UPI - Pope Leo XIV expected to visit Lebanon on first international trip: https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2025/08/21/pope-leo-lebanon-first-international-trip/
Yahoo/Reuters - Pope Leo to visit Lebanon, cardinal says, in likely first trip abroad: https://www.yahoo.com/news/pope-leo-visit-lebanon-cardinal-170245456.html
Holy See Press Office: https://press.vatican.va/
Vatican News: https://www.vaticannews.va/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, the Holy See Press Office or Vatican News first publishes an official announcement that Pope Leo XIV will make a trip to Lebanon, and no earlier official announcement in that same window names any other sovereign country outside Italy as the destination of an upcoming papal trip.

This question resolves No if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, either (a) the first such official foreign-trip announcement instead names a different sovereign country outside Italy, or (b) no official announcement of any upcoming foreign papal trip outside Italy is published by the Holy See Press Office or Vatican News during that window.

For resolution, "official announcement" means a publicly accessible item from the Holy See Press Office (https://press.vatican.va/) or Vatican News (https://www.vaticannews.va/) that explicitly states Pope Leo XIV will travel/visit a named sovereign country outside Italy. Routine speeches, rumors, third-party press reports, invitations, or statements by non-Vatican officials do not count unless reproduced as an official Holy See Press Office bulletin or Vatican News report.

If an announcement names multiple countries at once, the question resolves Yes only if Lebanon is included and no previously published official announcement in the window named a different foreign destination first. If the first official announcement in the window names multiple countries including Lebanon, that still counts as Yes, because Lebanon would be part of the first announced foreign trip itinerary. If the first official announcement in the window names multiple countries and does not include Lebanon, the question resolves No.

Primary source for resolution: Holy See Press Office bulletins and schedules at https://press.vatican.va/ . Secondary/fallback source: Vatican News at https://www.vaticannews.va/ . If timestamps differ across mirrored pages, use the earliest publication time shown on the Holy See Press Office site; if unavailable, use Vatican News publication time. If no authoritative timestamp is available but publication date is clear, use date only.

If the relevant official announcement is published after 2025-10-31, it does not count. If source pages are unavailable at resolution time, archived versions from the Holy See website or Vatican News pages may be used, but only if they clearly preserve the original text and publication date.
subquestions.rationale: The first official Vatican trip announcement is a strong early indicator of which country Pope Leo XIV is likely to visit first. It is not the same as the ultimate question, because announcements can precede or differ from actual travel, but resolving this subquestion should meaningfully update forecasts about whether Lebanon is the first country visited.

question: Will China lift rare earths export ban by December 31?
description:
On April 4, China implemented a series of restrictions on the export of a variety of rare earth metals. You can read more about that here: https://www.nytimes.com/2025/04/13/business/china-rare-earths-exports.html

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Chinese government officially lifts, removes, or reduces any of the export restrictions placed on rare earth metals on April 4, between July 23 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

The issuance of a qualifying official act by China within this market's timeframe will count toward a "Yes" resolution, even if the lifting or reduction of the stated export ban does not come into effect until after this market's resolution date.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the government of the United States, however a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

subquestions.question: Will China's Ministry of Commerce or Foreign Ministry publicly announce, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, that it has approved additional compliant export-license applications for rare earth-related items to India, the United States, or the European Union?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term signal for whether China may lift or soften its April 4 rare-earth export restrictions is whether Beijing starts publicly emphasizing approval of export-license applications for affected destinations. China remains the dominant global supplier of rare earths, and its April 2025 licensing restrictions sharply disrupted downstream industries. Reuters reported in August 2025 that China issued new regulations tightening oversight of rare-earth mining, smelting, and trade, including monthly circulation reporting and quota-linked penalties, with the rules taking effect July 28, 2025. Reuters also noted that outbound shipments had only improved after a temporary trade deal and that China had intensified its crackdown on illegal exports in July, indicating that controls remained active rather than broadly lifted as of late August. See Reuters via Morningstar: https://www.morningstar.com/news/reuters/20250822nL4N3T80TW/china-tightens-controls-on-rare-earths

On August 19, 2025, China's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said China had "approved a certain number of compliant applications for rare earth-related exports" and would continue to strengthen the approval process, while maintaining dialogue with relevant countries. That statement is important because it suggests a path of incremental administrative easing before any formal rollback of the April restrictions. See Pakistan Today summarizing the press briefing: https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2025/08/19/china-responds-to-reports-of-lifting-restrictions-on-rare-earth-exports-to-india/

At the same time, reporting in September indicated that India still had not seen a meaningful resumption of rare-earth shipments despite diplomatic assurances, suggesting that public confirmation of newly approved licenses would be informative rather than trivial. Moneycontrol, citing businessline, reported on September 11 that none of India's importers had yet received supplies and that Beijing had made no official statement on resumption. https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/china-yet-to-resume-rare-earth-exports-to-india-despite-wang-yis-assurance-ev-makers-face-crunch-report-13415138.html

Because the ultimate question asks whether China will officially lift, remove, or reduce any of the April 4 restrictions by the end of the market window, a public Chinese government statement that additional licenses are being approved for major destinations would be a meaningful observable precursor. It would not itself be the same as lifting the restrictions, but it would indicate operational easing and increased political willingness to soften the regime.

Sources:
Reuters / Morningstar - China Tightens Controls on Rare Earths - https://www.morningstar.com/news/reuters/20250822nL4N3T80TW/china-tightens-controls-on-rare-earths
Pakistan Today - China responds to reports of lifting restrictions on rare-earth exports to India - https://www.pakistantoday.com.pk/2025/08/19/china-responds-to-reports-of-lifting-restrictions-on-rare-earth-exports-to-india/
Moneycontrol - China yet to resume rare earth exports to India despite Wang Yi's assurance - https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/china-yet-to-resume-rare-earth-exports-to-india-despite-wang-yis-assurance-ev-makers-face-crunch-report-13415138.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, either (a) the People's Republic of China Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) or (b) the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA), including an official spokesperson briefing transcript, publicly states that China has approved additional compliant export-license applications for rare earth-related items destined for India, the United States, or the European Union.

For Yes, the statement must be published on an official PRC government website during the resolution window and must clearly refer to approvals being granted or additional applications being approved during or by that time. General statements that China is "willing to strengthen dialogue," that it will "continue the approval process," or that approvals have occurred in the past without indicating additional approvals during the window are insufficient.

Primary sources:
- PRC Ministry of Commerce English site: http://english.mofcom.gov.cn/
- PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs English site and spokesperson transcripts: https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng/ and https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng/xwfw_665399/s2510_665401/

If neither ministry publishes a qualifying statement on its official site during the window, resolve No.

If an official statement is issued within the window but later removed, archived copies from the official domain or contemporaneous reporting quoting the official statement from Reuters may be used as fallback evidence:
- Reuters World / China coverage: https://www.reuters.com/world/china/

If source websites are unavailable at resolution time, archived official pages (for example via the Internet Archive) and Reuters reporting that directly quotes the official statement may be used. If no reliable determination can be made from official or fallback sources, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A public announcement of new rare-earth export-license approvals would be an observable sign of administrative easing and diplomatic de-escalation. That would increase the likelihood that China subsequently takes the more explicit step required by the ultimate question: officially lifting, removing, or reducing some portion of the April 4 restrictions.

question: OpenAI becomes a for-profit in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if OpenAI shifts from its current capped-profit corporation structure to a for-profit model by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

Any form of fully for-profit organization—including a Benefit Corporation (B-Corp), Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), or a modification to its existing structure to remove profit caps—will suffice for a "Yes" resolution.

If the OpenAI non-profit relinquishes control over the for-profit business, this will also qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

An announcement indicating that OpenAI is merely considering the shift will not suffice; the change must officially occur.

The primary resolution source will be official information from OpenAI; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will OpenAI publicly disclose by 2025-10-25 that its capped-profit investor return structure has been replaced with a standard equity or uncapped stock-based capital structure for its main commercial entity?
subquestions.background_information:
This is a useful indicator for whether OpenAI will count as having become a for-profit in 2025 because the ultimate market explicitly treats removal of profit caps as sufficient for a Yes resolution. In May 2025, OpenAI announced that it would keep nonprofit control but planned to convert its commercial arm into a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) and move away from its "complex capped-profit structure" toward "a normal capital structure where everyone has stock," according to Sam Altman's letter discussed by Engadget: https://www.engadget.com/ai/openais-new-for-profit-plan-leaves-many-unanswered-questions-184819903.html . Investopedia likewise reported that OpenAI said it would remain nonprofit-controlled while reorganizing the for-profit arm into a PBC: https://www.investopedia.com/openai-scraps-for-profit-plans-11728115 . TechCrunch reported that Microsoft had not yet approved the proposed structure as of May 2025, suggesting implementation details were still pending: https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/07/openai-expects-to-cut-share-of-revenue-it-pays-microsoft-by-2030/ .

Because the key unresolved factual issue is whether the old capped-profit economics are actually replaced in official documents or announcements, a public disclosure of uncapped/common-equity-style ownership would be a strong near-term crux. If OpenAI formally says the capped-profit model has been replaced, that materially increases the odds that the ultimate question resolves Yes, even if nonprofit control is retained.

Sources:
Engadget - OpenAI's new for-profit plan leaves many unanswered questions - https://www.engadget.com/ai/openais-new-for-profit-plan-leaves-many-unanswered-questions-184819903.html
Investopedia - OpenAI Scraps For-Profit Plans - https://www.investopedia.com/openai-scraps-for-profit-plans-11728115
TechCrunch - OpenAI expects to cut share of revenue it pays Microsoft by 2030 - https://techcrunch.com/2025/05/07/openai-expects-to-cut-share-of-revenue-it-pays-microsoft-by-2030/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-25 (inclusive), OpenAI publicly states in an official source that the capped-profit / capped-return structure governing its main commercial entity has been replaced by a standard equity, normal capital, stock-based, or otherwise uncapped return structure. Qualifying official sources include OpenAI's official blog, newsroom, charter/governance pages, legal documents posted by OpenAI, or filings by an OpenAI entity. A statement that OpenAI is merely considering such a change does not count.

This question also resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-25 (inclusive), OpenAI publishes governing documents for its main commercial entity that clearly show ordinary equity or stock ownership without an investor return cap.

It resolves No if no such public disclosure appears by 2025-10-25.

Priority resolution sources: OpenAI official site https://openai.com/ , OpenAI newsroom/blog pages on that domain, and any legal/governance documents publicly linked there. If OpenAI publishes no direct statement but multiple highly credible outlets quote or reproduce an OpenAI statement or document released within the window, those may be used as secondary evidence, with preference to verbatim quotations from OpenAI materials. If the evidence remains ambiguous as to whether the cap was actually removed, resolve No.

If a relevant announcement is made within the window but expressly says the change will occur only after 2025-10-25, this question resolves No. If OpenAI's public materials are removed after publication, archived copies or contemporaneous reporting quoting the original text may be used.

Useful source pages for resolution:
OpenAI homepage/newsroom - https://openai.com/
OpenAI blog - https://openai.com/news/
OpenAI governance page - https://openai.com/our-structure/
Engadget article quoting Altman's May 2025 letter - https://www.engadget.com/ai/openais-new-for-profit-plan-leaves-many-unanswered-questions-184819903.html
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question can resolve Yes if OpenAI removes profit caps even without giving up nonprofit control. Therefore, official confirmation that the capped-profit model has actually been replaced is one of the most direct and informative leading indicators short of the final event itself.

question: Evidence Trump went to Epstein's Island made public in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if evidence is made public confirming that Donald Trump has visited visited Little Saint James by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This includes but is not limited to flight logs, photographs, videos, court records, or sworn testimony that clearly place Trump on the island.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. House Oversight Committee, the Department of Justice, or the FBI publicly release by 2025-11-30 at least one document that explicitly references "Little Saint James" (or "Little St. James" / "LSJ") and names Donald Trump in the same document?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term driver of the ultimate question is whether official Epstein-related document releases continue and whether those releases contain island-specific material involving Donald Trump. Reporting before 2025-10-31 indicated that Congress and the DOJ were reviewing and partially releasing Epstein-related materials. Maggie Haberman said in August 2025 that the DOJ planned to send part of roughly 100,000 pages of Epstein files to the House Oversight Committee, and that unreleased evidence reportedly included logbooks of visitors to Little Saint James: https://www.alternet.org/trump-epstein-files-haberman/ .

Separate late-September reporting said newly released documents from Epstein's estate included a 2014 calendar entry about a possible Elon Musk island visit, showing that document batches being made public in 2025 can contain island-specific references even when they do not prove an actual visit: https://www.thestar.com/news/world/united-states/musk-says-he-rejected-invite-to-epsteins-caribbean-island/article_1b8fb3a0-8d59-5d0f-9b6e-d0e7e4c9e4df.html and https://in-cyprus.philenews.com/international/leaked-documents-reveal-planned-visit-by-elon-musk-to-jeffrey-epsteins-private-island/ .

Trump publicly denied going to Little Saint James in July 2025, saying he "never had the privilege" of going and had turned down an invitation: https://people.com/donald-trump-says-he-never-had-the-privilege-to-go-to-epstein-island-11775381 . If an official release were to contain a document naming Trump alongside a direct island reference, that would be a meaningful leading indicator for whether stronger evidence of an actual visit may emerge by year-end, even though such a document alone might fall short of proving the ultimate claim.

This subquestion is not just the ultimate question with an earlier deadline: it asks about a narrower precursor event in the information pipeline—whether an official public release surfaces a Trump-plus-island document at all.

Sources:
Alternet - Haberman says Trump nervous over upcoming Epstein release: https://www.alternet.org/trump-epstein-files-haberman/
The Star - Musk says he rejected invite to Epstein's Caribbean island: https://www.thestar.com/news/world/united-states/musk-says-he-rejected-invite-to-epsteins-caribbean-island/article_1b8fb3a0-8d59-5d0f-9b6e-d0e7e4c9e4df.html
In-Cyprus / Phileleftheros - Leaked documents reveal planned visit by Elon Musk to Jeffrey Epstein's private island: https://in-cyprus.philenews.com/international/leaked-documents-reveal-planned-visit-by-elon-musk-to-jeffrey-epsteins-private-island/
People - Donald Trump Says He 'Never Had the Privilege' to Go to Epstein's Island: https://people.com/donald-trump-says-he-never-had-the-privilege-to-go-to-epstein-island-11775381
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 inclusive, an official public release by any of the following entities becomes publicly accessible on the open web: (a) the U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, (b) the U.S. Department of Justice, or (c) the FBI, and that release includes at least one document image, scan, transcript, exhibit, log, email, calendar entry, memo, or filing that both (1) names Donald Trump (including "Donald Trump," "Donald J. Trump," or a clearly identifying variant) and (2) explicitly references Little Saint James, Little St. James, or LSJ in the same document.

The release must be published by one of the named entities on an official website or official document repository. Primary sources for resolution are:
- House Oversight Committee website: https://oversight.house.gov/
- U.S. Department of Justice website: https://www.justice.gov/
- FBI website / Records: https://www.fbi.gov/ and https://vault.fbi.gov/

A document qualifies even if it does not prove Trump visited the island; this market is about whether such an official Trump-plus-island document is publicly released. Mere media summaries, leaks without an official public posting, social-media claims, or secondhand descriptions do not count unless the underlying document is publicly posted by one of the named entities within the window.

This question resolves No if no such official public release occurs between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 inclusive.

If a relevant release is announced within the window but the underlying document is not publicly accessible until after 2025-11-30, it does not count. If an official site later goes offline, archived copies or contemporaneous reporting may be used only to verify that the document was publicly posted by the official entity during the window. Good secondary confirmation sources, if needed, include Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/) and AP News (https://apnews.com/), but the official posting governs whenever available.
subquestions.rationale: If official releases begin surfacing documents that mention both Trump and Little Saint James, that substantially raises the chance that stronger corroborating evidence—such as logs, photos, testimony, or court records—will become public by the end of 2025. Conversely, the absence of any such official Trump-plus-island document in the immediate release wave is modest evidence against the ultimate question.

question: Will the Fed cut-pause-pause in 2025?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve according to the decisions made by the next three Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings in 2025 (September 16-17, October 28-29, and December 9-10).

A qualifying cut occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is lower compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying hike occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is higher compared to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

A qualifying pause occurs when the new upper bound of the target federal funds rate is equal to the level it was prior to the respective meeting.

If the Fed publishes a different combination than any listed, this market will resolve to "Other".

Emergency rate cuts outside the regularly scheduled meetings will not be considered. 

Any rate hike will be encompassed by "Other".

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meetings: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm

If no statement is released for the December meeting by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

subquestions.question: Will the September 2025 CPI report show U.S. core CPI inflation at or below 2.9% year-over-year?
subquestions.background_information:
A key crux for whether the Fed will cut in September and then pause in October is whether inflation data look sufficiently tame before the September 16-17 FOMC meeting. The Fed targets 2% inflation over the longer run and has recently kept the target federal funds range unchanged at 4.25% to 4.50%, while stating that inflation remains somewhat elevated and that it will assess incoming data on inflation and labor markets when considering policy changes. The July 30, 2025 FOMC statement said the Committee decided to maintain the target range at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent and continues to monitor risks to both sides of its mandate: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/monetary20250730a1.pdf

The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) publishes monthly CPI data, including CPI less food and energy (core CPI), which is closely watched by markets and policymakers as a signal of underlying inflation. The CPI release calendar is published by BLS here: https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm and the CPI home page is here: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/

As of mid-2025, market commentary has emphasized that a September cut is more likely if inflation remains subdued while labor-market data soften. For example, Forbes noted in August 2025 that a September cut was expected by many observers, conditional on tame inflation figures and slower job growth: https://www.forbes.com/sites/simonmoore/2025/08/03/what-to-expect-on-interest-rates-for-the-remainder-of-2025/

A core CPI year-over-year reading at or below 2.9% in the September 2025 CPI release would indicate further disinflation toward the Fed's 2% target and would likely strengthen the case for a September cut, which is a necessary precondition for the ultimate 'cut-pause-pause' path across the September, October, and December meetings. The 2.9% threshold is informative because it is low enough to signal continued progress on inflation, but not so low as to be nearly certain.

Sources:
Federal Reserve FOMC statement, July 30 2025 — https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/monetary20250730a1.pdf
BLS CPI release schedule — https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm
BLS Consumer Price Index home page — https://www.bls.gov/cpi/
Forbes on 2025 rate expectations — https://www.forbes.com/sites/simonmoore/2025/08/03/what-to-expect-on-interest-rates-for-the-remainder-of-2025/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reports, between 2025-09-05 and 2025-10-05 inclusive, that CPI for All Urban Consumers less food and energy (core CPI) was 2.9% or lower on a 12-month percent-change basis in the first CPI release published during that window.

Primary source: the BLS CPI news release and associated tables at https://www.bls.gov/cpi/ and release schedule at https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm

Resolution procedure:
1. Identify the first official BLS CPI release published between 2025-09-05 and 2025-10-05 inclusive.
2. Use the reported 12-month percent change for 'All items less food and energy' (seasonally adjusted or not seasonally adjusted if that is the headline presentation in the release; if both are shown, use the standard 12-month figure highlighted in the BLS release text/tables).
3. Resolve Yes if that figure is less than or equal to 2.9%.
4. Otherwise resolve No.

If BLS does not publish any CPI release during the window 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-05 inclusive, this question is unresolvable. If the main CPI page is unavailable, the corresponding BLS news release PDF or archived release accessible from https://www.bls.gov/cpi/ or https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm should be used.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question depends first on whether the Fed cuts in September. Inflation data released before that meeting are among the most important observable drivers of that decision. A sufficiently low core CPI reading would materially increase the odds of a September cut; a hotter reading would make a cut less likely and thus reduce the chance of the specific cut-pause-pause sequence.

question: Will Russia capture Myrnohrad by September 30?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the intersection between Vatutina Vulytsya and Puhachova Vulytsya located in Myrnohrad by September 30, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET.

The intersection station will be considered captured if any part of the intersection is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by September 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to “No”.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded red in the ISW map. An announcement of a negotiated settlement which gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Once Russia captures the intersection, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

Intersection Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/myrnohrad+intersection+zoom.png

Intersection Location in Myrnohrad: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/myrnohrad+intersection.jpeg

Myrnohrad Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/myrnohrad.jpeg

Location on Google maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qCLFQNiDKN2ABe5Q9

The primary resolution source for this market will be the ISW Ukraine map. If the ISW map is rendered unavailable, information from DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used. If information from both the ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

Note: Any temporary glitches or errors in the map will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will Russian-controlled territory on the ISW Ukraine map reach any part of Myrnohrad's eastern administrative boundary between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-28?
subquestions.background_information:
A useful leading indicator for whether Russia will capture a specific intersection inside Myrnohrad by September 30 is whether Russian forces first reach the city limits. If Russian-controlled territory touches Myrnohrad's eastern administrative boundary, that would suggest Russian forces have closed the remaining gap to the urban area and materially improved their chances of pushing farther into the city before the ultimate market resolves. Conversely, if they have not even reached the city boundary by late September, the odds of taking an interior intersection by September 30 are lower.

Myrnohrad is adjacent to Pokrovsk in Donetsk Oblast and sits on an active axis of Russian operations. The ISW interactive Ukraine map is the ultimate market's primary source and is therefore a natural source for a closely related but distinct territorial-indicator subquestion: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 . DeepStateMap provides another frequently updated frontline map for fallback and cross-checking: https://deepstatemap.live/ .

Recent reporting before 2025-09-01 indicates Russian pressure east of Myrnohrad. AGC News reported on 2025-08-31 that Russian units had expanded control east of Myrnohrad, seized the Oksamyt wastewater plant, pushed toward Pankivka, and were advancing from the Novoekonomichne/Myrolyubivka area while Ukrainian forces withdrew westward under fire: https://www.agcnews.eu/ukrainerussiawar-moscow-advances-on-kiev-and-front-expands-in-favor-of-russians-at-myrnohrad/ . At the same time, ISW's 2025-08-25 assessment noted that Russian forces had shifted focus to Pokrovsk and Myrnohrad, though it also cited Ukrainian counteraction and stated Russian forces had struggled to consolidate some penetrations: https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-august-25-2025 .

Because the ultimate question concerns a point well inside Myrnohrad, the city's administrative boundary is a meaningful intermediate milestone rather than a mere earlier restatement of the same event. Reaching the city edge is a prerequisite-like operational step for capturing an interior road intersection, especially in urban combat where each additional block can take significant time.

Sources:
ISW Ukraine interactive map — https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
DeepStateMap — https://deepstatemap.live/
AGC News, 2025-08-31 — https://www.agcnews.eu/ukrainerussiawar-moscow-advances-on-kiev-and-front-expands-in-favor-of-russians-at-myrnohrad/
ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, 2025-08-25 — https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-august-25-2025
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Russian-controlled territory is shown as touching or overlapping any part of Myrnohrad's eastern administrative boundary at any time between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-28 (inclusive).

Primary source: the ISW Ukraine interactive map, using the control-of-terrain shading shown there: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 .

For purposes of this question, "Myrnohrad's eastern administrative boundary" means the eastern city limit as displayed on standard public basemaps such as Google Maps for Myrnohrad, Donetsk Oblast: https://maps.app.goo.gl/qCLFQNiDKN2ABe5Q9 . If a resolver needs a more explicit reference, any clearly labeled city boundary layer on Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, or equivalent widely used public map may be used to identify the city limit, but the control determination must still come from ISW unless fallback criteria are triggered.

The question resolves No if, by 2025-09-28 23:59:59 UTC, no part of Russian-controlled territory on the ISW map has touched or overlapped any part of that eastern city boundary.

Fallbacks: If the ISW map is rendered unavailable for the relevant period, DeepStateMap may be used to determine whether Russian-controlled territory reached the city boundary: https://deepstatemap.live/ . If both ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible geolocated reporting may be used.

Temporary glitches, delayed tile loading, or obvious cartographic errors should be ignored. If map evidence is too ambiguous to determine whether contact with the boundary occurred during the 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-28 window, and no fallback source cleanly resolves it, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Touching Myrnohrad's eastern city boundary is a concrete operational milestone that should strongly update forecasts about whether Russia can capture a specific interior intersection by September 30. It is closer to the target than broad frontline gains, but still distinct from the ultimate question.

question: Will Ghislaine Maxwell testify before Congress in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Ghislaine Maxwell provides live or recorded testimony before either chamber of the United States Congress (House of Representatives or Senate), or any of their official committees or subcommittees by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform publicly state by 2025-10-31 that it has scheduled, re-scheduled, or is actively negotiating a specific date for Ghislaine Maxwell's deposition or interview?
subquestions.background_information:
This is a useful near-term indicator for whether Maxwell will ultimately testify before Congress in 2025 because the main obstacle appears to be procedural and legal negotiation rather than simple congressional interest. In July 2025, the House Oversight Committee moved to subpoena Maxwell regarding Jeffrey Epstein-related matters, and reporting indicated a deposition had at one point been contemplated for August 11, 2025. However, Maxwell's attorneys said she would testify only if several conditions were met, including immunity, advance access to questions, and timing after the resolution of her Supreme Court petition; they also said that absent those concessions she would invoke the Fifth Amendment. CNN reported that the committee rejected immunity, while Maxwell's lawyer said they remained open to finding a path forward. These facts suggest that a concrete public update from the committee in October 2025 that a date is being set or negotiated would be meaningful evidence that talks have advanced beyond the July standoff and therefore would raise the odds of actual testimony before the end of 2025. See CNN's reporting on Maxwell's conditions and the committee's rejection of immunity: https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/29/politics/ghislaine-maxwell-testify-congress-immunity ; and Yahoo/AFP on the subpoena push and broader congressional effort: https://www.yahoo.com/news/us-congress-subpoena-ghislaine-maxwell-2025-07-22.html . Additional contemporaneous reporting indicated the committee had subpoenaed Maxwell for an August 11 deposition and that her counsel was still seeking concessions: https://www.politico.com/ (as quoted in secondary coverage summarized at https://boingboing.net/2025/07/29/sex-trafficker-ghislaine-maxwell-wants-new-conditions-met-before-shell-testify-to-congress.html ).

Sources:
CNN Politics - Maxwell offers to testify before Congress but with major conditions, including immunity - https://www.cnn.com/2025/07/29/politics/ghislaine-maxwell-testify-congress-immunity
Yahoo News / AFP - US Congress will subpoena Ghislaine Maxwell to testify about Jeffrey Epstein amid political firestorm - https://www.yahoo.com/news/us-congress-subpoena-ghislaine-maxwell-2025-07-22.html
Boing Boing summary citing Politico - Sex trafficker Ghislaine Maxwell wants new conditions met before she'll testify to Congress - https://boingboing.net/2025/07/29/sex-trafficker-ghislaine-maxwell-wants-new-conditions-met-before-shell-testify-to-congress.html
House Oversight Committee official site - https://oversight.house.gov/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform (or its official chair, ranking member, official spokesperson, or official website/social-media account) publicly states that: (a) a specific date has been scheduled or re-scheduled for Ghislaine Maxwell's deposition, interview, or testimony before the committee or a subcommittee; or (b) the committee and Maxwell/her counsel are actively negotiating or finalizing a specific date for such a deposition, interview, or testimony.

This question resolves No if no such public statement is made between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive.

Qualifying statements must be attributable to an official committee source or be reported by at least one credible outlet quoting an on-record committee spokesperson or member acting in an official capacity. General statements that the committee still wants testimony, without mention of scheduling, re-scheduling, or active date-setting negotiations, do not qualify. Mere repetition in October of a previously announced August plan does not qualify unless the October statement makes clear that a date is currently scheduled, being re-scheduled, or actively negotiated during the resolution window.

Primary resolution sources: the House Oversight Committee official website https://oversight.house.gov/ and official X account https://x.com/GOPoversight . Secondary sources, if needed, include credible reporting such as CNN https://www.cnn.com/politics , NBC News https://www.nbcnews.com/politics , The Hill https://thehill.com/homenews/house/ , Politico https://www.politico.com/ , and Reuters https://www.reuters.com/ . If no primary-source statement is available but multiple credible reports consistently quote an official committee source on the record, those reports may be used. If reporting is contradictory and no consensus can be established, the question should be considered unresolved rather than forced to Yes or No.
subquestions.rationale: A public October update that a date is scheduled or actively being negotiated would be a strong operational signal that the congressional process is moving toward actual testimony. It is not the same as asking whether Maxwell testifies; instead, it measures whether the stalled subpoena/negotiation process has materially advanced.

question: Nothing Ever Happens: US Strike Edition
description:
This market will resolve to “No” if any of the following conditions are met between market creation and March 31, 2026, 11:59 ET:

- Another US strike on Venezuela
- US strikes Iran
- US strike on Colombia
- US strike on Mexico
- US strike on Cuba

Otherwise, this market will resolve to “Yes”.

If no qualifying strike is confirmed by the resolution date, this market will remain open until the end of the second day after the resolution time. If the date/time of a qualifying strike cannot be confirmed by a consensus of credible reporting by that time, it will resolve to "Yes" regardless of whether a strike was later confirmed to have taken place.

The full rules for this market can be found here:
https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/NEHUSStrike.pdf

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Department of Defense announce between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05 that additional U.S. military forces or assets are being deployed to the U.S. Southern Command area of responsibility in response to the Venezuela operation?
subquestions.background_information:
A key near-term indicator for whether the U.S. could expand military action beyond Venezuela is whether Washington visibly reinforces the regional military posture. The ultimate market concerns possible U.S. strikes on Iran, Colombia, Mexico, or Cuba after the already-reported Venezuela strike. Following the January 2026 Venezuela operation, multiple reports say President Trump publicly threatened possible further military action involving Colombia, Mexico, and Cuba, and suggested readiness for additional strikes if Venezuelan authorities do not comply. See FXStreet (Jan. 5, 2026): https://www.fxstreet.com/news/dow-jones-futures-steady-ahead-of-us-ism-manufacturing-pmi-202601050933 and Newsquawk summaries via Zero Hedge (Jan. 5, 2026): https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/crude-falls-following-us-strike-venezuela-european-equity-futures-point-positive-open and https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/crude-benchmarks-trade-choppy-following-us-strike-venezuela-us-equity-futures-are

The Department of Defense regularly publicizes notable force posture changes through official releases and statements. U.S. Southern Command (SOUTHCOM) is the combatant command responsible for Latin America and the Caribbean, including Colombia, Venezuela, and Cuba: https://www.southcom.mil/About/ . A fresh deployment of naval, air, marine, or special-operations assets into SOUTHCOM after the Venezuela strike would be a concrete and observable escalation signal, more informative than rhetoric alone. Such deployments would not guarantee another strike, but they would materially increase the plausibility of one by improving readiness, logistics, and deterrence posture.

This is different from merely restating the ultimate question with an earlier deadline: it tracks a military-preparatory step that should update forecasters on the probability of additional U.S. strikes in the region. It is grounded in current events because the reported Venezuela operation has already occurred and public threats against Colombia, Mexico, and Cuba have been reported in major market coverage on Jan. 4-5, 2026.

Sources:
- FXStreet, Dow Jones futures steady ahead of US ISM Manufacturing PMI: https://www.fxstreet.com/news/dow-jones-futures-steady-ahead-of-us-ism-manufacturing-pmi-202601050933
- Zero Hedge / Newsquawk, Crude falls following US strike on Venezuela: https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/crude-falls-following-us-strike-venezuela-european-equity-futures-point-positive-open
- Zero Hedge / Newsquawk, Crude benchmarks trade choppy following US strike on Venezuela: https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/crude-benchmarks-trade-choppy-following-us-strike-venezuela-us-equity-futures-are
- U.S. Southern Command, About SOUTHCOM: https://www.southcom.mil/About/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05 (inclusive), the U.S. Department of Defense, a U.S. military service branch, or U.S. Southern Command publicly announces a new deployment, movement, or positioning of additional military forces or assets into the U.S. Southern Command area of responsibility explicitly connected to the Venezuela situation, regional deterrence, bordering states, counternarcotics pressure related to the crisis, or protection/contingency operations stemming from the January 2026 Venezuela operation.

Qualifying announcements include official press releases, statements, transcripts, or readouts on .mil or defense.gov websites that specify at least one additional asset or force package, such as naval vessels, combat aircraft, ISR aircraft, Marines, Army units, Special Operations forces, or air-defense/logistics enablers, being sent to or newly positioned within SOUTHCOM's area of responsibility. SOUTHCOM's AOR includes Latin America and the Caribbean; see https://www.southcom.mil/About/ .

The question resolves No if no such qualifying official announcement is published between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-05.

Clarifications:
- Routine previously scheduled exercises or rotations do not count unless the official announcement explicitly ties them to the Venezuela crisis or regional escalation after the January 2026 strike.
- Mere media speculation or unnamed-official reporting does not count without an official U.S. government announcement.
- Redeployments outside SOUTHCOM's area of responsibility do not count.
- If an announcement is first published within the window and later corrected, the corrected official record governs.
- If no authoritative official source remains available, fallback sources are archived official pages or contemporaneous Pentagon press briefings on https://www.defense.gov/ and official SOUTHCOM releases on https://www.southcom.mil/Newsroom/ .

Primary resolution sources:
- U.S. Department of Defense news: https://www.defense.gov/News/
- DoD Releases: https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/
- U.S. Southern Command newsroom: https://www.southcom.mil/Newsroom/
- U.S. Southern Command about page (for AOR definition): https://www.southcom.mil/About/
