subquestions.question: Will Take-Two Interactive's next earnings materials or call publicly reaffirm Grand Theft Auto VI's May 26, 2026 release date between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-07?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term crux for whether Rockstar will release another GTA VI trailer in late 2025 is whether parent company Take-Two continues to publicly stand behind the currently announced launch date. Companies often use trailers to support confidence in an on-track launch, pre-orders, and investor messaging; conversely, ambiguity or a delay signal would make a 2025 trailer less likely. As of late October 2025, multiple media reports state that GTA VI is scheduled for release on May 26, 2026 and that Take-Two's next earnings call is on November 6, 2025, making that event a key observable for near-term marketing cadence. See, e.g., reporting on the expected November 6 call and GTA VI update speculation: https://www.indiatimes.com/trending/take-two-interactive-confirms-next-official-gta-6-update-will-arrive-during-november-earnings-call-fans-eager-for-new-trailer-and-release-details-669171.html and https://www.indy100.com/gaming/gta-6-live-next-official-announcement-date-revealed . Take-Two's investor relations site hosts the authoritative earnings releases, presentations, and webcast links: https://www.take2games.com/ir/ . Rockstar's official GTA VI page currently lists the game and is the authoritative game-specific source: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI .

This subquestion is not a restatement of the ultimate trailer question: it asks about corporate guidance and schedule confidence, which is a different observable event. A public reaffirmation of the May 2026 date in earnings materials would be evidence that the marketing plan remains on track and could increase the chance of a trailer before year-end; failure to reaffirm, or signaling uncertainty, would point the other way.

Sources:
Take-Two Investor Relations — https://www.take2games.com/ir/
Rockstar Games GTA VI page — https://www.rockstargames.com/VI
IndiaTimes report on November 6 earnings call — https://www.indiatimes.com/trending/take-two-interactive-confirms-next-official-gta-6-update-will-arrive-during-november-earnings-call-fans-eager-for-new-trailer-and-release-details-669171.html
indy100 report on next official announcement date — https://www.indy100.com/gaming/gta-6-live-next-official-announcement-date-revealed
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-07 (inclusive), Take-Two Interactive publicly issues earnings materials or conducts an earnings call/webcast in which Grand Theft Auto VI is explicitly described as scheduled for release on "May 26, 2026" or equivalently reaffirmed as launching on that date.

Qualifying evidence, in order of priority:
1. A Take-Two earnings press release, shareholder letter, investor presentation, transcript, webcast replay, or prepared remarks posted on https://www.take2games.com/ir/ ; or
2. An SEC filing by Take-Two on EDGAR, if it contains the explicit reaffirmation: https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=946581&owner=exclude ; or
3. Rockstar's official GTA VI page https://www.rockstargames.com/VI if updated during the window with an explicit reaffirmation tied to Take-Two's earnings communications.

The resolution is based on public materials first made available during the window 2025-10-31 through 2025-11-07 inclusive. Mere media paraphrases, analyst commentary, fan summaries, or vague statements such as "on track" without an explicit mention of GTA VI and the May 26, 2026 date do not qualify on their own.

This question resolves No if, by 2025-11-07 23:59:59 UTC, no qualifying source in the above hierarchy explicitly reaffirms GTA VI's May 26, 2026 release date during the window.

If the scheduled earnings call is postponed beyond 2025-11-07 and no qualifying reaffirmation appears in the window, resolve No rather than unresolvable, because the question asks whether a reaffirmation occurs within the defined window. If Take-Two's IR site is unavailable, use the SEC filing and archived webcast/transcript pages as fallback sources.
subquestions.rationale: An explicit reaffirmation of the May 2026 launch date would be a strong signal that Rockstar and Take-Two are still comfortable with the game's schedule and may proceed with late-2025 marketing beats such as another trailer. If management avoids reaffirmation or changes guidance, forecasters should lower the probability of a new official trailer in the ultimate market window.

question: Will 'Zootopia 2' have the second best domestic opening weekend in 2025?
description:
This is a market on how whether 'Zootopia 2' (2025) will have the second-highest domestic gross on its opening weekend compared to all other movies released in 2025. The “Weekend Box Office Performance” table on https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Zootopia-2-(2025)#tab=box-office will be used to resolve this market once the values for the 3-day opening weekend (November 28 - 30) are final (i.e. not studio estimates).

This market will resolve to "Yes" if 'Zootopia 2' (2025) grosses the second-highest on its 3-day domestic opening weekend compared to any other movie in 2025. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Please note, this market will resolve according to the The Numbers figures provided under Weekend Box Office Performance for the 3-day weekend, regardless of whether domestic refers to only the USA, or to USA and Canada, etc.

Resolution will be based specifically on the figures provided for this movie's 3-day opening weekend (Friday, Saturday, Sunday), regardless of whether the movie has a 4 or 5-day opening weekend.

If two other movies' opening weekend box office performances surpass that of 'Zootopia 2' (2025) after the respective numbers are finalized, this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If this movie's opening weekend box office performance ties with any other's, the movie whose title comes first in alphabetical order will rank higher.

If there is no final data available by January 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, another credible resolution source will be chosen.

subquestions.question: Will 'Wicked: For Good' have a final 3-day domestic opening weekend of at least $130 million, as reported by The Numbers, by 2025-11-24?
subquestions.background_information:
A key determinant of whether 'Zootopia 2' can finish with the second-best domestic opening weekend of 2025 is how strongly 'Wicked: For Good' opens one week earlier. If 'Wicked: For Good' posts a very large opening, it likely occupies one of the top slots above 'Zootopia 2', reducing the room for Zootopia 2 to finish second only if it can still beat other major 2025 openings.

Recent trade reporting suggests 'Wicked: For Good' is tracking as one of the biggest openings of 2025. ComicBook reported on 2025-10-30 that the film was projected for roughly $112 million to $115 million domestically on opening weekend: https://comicbook.com/movies/news/wicked-for-good-box-office-opening-weekend-projection/ . Boxoffice Pro's long-range forecast for late-November titles placed 'Wicked: For Good' at roughly $130 million to $155 million domestically for its opening weekend, while also projecting 'Zootopia 2' at about $95 million to $110 million for its 3-day frame: https://www.boxofficepro.com/long-range-forecast-can-zootopia-2-break-moana-2s-thanksgiving-weekend-records/ . MovieWeb also noted that 'Zootopia 2' is being discussed as one of the year's biggest openings, but in many scenarios still below 'Wicked: For Good': https://movieweb.com/zootopia-2-box-office-opening-weekend-projection/ .

The threshold of $130 million is informative because it sits near the low end of some more bullish professional forecasts for 'Wicked: For Good'. If 'Wicked: For Good' clears that mark, it becomes more likely that one of the top two 2025 opening-weekend positions is already taken by a late-November rival, making the race for Zootopia 2 narrower and more dependent on whether it can exceed movies such as 'Lilo & Stitch' or 'A Minecraft Movie'.

Sources:
ComicBook - Wicked: For Good Projected For One of Year's Biggest Box Office Openings - https://comicbook.com/movies/news/wicked-for-good-box-office-opening-weekend-projection/
Boxoffice Pro - Long Range Forecast: Can ZOOTOPIA 2 Break MOANA 2's Thanksgiving Weekend Records? - https://www.boxofficepro.com/long-range-forecast-can-zootopia-2-break-moana-2s-thanksgiving-weekend-records/
MovieWeb - 'Zootopia 2' Projected for One of the Biggest Opening Weekends of 2025 - https://movieweb.com/zootopia-2-box-office-opening-weekend-projection/
The Numbers - Wicked: For Good - https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-For-Good-(2025)
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-24 (inclusive), The Numbers publishes a final value showing that 'Wicked: For Good' earned at least $130,000,000 on its 3-day domestic opening weekend (Friday-Sunday).

Primary source: the film's page on The Numbers, specifically the Weekend Box Office Performance table for the 3-day opening weekend: https://www.the-numbers.com/movie/Wicked-For-Good-(2025)

Resolution details:
- Use the final, not studio-estimate, 3-day domestic opening weekend number shown by The Numbers.
- If the final 3-day opening weekend listed on The Numbers is $130,000,000 or more by 2025-11-24 23:59:59 UTC, resolve Yes.
- If by 2025-11-24 23:59:59 UTC The Numbers shows a final 3-day opening weekend below $130,000,000, resolve No.
- If by 2025-11-24 23:59:59 UTC only studio estimates are available and no final number has been posted, this question is unresolvable.
- If The Numbers becomes unavailable, a fallback source is Box Office Mojo's domestic opening figure for the same 3-day weekend: https://www.boxofficemojo.com/ . If fallback is required, use the first publicly available non-estimate 3-day domestic opening value. If neither source provides a final/non-estimate figure by the end of the window, the question is unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Whether 'Wicked: For Good' opens huge is a major crux for Zootopia 2's chances of finishing second in 2025. A very strong Wicked opening would likely lock up one top position and make Zootopia 2's path to exactly second depend on beating the rest of the field.

question: X relaunches Vine in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if X relaunches Vine by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

"Relaunching Vine" is defined as launching a platform and/or feature that performs similar functions to Vine, and is branded as a "relaunch of Vine" by Elon Musk or X itself. Note - the relaunch must be live and broadly accessible to the public before the resolution date for this market to resolve to "Yes".

The primary resolution source will be the Vine platform, as well as official information from Elon Musk and X, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will X or Elon Musk publicly reveal a broadly accessible Vine product surface (such as a live website, app store listing, or in-app waitlist/signup page) between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
This is a useful leading indicator for whether X will relaunch Vine by the end of 2025, because a publicly accessible product surface is typically a major step between a verbal announcement and a true public launch. Elon Musk stated in July 2025, "We’re bringing back Vine, but in AI form," which moved the topic from speculation to an announced intent, but did not include a launch date, product URL, app listing, or public signup flow. Multiple news reports in late July and early August 2025 described the project as an AI-inflected Vine revival and noted that details remained sparse. One August 2025 report further claimed that X was restoring the Vine archive and that the restored archive could go live as early as October 2025, suggesting October is a plausible period for visible pre-launch product activity rather than a random date. See reporting at Winbuzzer: https://winbuzzer.com/2025/08/04/x-to-resurrect-vine-archive-in-ai-powered-push-for-video-dominance-xcxwbn/ and coverage summarizing Musk's July statement at Investopedia: https://www.investopedia.com/elon-musk-says-he-s-bringing-back-vine-here-s-what-it-s-all-about-11789983 and The A.V. Club: https://www.avclub.com/elon-musk-circles-back-to-his-dream-of-relaunching-vine

A public website, app listing, or signup page would be materially informative because the ultimate market requires a relaunch that is live and broadly accessible to the public by December 31, 2025. If by the end of October there is still no public product surface, forecasters should generally become less confident in a 2025 relaunch; if one does appear, confidence should increase even if the full launch has not yet occurred. This makes the subquestion a better crux than merely asking whether Vine launches earlier.

Sources:
Winbuzzer - X to Resurrect Vine Archive in AI-Powered Push for Video Dominance - https://winbuzzer.com/2025/08/04/x-to-resurrect-vine-archive-in-ai-powered-push-for-video-dominance-xcxwbn/
Investopedia - Elon Musk Says He's Bringing Back Vine. Here's What It's All About. - https://www.investopedia.com/elon-musk-says-he-s-bringing-back-vine-here-s-what-it-s-all-about-11789983
The A.V. Club - Elon Musk circles back to his dream of relaunching Vine - https://www.avclub.com/elon-musk-circles-back-to-his-dream-of-relaunching-vine
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), X Corp. or Elon Musk publicly reveals at least one broadly accessible Vine product surface intended for public use: (a) a live official Vine-branded website or subdomain; (b) an official Vine-branded listing in the Apple App Store or Google Play that is publicly viewable; or (c) an official Vine-branded in-product page on x.com or in the X app that allows the general public to join a waitlist, sign up, request access, or otherwise interact with a forthcoming Vine product.

For this question, "official" means the surface is linked from, posted by, or clearly attributable to an official X or Elon Musk communication channel, such as Elon Musk's account on X (https://x.com/elonmusk), X's official accounts on X, X's newsroom/blog pages, x.com, vine.co, or app publisher information identifying X Corp. A leaked screenshot, reverse-engineered code, or a page accessible only through developer tools does not count. A TestFlight-only beta, enterprise-only page, or page restricted to employees/invitees only does not count as "broadly accessible."

Primary resolution sources will be official X / Elon Musk communications and the live product surfaces themselves, including x.com, vine.co if reactivated, the Apple App Store (https://apps.apple.com/), and Google Play (https://play.google.com/store). Secondary sources may include consensus reporting from major outlets if the page existed during the window but is later removed. If no qualifying public product surface is revealed during the window from 2025-10-01 through 2025-10-31 inclusive, resolve No.

If an announcement during the window merely reiterates plans to revive Vine without revealing any public product surface, that is No. If a relevant launch or reveal occurs before 2025-10-01 or after 2025-10-31, it does not count. If evidence is too ambiguous to determine whether the surface was official and broadly accessible within the window, resolve No unless multiple authoritative sources clearly document that it was.

Proposed resolution sources:
Elon Musk on X - https://x.com/elonmusk
X platform - https://x.com/
Apple App Store - https://apps.apple.com/
Google Play Store - https://play.google.com/store
X Help Center / official web properties - https://help.x.com/ and https://about.x.com/
subquestions.rationale: A public Vine product surface is a concrete intermediate milestone that should substantially update beliefs about a full 2025 relaunch. It is not a restatement of the ultimate question, because it does not require Vine to be fully relaunched or broadly available as a complete product; it only asks whether X has advanced to a visible pre-launch or launch-preparation stage.

question: Will Wesley Hunt come in 3rd in the 2026 Texas Republican Primary?
description:
This market will resolve according to the candidate who receives the third-most votes in the first round of the Republican Primary for United States Senator from Texas, which is scheduled to take place on March 3, 2026. 

If no 2026 Texas Republican Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Texas Republican party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

subquestions.question: Will Wesley Hunt report raising at least $2.0 million in itemized+unitemized receipts for his principal campaign committee in an FEC filing covering activity through 2025-12-31?
subquestions.background_information:
Wesley Hunt entered the 2026 Texas Republican Senate primary in early October 2025, turning the race into a three-way contest with John Cornyn and Ken Paxton. Early reporting described Hunt as a credible but still trailing candidate: a University of Houston poll cited by Newsweek/Yahoo had Paxton at 34%, Cornyn at 33%, and Hunt at 22%, while Hunt’s name recognition among Republican voters was reported as 69%, below Paxton’s 94% and Cornyn’s 90% (https://www.yahoo.com/news/polls-tighten-wesley-hunt-enters-151500000.html). Other reporting noted Hunt had previously raised just over $400,000 in the quarter ending July 2025 before entering the Senate race, versus Cornyn’s $3.9 million and Paxton’s $2.9 million in that earlier period, underscoring that fundraising strength is a major uncertainty for whether Hunt can remain competitive statewide (https://www.yahoo.com/news/wesley-hunt-launches-senate-bid-texas-192640019.html). Reporting also said Hunt and aligned groups had already spent heavily to expand his profile, including a reported $1.2 million statewide ad buy at launch (https://townhall.com/tipsheet/saraharnold/2025/10/06/rep-wesley-hunt-announces-senate-bid-against-cornyn-and-paxton-n2664948). In a crowded primary, substantial fundraising would be a strong indicator that Hunt can sustain media presence and organization, potentially threatening one of the two better-known rivals rather than merely finishing a distant third.

Because the ultimate question is whether Hunt comes exactly third in the March 2026 primary, near-term evidence about whether he can build a serious statewide campaign matters. A large fundraising haul by year-end would suggest Hunt is more viable and may be less likely to settle into a clear third-place lane; a weak haul would suggest the opposite.

Sources:
- Yahoo/Newsweek on poll after Hunt entered: https://www.yahoo.com/news/polls-tighten-wesley-hunt-enters-151500000.html
- Yahoo on Hunt launch and prior fundraising context: https://www.yahoo.com/news/wesley-hunt-launches-senate-bid-texas-192640019.html
- Townhall on Hunt launch and ad buy: https://townhall.com/tipsheet/saraharnold/2025/10/06/rep-wesley-hunt-announces-senate-bid-against-cornyn-and-paxton-n2664948
- Federal Election Commission campaign finance data portal: https://www.fec.gov/data/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-26 and 2025-12-26 inclusive, the Federal Election Commission (FEC) makes available a filing by Wesley Hunt’s principal Senate campaign committee that reports total receipts of at least $2,000,000 for the reporting period covered by that filing and ending on or before 2025-12-31.

Primary source: the FEC candidate/committee filings and totals pages at https://www.fec.gov/data/ and the committee’s filed reports accessible there.

Interpretation rules:
1. The relevant committee is Hunt’s principal campaign committee for his 2026 U.S. Senate campaign in Texas, as identified in FEC records.
2. “Total receipts” means the figure reported by the committee for receipts for the reporting period in the filed report, not cash-on-hand and not combined receipts of super PACs or joint fundraising committees unless those funds are reported as receipts of Hunt’s principal committee itself.
3. An amendment filed within the resolution window counts, and the most recent qualifying filing available on the FEC site by 2025-12-26 23:59:59 UTC governs.
4. If multiple reports are filed in the window, any one qualifying report is sufficient for Yes.
5. If no such filing is available on the FEC site by the end of the window, the question resolves No.
6. If the FEC site is unavailable, a directly accessible PDF of the filing from the committee or an archived FEC copy may be used as fallback evidence, but the numerical total must match what is reported in the filed report. Relevant fallback source: committee filings or PDFs linked from FEC results pages at https://www.fec.gov/data/.
7. If reporting schedules are delayed such that no filing covering activity through 2025-12-31 is available during the 2025-11-26 to 2025-12-26 window, the question resolves No rather than unresolvable, because the event being forecast is publication of such a filing within that window.

Useful source links for resolution:
- FEC data portal: https://www.fec.gov/data/
- FEC filings search: https://www.fec.gov/data/filings/
- FEC candidates search: https://www.fec.gov/data/candidates/
subquestions.rationale: Fundraising is an early indicator of whether Hunt is building a campaign capable of overtaking either Cornyn or Paxton. A strong year-end haul would make a third-place finish less likely; a weak haul would support the view that Hunt remains the likely third-place candidate.

question: Fed governor resigns by October 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a Fed governor announces they have resigned or will resign between August 8 and October 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

For this market to resolve to "Yes," it is only necessary that a governor announce that they have resigned or will resign. Whether they actually resign will have no bearing on the resolution of this market.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the US federal government; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will a federal court issue an order between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 that restores, preserves, or recognizes Lisa Cook's authority to serve as a Federal Reserve Governor after President Trump's August 2025 attempted removal?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question is whether any Fed governor will announce a resignation by October 31, 2025. A key live driver of that risk is the confrontation over Governor Lisa Cook. Multiple reports state that President Trump publicly claimed to remove Cook in late August 2025, while Cook replied that he had no authority to do so and explicitly said she would not resign. If courts quickly back Cook's position, that likely reduces near-term pressure for a resignation announcement; if they do not, resignation risk may rise due to legal, political, and institutional pressure.

As of late August 2025, Cook had publicly stated: "I will not resign." Reuters-style and other reporting described the action as unprecedented and likely headed for litigation. See WTOP/AP coverage: https://wtop.com/business-finance/2025/08/stocks-slide-after-trump-says-he-is-firing-fed-governor-lisa-cook/ ; CNBC coverage: https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/26/trump-tells-feds-lisa-cook-shes-fired-she-says-he-has-no-authority-to-do-so.html ; and CNN reporting that Cook planned to contest the action in court: https://www.cnn.com/2025/08/28/economy/trump-fed-lisa-cook-fired

The Federal Reserve Board's official website lists Board members and publishes press releases and speeches, making it a useful source for whether Cook continues to be treated as a serving governor: https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/boardmembers.htm and https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents.htm . Federal court dockets are publicly tracked through PACER and often reflected in major legal/news coverage.

This subquestion is a useful crux because the legal status of Cook is a major determinant of whether the conflict ends in forced exit, negotiated departure, or continued service. A court order favorable to Cook before October would be a concrete, observable indicator that a resignation announcement is less likely by October 31 than it would otherwise be.

Sources:
WTOP/AP - Fed governor won't leave, saying Trump lacks authority to fire her: https://wtop.com/business-finance/2025/08/stocks-slide-after-trump-says-he-is-firing-fed-governor-lisa-cook/
CNBC - Trump tells Fed's Lisa Cook she's fired; she says 'he has no authority to do so': https://www.cnbc.com/2025/08/26/trump-tells-feds-lisa-cook-shes-fired-she-says-he-has-no-authority-to-do-so.html
CNN - Inside Trump's attempt to put his mark on the Fed: https://www.cnn.com/2025/08/28/economy/trump-fed-lisa-cook-fired
Federal Reserve Board members page: https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/boardmembers.htm
Federal Reserve news/events: https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents.htm
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), a U.S. federal court issues a written order, opinion, judgment, or docketed minute order in litigation concerning President Trump's August 2025 attempted removal of Lisa Cook that does at least one of the following: (a) enjoins or stays her removal, (b) orders that she be reinstated or remain in office pending litigation, or (c) explicitly states that she continues to possess the authority or status of a Federal Reserve Governor pending further proceedings.

This question resolves No if no such court order is issued between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive).

For resolution, the primary source will be the relevant federal court docket and filed orders accessible via PACER/CourtListener/RECAP. CourtListener search may be used to locate the case and docketed orders: https://www.courtlistener.com/ . If the docket is difficult to access, a consensus of at least two credible reports from major outlets that quote or reproduce the order may be used as a fallback, such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), AP (https://apnews.com/), Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/), CNBC (https://www.cnbc.com/), or the Federal Reserve's official site if it references the order: https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents.htm .

Only orders actually issued within the window from 2025-09-01 through 2025-10-01 count. Oral remarks not reflected in a docketed order do not count. A mere filing of a lawsuit, motion for TRO, or hearing scheduling order does not count unless the court's order itself grants relief described above. If the case is transferred, consolidated, or renumbered, any qualifying federal court order in the same dispute still counts. If no qualifying order is issued by 2025-10-01, the market resolves No. If source availability problems make the existence of an order impossible to verify, the resolver should use the best available combination of docket access and contemporaneous reporting; if still impossible, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: The attempted removal of Lisa Cook is the most salient current pathway to a Fed-governor departure. A court order protecting or restoring her status would materially reduce the chance that she or another governor announces a resignation under pressure before October 31. Conversely, the absence of such legal protection keeps resignation risk elevated. This is therefore a high-value, nontrivial indicator rather than a restatement of the ultimate question.

question: Will Russia capture Lyman by November 30?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the Lyman railroad station located on Vulytsya Pryvokzalʹna by November 30, 2025, at 11:59 PM ET.

The railroad station will be considered captured if any part of the train station icon is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to “No”.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded red in the ISW map. An announcement of a negotiated settlement which gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Once Russia captures the railroad station, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

Train Station Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/lyman+train+station+zoom.png

Train Station Location in Lyman: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/lyman+train+station.jpeg

Lyman Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/lyman.jpeg

Location on Google maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/zeVSXaeDH93mF2WPA

The primary resolution source for this market will be the ISW Ukraine map. If the ISW map is rendered unavailable, information from DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used. If information from both the ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

Note: Any temporary glitches or errors in the map will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will the ISW control-of-terrain map show any Russian-controlled area inside the built-up area of Lyman city by 2025-11-21?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question is whether Russia will capture the Lyman railroad station by November 30, 2025. A useful leading indicator is whether Russian forces first establish any foothold inside Lyman’s urban/built-up area on the Institute for the Study of War (ISW) map. If Russia is shown controlling territory within the city itself before late November, that would be strong evidence that the rail station on Vulytsya Pryvokzalʹna is at greater near-term risk; if not, capture of the station by November 30 becomes less likely.

Lyman is in northern Donetsk Oblast and remains a meaningful rail/logistics node. The user-specified ultimate market resolves using the ISW Ukraine map, with the rail station identified on Google Maps and user-provided location images. As of the question start date, Russia has been making incremental advances in eastern Ukraine in 2025, but recent reporting in the materials provided is more focused on Kupiansk/pipeline infiltration and other Donetsk fronts than on confirmed entry into Lyman proper. That makes "any Russian-controlled area inside Lyman city" a distinct and informative crux rather than a restatement of the terminal condition.

ISW publishes a daily control-of-terrain map for Ukraine, which is already the primary resolution source for the ultimate question: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 . DeepState also publishes a frequently updated map that can serve as a fallback source if needed: https://deepstatemap.live/ . Google Maps shows Lyman and the station area referenced in the ultimate question: https://maps.app.goo.gl/zeVSXaeDH93mF2WPA .

Recent contextual reporting indicates continued Russian pressure in eastern Ukraine, including reported advances elsewhere in Donetsk and Kharkiv regions and notable infiltration tactics near Kupiansk, but not clear public confirmation in the provided materials that Russian forces have entered Lyman’s built-up area by 2025-10-22. See, for example, Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty on pipeline infiltration near Kupiansk (2025-09-18): https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-war-pipeline-kupyansk/33446420.html ; and ISW’s main Ukraine campaign outputs: https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment .

Sources:
Institute for the Study of War Ukraine map — https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
DeepStateMap — https://deepstatemap.live/
Google Maps location for Lyman station area — https://maps.app.goo.gl/zeVSXaeDH93mF2WPA
ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment — https://www.understandingwar.org/backgrounder/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment
RFE/RL on pipeline infiltration near Kupiansk — https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-ukraine-war-pipeline-kupyansk/33446420.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-22 and 2025-11-21 (inclusive), the Institute for the Study of War (ISW) Ukraine control-of-terrain map at https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 shows any area shaded as Russian-controlled (red) inside the built-up area of Lyman city.

For this market, "built-up area of Lyman city" means the contiguous urbanized area labeled "Lyman" on standard web maps, as visually identifiable on Google Maps / satellite basemap around the city label and the streets surrounding the rail station area: https://maps.app.goo.gl/zeVSXaeDH93mF2WPA . Rural fields/forest outside the city’s continuous urban footprint do not count.

Resolution procedure:
1. Check each ISW map publication dated from 2025-10-22 through 2025-11-21 inclusive.
2. If any such map shows red control shading overlapping any part of Lyman’s built-up area, resolve Yes.
3. If no such map through 2025-11-21 shows red control shading inside the built-up area, resolve No.

Fallbacks and edge cases:
- If the ISW map is permanently unavailable for part or all of the window, DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used as a fallback. On DeepState, the equivalent criterion is that any area inside Lyman’s built-up area is shown as occupied by Russian forces. If DeepState is used, the same date window of 2025-10-22 through 2025-11-21 inclusive applies.
- Temporary rendering glitches or obvious map errors do not count.
- A negotiated settlement giving Russia de facto control of any part of Lyman’s built-up area during the window counts as Yes even if map shading lags, provided actual control is established during the 2025-10-22 to 2025-11-21 window and this is confirmed by a consensus of credible reporting.
- If available sources are insufficient to determine whether Russian-controlled shading entered the built-up area during the specified window, the question should be considered unresolvable.

Primary resolution source: ISW Ukraine map — https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
Fallback source: DeepStateMap — https://deepstatemap.live/
Auxiliary location reference: Google Maps — https://maps.app.goo.gl/zeVSXaeDH93mF2WPA
subquestions.rationale: A Russian foothold anywhere in Lyman’s urban area is a strong precursor to capturing the specific railroad station by November 30, but it is not merely the same question with an earlier date. It tracks an earlier operational milestone: entering and holding part of the city. Forecasters who disagree on the station’s fate are likely to update materially based on whether Russia reaches the city proper by November 21.

question: Will BLɅϽKPIИK release an album by February 28?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Blackpink (블랙핑크, BLɅϽKPIИK) officially releases a new album by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM PT (Los Angeles time). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Officially released means that a newly released album is officially available for download or streaming (not including live events) by the resolution date.

The resolution source will be any official Blackpink streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

subquestions.question: Will YG Entertainment or BLACKPINK officially announce a specific release date for a new BLACKPINK album on or before 2026-01-07?
subquestions.background_information:
A dated official announcement is a strong near-term indicator for whether BLACKPINK will actually release an album by late February 2026, because major K-pop album releases are typically preceded by formal agency or artist announcements setting a release date and beginning preorder/promo activity. As of 2025-12-08, there is public speculation about an early-2026 BLACKPINK comeback, but no official date appears to have been confirmed. Jisoo said in an ELLE Korea interview, as reported by Soompi, that BLACKPINK’s next album is planned for 'early next year,' which supports the plausibility of a near-term release but does not itself give a specific date: https://www.soompi.com/article/1726324wpp/blackpinks-jisoo-shares-her-plans-for-winter-most-memorable-deadline-tour-moment-and-more . Additional media reports on 2025-11-29 likewise describe the comeback timing as unconfirmed and based on Jisoo’s comments rather than a formal schedule from YG Entertainment: https://www.republicworld.com/entertainment/korean/blackpink-vs-bts-in-2026-jisoos-statement-on-comeback-heats-up-discussions-about-possible-album-clash and https://www.moneycontrol.com/entertainment/blackpinks-jisoo-faces-backlash-over-comeback-comments-tied-to-bts-plans-article-13339474.html .

At the same time, one entertainment report claimed BLACKPINK were preparing a full-length album for January 2026 and that YG had said work was in final stages, but such third-party reporting is weaker than a direct official announcement and may not be reliable for resolution by itself: https://www.news18.com/movies/blackpinks-jennie-to-become-first-k-pop-artist-to-co-headline-spains-mad-cool-festival-2026-9123456.html . Because the ultimate market resolves based on an official album release on streaming/download platforms by 2026-02-28 PT, the appearance of an official dated announcement by early January would materially increase the odds of that outcome.

Sources:
Soompi - BLACKPINK's Jisoo Shares Her Plans For Winter, Most Memorable "DEADLINE" Tour Moment, And More - https://www.soompi.com/article/1726324wpp/blackpinks-jisoo-shares-her-plans-for-winter-most-memorable-deadline-tour-moment-and-more
Republic World - BLACKPINK Vs BTS In 2026? Jisoo's Statement On Comeback Heats Up Discussions About Possible Album Clash - https://www.republicworld.com/entertainment/korean/blackpink-vs-bts-in-2026-jisoos-statement-on-comeback-heats-up-discussions-about-possible-album-clash
Moneycontrol - BLACKPINK's Jisoo faces backlash over comeback comments tied to BTS plans - https://www.moneycontrol.com/entertainment/blackpinks-jisoo-faces-backlash-over-comeback-comments-tied-to-bts-plans-article-13339474.html
News18 - BLACKPINK's Jennie To Become First K-Pop Artist To Co-Headline Spain's Mad Cool Festival 2026 - https://www.news18.com/movies/blackpinks-jennie-to-become-first-k-pop-artist-to-co-headline-spains-mad-cool-festival-2026-9123456.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-12-08 and 2026-01-07 inclusive, either YG Entertainment or an official BLACKPINK account/channel publicly announces a specific calendar release date for a new BLACKPINK album.

For this question:
- 'Official BLACKPINK account/channel' includes BLACKPINK's verified social media accounts, YG Entertainment's official website/news pages, or official BLACKPINK/YG Entertainment posts on platforms such as YouTube, X, Instagram, Facebook, or Weverse.
- 'Specific calendar release date' means the announcement explicitly names a date (for example, 'January 23, 2026' or equivalent unambiguous date wording) on which a new BLACKPINK album will be released.
- 'Album' includes a single album, mini album/EP, or full-length album only if the official announcement itself describes the release as an album, mini album, EP, or full album. A mere single announcement does not count.
- Teasers that mention only 'coming soon,' 'early 2026,' or a month without a day do not count.
- Reports by media outlets alone do not count unless they directly reproduce or link to the qualifying official announcement.

Primary resolution sources: official YG Entertainment news pages and official BLACKPINK/YG channels/accounts, including:
- YG Entertainment official site: https://www.ygfamily.com/
- BLACKPINK YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@BLACKPINK
- BLACKPINK Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/blackpinkofficial/
- BLACKPINK X account: https://x.com/BLACKPINK

If an official announcement is deleted after publication, archived captures from the official source or widely cited screenshots from major reputable outlets may be used as fallback evidence, provided they clearly show the official account and posting date within the 2025-12-08 to 2026-01-07 window. If no qualifying official dated announcement is published in that window, resolve No. If source access issues make verification impossible, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A specific official release-date announcement is a meaningful operational milestone that usually precedes an actual album drop by weeks, making it a strong indicator for the ultimate question without simply restating it with an earlier deadline.

question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $110 by end of June?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day, the official CME settlement price for the Active Month (front month) of Silver (SI) futures is equal to or above the listed price by the final trading day of June 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

For CME Silver (SI) futures contracts, the Active Month is the nearest of CME's designated delivery-cycle months (March, May, July, September, December) that is not the spot month. The Active Month becomes a non-active month effective on its First Position Date, at which point the next eligible contract month becomes the Active Month.

Only the Active Month's official settlement price published by CME Group will be considered. Intraday trades, highs, lows, bids, offers, midpoint values, or indicative prices do not count.

Note that the settlement price may differ from the last traded price. CME's methodology to determine the settlement price can vary by commodity and contract.

Only days on which CME publishes an official settlement price for the Active Month will be included. Days without settlement prices (weekends, holidays, or market closures) are ignored.

This market will resolve based on the settlement price as it appears on the CME settlement page at the time it is first published for that trading day, regardless of any later corrections or updates.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website — specifically, the daily "Settlement" price for the Active Month of Silver (SI) futures.

subquestions.question: Will the official CME settlement price for the active-month Gold (GC) futures contract close at or above $4,300 per troy ounce on any trading day between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-24 (inclusive)?
subquestions.background_information:
A sharp continuation in precious-metals momentum, especially in gold, would be a meaningful near-term indicator for whether silver could plausibly surge toward an extreme target later. Gold and silver often co-move during macro-driven precious-metals rallies, though silver is typically more volatile. As of early December 2025, AP reported December 2025 gold futures settling at $4,211.80, while silver remained highly volatile and below the ultimate market's $110 threshold; this suggests a further breakout in gold to $4,300 would signal continued sector-wide bullish pressure rather than merely restating the silver target question. AP also reported substantial volatility and elevated open interest in silver, consistent with an environment where a precious-metals breakout could propagate across contracts. See AP summary in the user-provided article list and CME contract information for the underlying futures markets: CME Gold futures contract specs https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/gold.contractSpecs.html and CME Silver futures contract specs https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/silver.contractSpecs.html .

Gold at roughly $4,212 in early December 2025 means a $4,300 threshold over the next month is close enough to be informative but not so close as to be trivial. If gold does break to a fresh high above $4,300 in this short window, that would support a narrative of ongoing inflation-hedge, safe-haven, or metals-squeeze dynamics that may also increase the odds of an outsized silver move by late June 2026. Conversely, failure of gold to sustain further upside despite recent strength would be modestly bearish evidence for an extreme silver target.

Sources:
CME Gold futures contract specs — https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/gold.contractSpecs.html
CME Silver futures contract specs — https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/silver.contractSpecs.html
CME settlement pages hub — https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/settlements.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the official CME settlement price for the active-month COMEX Gold (ticker: GC) futures contract is at or above $4,300.00 per troy ounce on any trading day between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-24, inclusive. Otherwise, it resolves No.

For resolution, use CME Group's official daily settlements for Gold futures: https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/gold.settlements.html and, if necessary, the broader settlements hub at https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/settlements.html .

"Active month" should be interpreted analogously to the ultimate market's convention: the nearest CME-designated delivery-cycle month for Gold futures that is not the spot month, using the contract month identified by CME's listing and settlement publication for that trading day. Only the official settlement price published by CME for that active-month contract counts; intraday highs, last trade, bids/offers, or later-corrected values do not count unless the originally published settlement itself met the threshold.

Only trading days for which CME publishes an official settlement are considered. Weekends, exchange holidays, or closure days with no official settlement are ignored. If CME materially ceases publication of the named page, the resolver should use archived CME settlement data or another official CME page containing the same settlement figures. If no authoritative CME settlement data for the relevant window can be obtained, the question should be treated as unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: This is a different observable from the ultimate question and captures whether the broader precious-metals complex is extending its breakout. A decisive gold move above $4,300 in the next month would be strong evidence of continued macro tailwinds and speculative momentum that could spill over into silver, raising the probability of an eventual $110 silver print by late June 2026.

question: Transgender women be banned from the Olympics before Winter Games?
description:
The next Olympics are scheduled to be held in Milan–Cortina from February 6 to 22, 2026. Recent reporting indicates the IOC is considering a ban on transgender women competing in the female category. You can read more about that here: https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2025/nov/10/ioc-edges-closer-to-ban-on-transgender-women-in-female-olympic-events.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the International Olympic Committee (IOC) officially bans transgender women from competing in the female category by February 5, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying ban must affect at least one sport and apply to at least one clearly defined group, for example, transgender women who have undergone male puberty, individuals subject to specified testosterone-threshold policies, or athletes with differences of sexual development (DSD).

An official declaration of a qualifying ban within the specified timeframe will suffice, regardless of whether it is later revoked. 

Only IOC-imposed bans will qualify; bans or eligibility rules issued by other authorities, such as International Federations or National Olympic Committees, will not qualify. 

The primary resolution source for this market will be official IOC communications; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the IOC publicly release, between 2026-01-13 and 2026-02-03, a draft, consultation paper, working-group summary, or other official policy document proposing new Olympic-wide eligibility rules for the female category that explicitly address transgender women or athletes with differences of sexual development (DSD)?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question is whether the IOC will officially ban transgender women from the female category before the Milan–Cortina Winter Games. A strong leading indicator is whether the IOC moves from general public statements to publishing an official document that sets out proposed Olympic-wide eligibility rules. In December 2025, AP reported that IOC President Kirsty Coventry set an early-2026 target for a new policy on eligibility in female sports and said the IOC was seeking a unified approach rather than leaving the issue entirely to international federations (AP summary provided in prompt). The Irish Independent likewise reported that the IOC working group had been examining how to protect the female category and that a decision might come around the IOC session in early February 2026 (summary provided in prompt). This suggests that an official paper or draft would be a meaningful intermediate step toward any eventual IOC ban.

The IOC has previously relied on framework-style guidance rather than a blanket centralized rule. The IOC's 2021 'Framework on Fairness, Inclusion and Non-Discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity and Sex Variations' is the current baseline public document and does not itself impose a categorical Olympic-wide ban. See IOC framework materials at https://olympics.com/ioc/human-rights/fairness-inclusion-nondiscrimination and IOC PDF materials linked from that page. A newly published draft or consultation document explicitly proposing stricter female-category eligibility rules would therefore indicate that the IOC is operationalizing the policy shift discussed in late 2025 reporting.

Because the time window is short, a public document release is a better subquestion than asking whether the final ban itself occurs. It is observable, binary, and likely to meaningfully update beliefs about the ultimate question: if the IOC publishes an official proposal spelling out exclusionary criteria for the female category before February 3, the odds of a final IOC-imposed ban before the Games would likely rise.

Sources:
IOC - Fairness, Inclusion and Non-discrimination on the Basis of Gender Identity and Sex Variations: https://olympics.com/ioc/human-rights/fairness-inclusion-nondiscrimination
The Guardian report referenced by the ultimate question: https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2025/nov/10/ioc-edges-closer-to-ban-on-transgender-women-in-female-olympic-events
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-13 and 2026-02-03 inclusive, the IOC publicly posts or formally distributes an official document that is accessible on an IOC-controlled website or official IOC communication channel and that proposes, summarizes, or consults on new Olympic-wide eligibility rules for the female category explicitly addressing transgender women and/or athletes with differences of sexual development (DSD).

Qualifying documents include, for example: a draft policy, consultation paper, working-group report/summary, executive board paper summary, or official press release linking to such a document. Mere verbal remarks, media interviews, or news reports describing internal discussions do not qualify unless the IOC itself publishes the underlying document or a formal written summary.

The document must do more than restate the existence of a review; it must describe proposed substantive eligibility criteria, principles, or options for the female category. A document qualifies even if it does not finalize the rules.

Primary resolution sources: IOC official website, IOC news releases, and IOC human-rights/policy pages, including https://olympics.com/ioc and https://olympics.com/ioc/news and https://olympics.com/ioc/human-rights/fairness-inclusion-nondiscrimination. Archived copies from the IOC website are acceptable if the page is later moved. If IOC web publication status is disputed, official IOC social-media posts linking to the document or an IOC PDF hosted on an IOC domain also count.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying IOC-published document is publicly released between 2026-01-13 and 2026-02-03 inclusive.

If the IOC announces that a document exists but does not make it public within the resolution window, that does not count. If publication timing cannot be determined from the IOC page itself, the earliest timestamp from the IOC page, IOC press release, or a reliable web archive snapshot of the IOC page will be used. If no authoritative timing can be established, the question should resolve based on the best available evidence from IOC-controlled channels; if still genuinely indeterminate, it should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A public IOC policy document is a concrete precursor event that would strongly signal institutional momentum toward an IOC-imposed ban, while still being distinct from the ultimate question of whether a ban is officially adopted.

question: Will Obama endorse Mamdani?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Barack Obama announces that he will vote for Zohran Mamdani or endorses Mamdani for the 2025 NYC Mayor election between June 25, and November 3, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

If Barack Obama announces that he will vote for another candidate or endorses another candidate for NYC Mayor, this market will immediately resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Barack Obama or one of his representatives, or a consensus of credible reporting of Obama's endorsement.

subquestions.question: Will either Chuck Schumer or Hakeem Jeffries publicly endorse Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
A useful indicator for whether Barack Obama will endorse Zohran Mamdani before the November 4, 2025 election is whether other top national Democratic establishment figures who have so far withheld endorsement decide to back him in October. As of mid-September 2025, Governor Kathy Hochul had endorsed Mamdani, but reporting indicated that Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer and House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries still had not endorsed him. The Daily News reported on 2025-09-15 that Hochul's endorsement was followed by pressure on other New York Democrats, including Schumer and Jeffries, who had yet to endorse Mamdani: https://www.nydailynews.com/2025/09/15/mamdani-hochul-endorsement/ . News 12 reported on 2025-09-23 that former Vice President Kamala Harris endorsed Mamdani, while noting that Jeffries and Schumer had not yet indicated whether they would back him before the general election: https://bronx.news12.com/former-vice-president-kamala-harris-endorses-zohran-mamdani-for-nyc-mayor .

Earlier reporting also suggested that Obama had at least engaged with Mamdani: WKRC reported on 2025-08-15 that Obama had spoken with Mamdani by phone in June, boosting hopes for an endorsement, but that no endorsement had been announced: https://local12.com/news/nation-world/obama-call-boosts-hopes-in-zohran-mamdanis-mayoral-bid-but-endorsement-remains-uncertain . The New Republic likewise wrote on 2025-08-20 that major Democratic establishment figures, including Obama, had not publicly announced support for Mamdani: https://newrepublic.com/article/198800/democratic-establishment-shunning-mamdani-disqualifying .

If Schumer or Jeffries endorses in October, that would be evidence that elite Democratic resistance is breaking down, making an Obama endorsement more plausible. Conversely, if both continue to withhold endorsement through late October, that would suggest continued reluctance among high-profile establishment Democrats, which is evidence against an Obama endorsement.

Sources:
Daily News - Mamdani declines to immediately back Hochul's reelection after she offers him coveted endorsement - https://www.nydailynews.com/2025/09/15/mamdani-hochul-endorsement/
News 12 The Bronx - Former Vice President Kamala Harris endorses Zohran Mamdani for NYC mayor - https://bronx.news12.com/former-vice-president-kamala-harris-endorses-zohran-mamdani-for-nyc-mayor
WKRC / Local 12 - Obama call boosts hopes in Zohran Mamdani's mayoral bid but endorsement remains uncertain - https://local12.com/news/nation-world/obama-call-boosts-hopes-in-zohran-mamdanis-mayoral-bid-but-endorsement-remains-uncertain
The New Republic - The Democratic Establishment's Shunning of Mamdani Is Disqualifying - https://newrepublic.com/article/198800/democratic-establishment-shunning-mamdani-disqualifying
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), either Chuck Schumer or Hakeem Jeffries makes a public statement that clearly endorses, backs, or says they will vote for Zohran Mamdani in the 2025 New York City mayoral election.

Qualifying endorsements include, for example: an endorsement statement on the politician's official website, official X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube account; a campaign press release; or a direct on-the-record statement reported by multiple credible news outlets. Statements such as "I endorse Zohran Mamdani," "I'm supporting/voting for Mamdani," or equivalent unambiguous language count.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying endorsement by either Schumer or Jeffries occurs between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive).

Non-qualifying statements include: praise without endorsement, statements that Mamdani is the Democratic nominee without expressing support, statements about willingness to work with him if elected, or ambiguous comments that do not clearly communicate electoral support.

Primary resolution sources will be the official public communications of Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries, including https://www.schumer.senate.gov/ , https://x.com/SenSchumer , https://jeffries.house.gov/ , and https://x.com/RepJeffries . Secondary sources, if needed, will be credible reporting from outlets such as the Associated Press (https://apnews.com/), The New York Times (https://www.nytimes.com/), Politico (https://www.politico.com/), and Gothamist (https://gothamist.com/).

If a statement is made within the window but only becomes widely reported afterward, it still counts so long as the underlying endorsement can be verified as having occurred between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive). If no reliable evidence establishes the timing or content of the statement, the question should resolve based on the best available authoritative evidence; if timing cannot be determined at all, the question is unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Obama's decision is likely correlated with whether other senior establishment Democrats who have been hesitant—especially Schumer and Jeffries—decide that endorsing Mamdani is politically acceptable. Their endorsement would be a meaningful signal that elite Democratic opinion has shifted in Mamdani's favor, increasing the odds of an Obama endorsement.

question: EU/NATO country announces peacekeeping force in Ukraine in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any NATO or EU member country officially announces that they will be sending troops to Ukraine as part of a peacekeeping force by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to “No”.

A qualifying announcement must be part of a formal agreement between a NATO or EU member country and another country or international organization or otherwise indicative of a formalized policy.

Announcements which are statements of intent, contingent, or otherwise are not indicative of a formalized policy will not count

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from NATO, the EU, or member states of either entity, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the United Kingdom and France jointly publish an official plan document or joint statement by 2025-10-01 that specifies at least three operational details for a post-war multinational force in Ukraine?
subquestions.background_information:
The UK and France have been the core public champions of a possible European or "Coalition of the Willing" force for Ukraine, making movement from vague political support to concrete operational planning a key early indicator for whether any NATO/EU country is likely to formally announce troop participation by the end of 2025. Recent reporting says UK and French troops are expected to form the core of any contingent, while many other European states remain hesitant or opposed. EurActiv reported on 2025-08-28 that allies were preparing to outline a proposed "reassurance force" soon, but that the coalition had not yet agreed on the force's size, composition, or operational details; countries publicly considering deployment included France and the UK, while Poland ruled out sending troops and others preferred logistics or support roles: https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/whos-in-and-whos-out-of-ukraines-reassurance-force/ 

Politico reporting summarized by Ukrainska Pravda on 2025-08-29 said European leaders were discussing a 40-km buffer zone and debated force requirements ranging from 4,000 to 60,000 personnel, but that no country had committed. It also said French and UK troops were expected to form the core of the contingent: https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/08/29/7520828/ 

The Financial Times reporting summarized by the Kyiv Independent on 2025-08-26 said the US might provide ISR, command-and-control, and air-defense support to a European-led post-war force, but these commitments were still described as "pre-decisional" and dependent on European troop commitments: https://kyivindependent.com/us-may-provide-intelligence-air-defense-assets-to-european-peacekeepers-in-ukraine-ft-reports/ 

Back in March, Starmer said British military chiefs would go to Ukraine to draw up operational plans for a future ceasefire enforcement arrangement, indicating that planning work was already underway even though no formal deployment announcement had yet been made: https://news.yahoo.com/starmer-send-military-chiefs-ukraine-143837087.html 

Because the ultimate question requires an official, formalized announcement by a NATO or EU country, an official UK-France planning document that moves beyond rhetoric into operational specifics would be strong evidence that the coalition is nearing the kind of formal policy needed for a qualifying announcement.

Sources:
EurActiv - Who's in and who's out of Ukraine's 'reassurance force' - https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/whos-in-and-whos-out-of-ukraines-reassurance-force/
Ukrainska Pravda summary of Politico reporting - https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2025/08/29/7520828/
Kyiv Independent summary of FT reporting - https://kyivindependent.com/us-may-provide-intelligence-air-defense-assets-to-european-peacekeepers-in-ukraine-ft-reports/
Yahoo News - Starmer to send military chiefs to Ukraine to draw up ceasefire - https://news.yahoo.com/starmer-send-military-chiefs-ukraine-143837087.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 inclusive, the governments of both the United Kingdom and France jointly publish or jointly endorse an official document, communiqué, or statement that explicitly lays out at least three distinct operational details for a post-war multinational force in Ukraine.

For this question, qualifying operational details must be concrete and specific, and must include at least three of the following categories in the same jointly issued or jointly endorsed official release: (1) estimated troop numbers or unit scale; (2) deployment geography or mission locations inside Ukraine; (3) command structure or lead headquarters; (4) mission tasks/rules such as monitoring a ceasefire, training, air defense, logistics, or buffer-zone patrols; (5) participation framework naming contributing states or categories of contributors; (6) external support arrangements such as US ISR, air defense, or command-and-control support.

The publication must appear on an official UK government site, official French government/presidency site, or in an official jointly released communiqué. Examples of qualifying source domains include https://www.gov.uk/, https://www.pm.gov.uk/, https://www.elysee.fr/, https://www.gouvernement.fr/, or an official joint communiqué hosted by NATO/EU/member-state institutions.

It resolves No if no such jointly published or jointly endorsed official plan document or statement appears between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 inclusive.

Purely generic statements of support, statements that merely say planning is ongoing, or media leaks without an official public document do not count. Separate unilateral statements by the UK and France do not count unless one of them explicitly publishes a joint statement attributable to both governments.

Primary resolution sources: official UK and French government websites, including https://www.gov.uk/ and https://www.elysee.fr/ . Secondary confirmation may come from NATO or EU official sites if they host the same joint statement: https://www.nato.int/ and https://european-union.europa.eu/ . If official pages are temporarily unavailable, archived official pages or contemporaneous reporting quoting the full official text may be used as fallback, but only if the existence of the joint official release is clear.
subquestions.rationale: A formal troop announcement by an EU/NATO country is much more plausible if the UK-France-led effort advances from press speculation to an official operational blueprint. This subquestion captures a distinct upstream milestone: whether the coalition's leading sponsors can concretize the mission enough to specify how it would work. If this happens quickly, it would materially increase the odds of later formal troop announcements; if it does not, that is evidence the broader peacekeeping proposal remains too vague or politically fragile.

question: Will another MrBeast video get 100m+ week 1 views by November 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any YouTube video posted by MrBeast gets over 100 million views in the first 7 days after being posted between September 25 and November 30, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If MrBeast does not post a YouTube video by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

Videos posted within the final 7 days of this market's resolution date will qualify, and this market will remain open to allow for the full 7 days to be completed.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast's YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast), specifically the 'views' counter for the described video.

Note: This market refers to MrBeast’s posted YouTube videos. Shorts, previews, or other videos released other than the referenced videos will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will MrBeast publish at least one new long-form video on his main YouTube channel between 2025-09-27 and 2025-10-27 (inclusive)?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate market depends on whether any MrBeast upload in the late-2025 window can reach 100 million views in its first 7 days. A key leading indicator is simply whether MrBeast is actively releasing new long-form videos on the main channel in the near term, since no qualifying 100m-week-1 hit is possible without an upload cadence that includes eligible videos. MrBeast's main channel is currently the largest creator channel on YouTube, with roughly 435-437 million subscribers as of mid-to-late September 2025 according to Tubefilter and PR Week, indicating a very large base from which a blockbuster upload could emerge. https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/09/15/top-50-most-subscribed-youtube-channels-worldwide-week-of-09-14-2025/ ; https://www.prweek.com/article/1912360/flag-football-tswift-balance-creator-cookouts-nfls-influencer-play-card

Recent reporting also suggests MrBeast is heavily involved in large collaborations and stunts, including an August 2025 creator-collab effort and September 2025 NFL-related content, which may support additional major uploads soon. https://gamerant.com/mrbeast-record-breaking-content-creator-collab/ ; https://www.prweek.com/article/1912360/flag-football-tswift-balance-creator-cookouts-nfls-influencer-play-card

At the same time, coverage indicates that Shorts now account for a larger share of total views than MrBeast's long-form uploads, which makes it especially informative to track whether he continues posting qualifying long-form videos rather than shifting attention toward Shorts. The Daily Dot reported that MrBeast Shorts had 47.3 billion views versus 46.6 billion for longer videos as of August 22, 2025. https://www.dailydot.com/culture/mrbeast-youtube-shorts-more-views-than-videos/

Because the ultimate market excludes Shorts, previews, and other non-qualifying formats, a near-term binary question about whether a new long-form main-channel upload appears is a useful crux: if no such upload occurs by late October, the path to a 100m-first-week hit by November 30 becomes materially narrower.

Sources:
Tubefilter - Top 50 Most Subscribed YouTube Channels Worldwide * Week Of 09/14/2025 - https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/09/15/top-50-most-subscribed-youtube-channels-worldwide-week-of-09-14-2025/
PR Week - Flag football, the TSwift balance and creator cookouts: The NFL's influencer play card - https://www.prweek.com/article/1912360/flag-football-tswift-balance-creator-cookouts-nfls-influencer-play-card
The Daily Dot - MrBeast's YouTube shorts now have more views than his videos -- here's why it matters - https://www.dailydot.com/culture/mrbeast-youtube-shorts-more-views-than-videos/
Game Rant - YouTube Star MrBeast Teases Record-Breaking Content Creator Collab - https://gamerant.com/mrbeast-record-breaking-content-creator-collab/
MrBeast YouTube channel - https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if MrBeast's main YouTube channel publishes at least one new long-form video between 2025-09-27 and 2025-10-27, inclusive. It resolves No if no such video is published during that window.

For resolution, the primary source is the Videos tab of MrBeast's official main YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos

A 'new long-form video' counts only if all of the following are true:
1. It appears as a new upload on the official @MrBeast main channel during the window from 2025-09-27 through 2025-10-27 inclusive.
2. It is a standard video on the Videos tab, not a Short on the Shorts tab.
3. Its listed runtime is at least 1 minute and 1 second.
4. It is publicly visible on the channel at some point before resolution.

Items explicitly not counted: Shorts, livestreams, premieres that are scheduled but never actually published within the window, trailers/previews posted only as Shorts, reposts of older videos, uploads on other channels, and deleted/private videos unless YouTube's public interface or an archived capture clearly shows they were newly published on the main channel within the window.

If YouTube's interface is ambiguous, archived snapshots from the Internet Archive or a reputable YouTube analytics mirror such as Social Blade may be used as fallback evidence to confirm whether a qualifying upload appeared during the window: https://web.archive.org/ ; https://socialblade.com/youtube/c/mrbeast

If no reliable public evidence is available to determine whether a qualifying upload occurred in the stated window, the question should be considered unresolvable.

Sources for resolution:
MrBeast official Videos tab - https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos
Internet Archive Wayback Machine - https://web.archive.org/
Social Blade MrBeast page - https://socialblade.com/youtube/c/mrbeast
subquestions.rationale: This is a different observable event from the ultimate question and a strong precursor to it: a 100m-in-7-days hit requires a qualifying upload to exist at all. Near-term evidence that MrBeast is releasing eligible long-form videos on the main channel updates the likelihood that one of his late-2025 uploads could cross the 100 million first-week threshold.

question: U.S. agrees to a new trade deal with "Argentina"?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if a free trade agreement with the specified country or entity becomes law in the United States between July 25, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Th Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This includes both agreements that become law through Senate ratification and Presidential approval, or through the enactment of a Congressional-Executive Agreement signed into law by the President.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) or the White House publicly announce between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 that the United States and Argentina have launched formal negotiations toward a bilateral trade agreement or free trade agreement?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term bottleneck for any U.S. free trade agreement becoming law by the end of 2025 is whether the U.S. and the partner country have moved from general diplomatic contact to an explicit, formal trade-negotiation process. The ultimate question asks whether a U.S.-Argentina free trade agreement becomes law by December 31, 2025, which is a very short timeline. As of 2025-10-31, there is evidence of unusually warm U.S.-Argentina economic relations, including a reported October 2025 U.S. Treasury currency-support action for Argentina and high-level engagement with President Javier Milei, but that is not the same as a formal trade-negotiation launch. AS/COA reported on October 29, 2025 that on October 9 the U.S. Treasury announced a $20 billion currency swap with Argentina and that a Trump-Milei meeting had been scheduled for October 14, indicating elevated bilateral economic attention: https://www.as-coa.org/articles/tracking-trump-and-latin-america-trade-us-senate-votes-against-brazil-tariffs

At the same time, the broader regional context suggests the Americas are in an active trade-realignment period. Mercosur, which includes Argentina, has recently concluded an FTA with EFTA states, according to BNN Bloomberg on September 16, 2025: https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/international/2025/09/16/south-americas-mercosur-bloc-signs-trade-deal-with-four-european-countries/ . The EU is also pushing forward with its Mercosur agreement, with multiple reports in September-October 2025 describing ratification momentum: Reuters via Yahoo on September 8, 2025 https://www.yahoo.com/news/commission-launches-mercosur-deal-ratification-155116458.html ; POLITICO on September 30, 2025 https://www.politico.eu/article/brussels-sign-mercosur-trade-deal-dec-5/ . Those developments raise the salience of Argentina trade policy generally, but they do not by themselves establish a U.S.-Argentina FTA track.

Because a trade deal becoming U.S. law usually requires prior negotiation, text development, and some public executive-branch signaling, a formal U.S. announcement that negotiations with Argentina have begun would be a meaningful early indicator for the ultimate question. Conversely, if no such announcement occurs by late November, that would weigh against enough process being completed for enactment by year-end.

Sources:
AS/COA, Tracking Trump and Latin America: Trade -- U.S. Senate Votes Against Brazil Tariffs — https://www.as-coa.org/articles/tracking-trump-and-latin-america-trade-us-senate-votes-against-brazil-tariffs
BNN Bloomberg, South America’s Mercosur bloc signs trade deal with four European countries — https://www.bnnbloomberg.ca/business/international/2025/09/16/south-americas-mercosur-bloc-signs-trade-deal-with-four-european-countries/
Yahoo/Reuters, Commission launches Mercosur deal ratification amid political tensions in France — https://www.yahoo.com/news/commission-launches-mercosur-deal-ratification-155116458.html
POLITICO, Brussels aims to sign Mercosur trade deal on Dec. 5 — https://www.politico.eu/article/brussels-sign-mercosur-trade-deal-dec-5/
USTR official site — https://ustr.gov/
The White House official site — https://www.whitehouse.gov/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive), either (a) the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) or (b) the White House publicly states on an official website that the United States and Argentina have launched, initiated, opened, or begun formal negotiations toward a bilateral trade agreement or free trade agreement.

Qualifying announcements must be on an official U.S. government website, including but not limited to https://ustr.gov/ or https://www.whitehouse.gov/ . A qualifying statement must explicitly connect the U.S. and Argentina and describe the start of negotiations for a trade agreement/FTA; vague statements about "economic cooperation," "trade talks," "exploring options," or "working toward closer trade ties" do not count unless they clearly say negotiations have begun for a trade agreement.

This question also resolves Yes if an official U.S. government readout published in the window states that the parties have agreed to launch formal trade agreement negotiations, even if the announcement is in a joint statement.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying official announcement is published between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive).

Primary resolution sources: USTR press releases/statements at https://ustr.gov/about-us/policy-offices/press-office/press-releases and White House briefings/statements at https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/ .

Secondary/fallback sources, only to confirm an ambiguous official posting or if site structure changes, are archived versions of the same official pages via the Internet Archive (https://web.archive.org/) and consensus reporting from major outlets quoting the official announcement. If no official announcement can be verified from primary or archived official sources, resolve No.

If purported negotiations are announced before 2025-10-31 or after 2025-11-30, they do not count. If a planned launch is announced during the window but the actual launch is explicitly scheduled for after 2025-11-30, this question resolves No.
subquestions.rationale: A formal launch of U.S.-Argentina trade negotiations is a distinct observable step that would materially increase the odds of a deal becoming law soon after. It is not the same as the ultimate question, but it is a strong process indicator: if forecasters disagree about whether a U.S.-Argentina trade deal will become law by year-end, they are likely to update significantly on whether formal negotiations are publicly launched in November.
