question: Ahmed al-Sharaa out as leader of Syria in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Ahmed al-Sharaa, the President of Syria, is removed from power for any length of time between July 15,, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Al-Sharaa will be considered to be removed from power if he resigns, is detained, is officially dismissed, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as leader of Syria within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Ahmed al-Sharaa fail to deliver a speech in person during the UN General Assembly high-level week between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01?
subquestions.background_information:
Ahmed al-Sharaa is reportedly scheduled to attend the UN General Assembly in New York in September 2025 and deliver a speech, which would be a major signal of international recognition and regime stability. AFP, via Firstpost, reported on 2025-08-25 that a Syrian foreign ministry official said al-Sharaa would take part in the UN General Assembly high-level week scheduled for 22-30 September 2025, making him the first Syrian president to do so in decades. The same report noted that al-Sharaa remains under UN sanctions and a travel ban, meaning his trip requires an exemption and diplomatic coordination, creating a concrete, near-term test of both international acceptance and his ability to function as Syria's leader abroad. https://www.firstpost.com/world/al-sharaa-to-speak-at-unga-next-month-first-syrian-leader-to-do-so-in-decades-13948973.html

A separate 2025-08-07 report said the United States was pushing to remove al-Sharaa and Interior Minister Anas Khattab from the UN Security Council terrorism sanctions list, partly because al-Sharaa was expected to speak at UNGA. The report also said China and Russia had raised concerns, implying that diplomatic friction could still derail the appearance. https://www.intellinews.com/us-pushes-to-remove-syrian-officials-from-un-terrorism-sanctions-list-395111/

Domestically, al-Sharaa has recently been trying to reinforce his political footing. Asharq Al-Awsat reported on 2025-08-31 that he toured Homs, Hama, and Idlib to reinforce grassroots support after July violence in Sweida and amid unrest over autonomy demands. The article described Hama as a central pillar of his authority and said the tour was meant to rally public resolve ahead of parliamentary elections and the UNGA trip. If he cannot make or complete the UN visit, that would be a meaningful indicator of weakness, isolation, or acute instability that could raise the probability he is removed from power later in 2025. https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5162855-al-sharaa%E2%80%99s-provincial-tour-reinforces-popular-support-his-rule-syria

Sources:
Firstpost - Al-Sharaa to speak at UNGA next month, first Syrian leader to do so in decades - https://www.firstpost.com/world/al-sharaa-to-speak-at-unga-next-month-first-syrian-leader-to-do-so-in-decades-13948973.html
bne IntelliNews - US pushes to remove Syrian officials from UN terrorism sanctions list - https://www.intellinews.com/us-pushes-to-remove-syrian-officials-from-un-terrorism-sanctions-list-395111/
Asharq Al-Awsat - Al-Sharaa’s Provincial Tour Reinforces Popular Support for His Rule in Syria - https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5162855-al-sharaa%E2%80%99s-provincial-tour-reinforces-popular-support-his-rule-syria
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), Ahmed al-Sharaa does not deliver a speech in person during the UN General Assembly high-level week in New York, scheduled for 2025-09-22 through 2025-09-30, after having been publicly expected to do so.

This question resolves No if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive), credible reporting and/or official UN video, transcript, schedule, or meeting records show that Ahmed al-Sharaa personally delivered a speech in person at the UN General Assembly high-level week in New York.

For avoidance of doubt:
- "In person" means physically present and speaking at the UN venue in New York. A prerecorded video, remote address, written statement, or speech delivered by another Syrian official does not count.
- If al-Sharaa attends the UN but speaks only in another forum outside the General Assembly high-level week, that does not count as delivering the relevant speech.
- If the UNGA session is postponed beyond 2025-10-01, or if authoritative evidence remains insufficient to determine whether he spoke in person, the question should be considered unresolvable.

Primary resolution sources: official UN General Assembly programme pages, UN Web TV archives, UN meeting coverage, and consensus of credible reporting from Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, or similar outlets.

Proposed sources for resolution:
UN General Assembly main site: https://www.un.org/en/ga/
UN Web TV: https://media.un.org/en/webtv
UN Meetings Coverage and Press Releases: https://press.un.org/en
Reuters world news: https://www.reuters.com/world/
Associated Press world news: https://apnews.com/hub/world-news
BBC News world: https://www.bbc.com/news/world
subquestions.rationale: Al-Sharaa's ability to appear at UNGA is a near-term, observable test of regime stability, international legitimacy, and his freedom of action. Failure to make the trip or speak in person would be evidence of diplomatic blockage, security concerns, internal instability, or loss of authority, all of which would increase the chance he is removed from power before the end of 2025.

question: Will Venezuela invade Guyana in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Venezuela commences a military offensive intended to establish control over any portion of Guyana between January 29 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be will be official confirmation by Venezuela, Guyana, the United Nations, or any permanent member of the UN Security Council, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Guyana or the Guyana Defence Force publicly report at least one new armed cross-border incident attributed to Venezuelan forces or actors firing from Venezuelan territory into Guyana between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
A fresh armed border incident would be a meaningful near-term indicator for the risk of a Venezuelan invasion of Guyana in late 2025, because it would suggest continued escalation from coercive pressure or probing actions toward overt military confrontation. Tensions are already elevated. On 2025-08-31, Guyana's military reported that a Joint Services patrol escorting election officials near the Upper Cuyuni River was fired upon from the Venezuelan side; no injuries were reported, but the incident showed that live-fire contact across the border had already occurred shortly before this forecasting window. See BNO News: https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/guyana-says-patrol-came-under-fire-from-venezuela-no-injuries-reported/ and a similar account from Bahamas Spectator: https://www.bahamasspectator.com/2025/08/31/guyana-votes-amid-border-tensions-with-venezuela/

Guyana's government has also said Venezuela has engaged in a pattern of 'illegal and aggressive actions' aimed at annexing Essequibo, including unlawful bridge construction, unauthorized overflights, and plans to hold Venezuelan elections for the disputed area despite ICJ measures ordering Venezuela not to alter the status quo. See Newsroom Guyana, 2025-05-25: https://newsroom.gy/2025/05/25/guyana-on-high-alert-as-venezuela-threatens-international-peace-and-order/

Venezuelan rhetoric has also intensified. On 2025-09-15, Venezuelan Defense Minister Vladimir Padrino López warned Guyana and Trinidad and Tobago that if the U.S. attacked Venezuela from their territory, they would 'also receive a response,' framing this as 'legitimate defense.' See Latin Times: https://www.latintimes.com/venezuela-warns-neighbors-retaliation-over-support-us-military-operations-well-act-legitimate-583000

This subquestion is not a restatement of invasion. A reported armed cross-border firing incident is a lower-level, more observable escalation marker that would update forecasts about whether Venezuela is willing to use force against Guyana in the near term.

Sources:
BNO News - Guyana says patrol came under fire from Venezuela; no injuries reported - https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/guyana-says-patrol-came-under-fire-from-venezuela-no-injuries-reported/
Bahamas Spectator - Guyana Votes Amid Border Tensions With Venezuela - https://www.bahamasspectator.com/2025/08/31/guyana-votes-amid-border-tensions-with-venezuela/
Newsroom Guyana - Guyana on high alert as Venezuela threatens international peace and order - https://newsroom.gy/2025/05/25/guyana-on-high-alert-as-venezuela-threatens-international-peace-and-order/
Latin Times - Venezuela Warns Neighbors of Retaliation Over Support for U.S. Military Operations - https://www.latintimes.com/venezuela-warns-neighbors-retaliation-over-support-us-military-operations-well-act-legitimate-583000
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, either (a) the Government of Guyana, the Guyana Defence Force (GDF), or the Guyana Police Force publicly states that there was at least one armed incident in which shots were fired from Venezuelan territory, Venezuelan waters, or by Venezuelan uniformed personnel / armed actors crossing from Venezuela into Guyana, and attributes the incident to Venezuelan forces or actors; or (b) at least two independent, credible news outlets report such an incident and cite Guyanese official sources.

This question resolves No if no such publicly reported incident occurs in that window.

For avoidance of doubt, the qualifying event is a new armed cross-border incident during the window, not merely commentary about earlier incidents. General political threats, troop movements without reported firing, or vague allegations without attribution do not count. Incidents occurring before 2025-10-01 or after 2025-10-31 do not count.

Primary resolution sources: official statements/pages of the Government of Guyana, Department of Public Information Guyana, and the Guyana Defence Force if available, plus official social media/accounts if they are the government's standard publication channel. Relevant sites include https://dpi.gov.gy/ and https://www.facebook.com/guyanadefenceforce/ .

Secondary sources if primary official publication is unavailable or ambiguous: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/ , AP https://apnews.com/ , BBC https://www.bbc.com/news , or other major credible outlets reporting and clearly attributing the incident to Guyanese official statements.

If an alleged incident is reported during the window but later explicitly retracted by the originating Guyanese authority before 2025-10-31, it will not count. If the only available information by resolution time is too ambiguous to determine whether shots were actually fired during the 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-31 window, the question should resolve No rather than infer an event. If a major source archive outage prevents verification, fall back to archived copies or secondary reporting that quotes the original official statement.

Relevant source URLs for resolution:
Department of Public Information, Guyana: https://dpi.gov.gy/
Guyana Defence Force Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/guyanadefenceforce/
Reuters world news: https://www.reuters.com/world/
AP News world: https://apnews.com/world-news
BBC News world: https://www.bbc.com/news/world
subquestions.rationale: A new armed border-fire incident would be a concrete sign that the dispute is escalating operationally, not just rhetorically. Such incidents can function as precursors to broader military action, making this a useful crux for the invasion question.

question: Will Samsung release a trifold phone by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Samsung releases a phone with three foldable screens by the listed date (ET). Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

In order to be considered released, the product must be available for purchase by the general public within the specified timeframe. An announcement or unveiling alone is not sufficient.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from Samsung. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Samsung publish an official product page or newsroom post between 2025-11-12 and 2025-12-09 that states its trifold phone will be sold in at least one market in 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
Samsung has already moved beyond rumor stage: the company officially showed a trifold handset at a public technology showcase in late October 2025, and credible reporting after the APEC showcase said Samsung told media it planned to bring the device to users "within this year." This makes a near-term official commercialization statement a strong indicator for whether a public release will occur by the end of the ultimate market window. See TechRadar's report on Samsung officially displaying the device at the K-Tech Showcase: https://www.techradar.com/phones/samsung-galaxy-phones/the-samsung-galaxy-tri-fold-just-got-officially-shown-off . Forbes also reported that Samsung said in an official statement to SamMobile that it planned to bring the device to users "within this year": https://www.forbes.com/sites/ewanspence/2025/11/01/samsung-galaxy-trifold-folding-phone-release-date-coming-soon/ .

Samsung's official newsroom and product sites are typically where the company posts launch announcements, availability details, and market-by-market sales timing for flagship devices. If Samsung itself publishes a dated statement before 2025-12-09 saying the trifold will go on sale in 2025 in at least one named market, that would be a strong leading indicator that an actual public release by the ultimate deadline is likely. Conversely, if no such official commercialization statement appears by then, the probability of a true public release by the deadline is lower.

Official Samsung sources that would plausibly carry such a statement include Samsung Global Newsroom and Samsung Electronics product/news pages: https://news.samsung.com/global and https://www.samsung.com/global/galaxy/ .

Sources:
TechRadar - The Samsung Galaxy tri-fold just got officially shown off — https://www.techradar.com/phones/samsung-galaxy-phones/the-samsung-galaxy-tri-fold-just-got-officially-shown-off
Forbes - Samsung Finally Unveils Galaxy TriFold And Confirms Release Date Coming Soon — https://www.forbes.com/sites/ewanspence/2025/11/01/samsung-galaxy-trifold-folding-phone-release-date-coming-soon/
Samsung Global Newsroom — https://news.samsung.com/global
Samsung Galaxy site — https://www.samsung.com/global/galaxy/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-12 and 2025-12-09 inclusive, Samsung publishes on an official Samsung-owned website a product page, newsroom post, press release, or official event recap that explicitly states that Samsung's trifold phone (a phone with two hinges / three panels, regardless of final product name) will be sold, available for purchase, or launched in at least one market during calendar year 2025.

The qualifying statement must appear on an official Samsung domain, such as Samsung Global Newsroom (https://news.samsung.com/global), a regional Samsung Newsroom site, Samsung.com product pages, or another clearly official Samsung web property. The statement must be public and accessible on the web during or after the window.

Examples that count:
- "Available in Korea starting December 2025"
- "On sale this year in China"
- "Launching in select markets in 2025"

Examples that do NOT count:
- Mere display/showcase/unveiling language with no sales timing
- Third-party media reports quoting unnamed sources
- Statements that only say "coming soon" or "within this year" unless they are newly published by Samsung within the 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-09 window and clearly refer to market availability for sale in 2025
- Developer-facing references with no consumer sales commitment

Primary sources for resolution will be official Samsung sites, especially:
- Samsung Global Newsroom: https://news.samsung.com/global
- Samsung global Galaxy pages: https://www.samsung.com/global/galaxy/
- Samsung Electronics main site: https://www.samsung.com/

If no qualifying official Samsung statement is published between 2025-11-12 and 2025-12-09 inclusive, resolve No.

If Samsung publishes ambiguous language and no reasonable determination can be made about whether it commits to 2025 sales availability, resolve No unless a later official clarification within the same 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-09 window removes the ambiguity.

If Samsung's official sites are unavailable or archived incompletely, archived copies (for example via the Internet Archive) and contemporaneous coverage from reputable outlets quoting and linking the Samsung statement may be used as fallback evidence, but only if they clearly identify an official Samsung publication within the 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-09 window.
subquestions.rationale: An official Samsung sales-timing statement is a strong near-term crux for whether a real public release will happen by the ultimate deadline. It is not the same as asking whether the phone is released; instead, it tracks whether Samsung has crossed the internal commercialization threshold of publicly committing to 2025 market availability.

question: Will Trump act to ban mail-in voting or voting machines in 2025?
description:
On August 18, 2025, President Donald J. Trump announced his commitment to eliminate mail-in voting and voting machines in U.S. elections, ahead of the 2026 midterms.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if Donald Trump signs any federal legislation or performs any executive action that inhibits mail-in voting or voting machines from use for the 2026 midterm election by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Any executive action or legislation that restricts, limits, or prohibits the use of mail-in voting or voting machines in any way will qualify, even if the action is delayed, suspended, or subsequently blocked by judicial or other actions.

This market’s primary resolution source will be official information from the Trump administration; however, a consensus of credible information from major news outlets or government statements will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the White House or DOJ publicly release, between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29, a draft executive order, formal legal memorandum, or official policy document that explicitly proposes restricting mail-in voting or the use of voting machines in federal elections?
subquestions.background_information:
A useful leading indicator for whether Trump will actually act by the end of 2025 is whether the administration produces a concrete official policy artifact, not just rhetoric. Trump publicly said in August 2025 that he intended to use executive action to end mail-in voting and voting machines before the 2026 midterms, and later reiterated plans for voter-ID rules and severe limits on mail voting. Multiple reports describe the administration as planning or drafting such an order, but public reporting before 2025-11-30 appears to be centered on statements of intent rather than release of a final official text. See KOMO's report on Trump's August 18 pledge to sign an executive order to end mail-in ballots and voting machines: https://komonews.com/news/nation-world/election-officials-speak-out-as-trump-pushes-to-eliminate-mail-in-voting ; USA Today on Trump's August 30/31 Truth Social post promising an executive order on voter ID and limiting mail-in voting: https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2025/08/31/trump-executive-order-voter-id-mail-voting/ ; and Al Jazeera's summary of the same announcement: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/31/trump-to-order-voter-id-for-every-vote-no-exceptions .

This subquestion is informative because formal release of a draft EO, OLC/DOJ memo, or other official policy text would show the administration has moved from messaging to legally operational planning. That is a strong indicator for the ultimate question, but not identical to it: the administration could release a draft or memo and still fail to act, or act without publicly releasing such a document. The question is also grounded in the institutional reality that presidential executive actions are often preceded or accompanied by published memoranda, fact sheets, legal justifications, or Federal Register materials. The White House publishes presidential actions and statements at https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/ , and the Department of Justice posts legal and policy materials at https://www.justice.gov/ .

Sources:
KOMO News - Election officials speak out as Trump pushes to eliminate mail-in voting - https://komonews.com/news/nation-world/election-officials-speak-out-as-trump-pushes-to-eliminate-mail-in-voting
USA Today - Trump says he will issue executive order mandating voter ID requirement - https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2025/08/31/trump-executive-order-voter-id-mail-voting/
Al Jazeera - Trump to order voter ID for every vote, 'no exceptions' - https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/31/trump-to-order-voter-id-for-every-vote-no-exceptions
White House - Presidential Actions - https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/
U.S. Department of Justice - https://www.justice.gov/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive, an official U.S. government source publicly releases a document that explicitly proposes restricting mail-in voting or restricting/replacing the use of voting machines in federal elections. Qualifying documents include: (a) a draft executive order, (b) a White House fact sheet or presidential memorandum describing a forthcoming order or directive, (c) a DOJ/OLC legal memorandum, guidance document, or litigation filing, or (d) a Federal Register or other official publication containing proposed executive policy language.

The document must be publicly accessible from an official government website such as the White House (https://www.whitehouse.gov/), the Department of Justice (https://www.justice.gov/), the Federal Register (https://www.federalregister.gov/), or another .gov site, and must explicitly reference limiting, prohibiting, replacing, or otherwise inhibiting mail-in voting and/or voting machines for federal elections. Mere speeches, social-media posts, campaign statements, or anonymous-leak reporting do not qualify unless accompanied by the release of an official document.

This question resolves No if no such official document is publicly released between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive.

Primary sources for resolution: White House Presidential Actions page (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/), White House Briefing Room (https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/), DOJ website (https://www.justice.gov/), and Federal Register (https://www.federalregister.gov/). If those sources are temporarily unavailable, archived copies or contemporaneous reporting from major outlets that directly link to or reproduce the official document may be used as secondary confirmation. If a document is announced during the window but only released after 2025-12-29, it does not count.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question asks whether Trump will actually take executive or legislative action by year-end. A publicly released draft order or formal legal memo is a concrete precursor showing administrative preparation and legal commitment, making it a strong early indicator without merely restating the ultimate question.

question: Will US GDP growth in Q3 2025 be between 2.0% and 2.5%?
description:
This market will resolve according to the seasonally adjusted and annualized GDP "Advance Estimate" release for Q3 of 2025 scheduled for October 30, 2025.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The GDP release will be made available here: https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product

Note: data in the first available GDP report is labelled by the BEA as an "Advance Estimate". The data found in the advance estimate will be used to resolve this market. Data may be revised during the following quarter or as a part of the next estimate's publication, however any revisions to GDP report data made after the release of the advance estimate will not be considered for this market's resolution.

subquestions.question: Will the Atlanta Fed GDPNow model's forecast for U.S. real GDP growth in Q3 2025 be between 1.8% and 2.7% on its last update published between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term nowcast of Q3 2025 GDP is one of the most direct early indicators for whether the BEA's Q3 2025 advance estimate will land in the relatively narrow 2.0% to 2.5% range. The Atlanta Fed's GDPNow model is widely followed because it updates through the quarter using incoming high-frequency macro data and is explicitly designed to track the BEA's real GDP growth measure in annualized quarterly terms. The Atlanta Fed describes GDPNow as a 'nowcast' model estimate of real GDP growth based on currently available economic data: https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow. A forecast range centered near the target bracket but slightly wider (1.8% to 2.7%) is useful because nowcasts are noisy and may differ somewhat from the eventual BEA advance estimate while still being informative about whether final growth is likely to fall in the 2.0% to 2.5% band.

Current context suggests this is a meaningful crux rather than a restatement. The BEA's second estimate reported real GDP growth of 3.3% in Q2 2025, following a -0.5% contraction in Q1 2025, underscoring recent volatility in headline GDP and making a mid-2% Q3 outcome plausible but far from certain. The BEA's Q2 2025 release page reports the 3.3% annualized growth rate in the second estimate: https://www.bea.gov/news/2025/gross-domestic-product-second-estimate-corporate-profits-preliminary-estimate-and-gdp. Because Q2's strength was materially affected by trade/import dynamics, a contemporaneous nowcast for Q3 helps distinguish whether growth is settling into the low-to-mid 2% range versus remaining stronger or weakening materially.

This subquestion is grounded in current publicly available data infrastructure and resolves before the user's requested latest date of 2025-10-01. It should have meaningful value of information because forecasters who disagree on the ultimate question will often differ on whether incoming September data leave the quarter tracking near the target band.

Sources:
Atlanta Fed GDPNow: https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow
BEA Q2 2025 GDP second estimate release: https://www.bea.gov/news/2025/gross-domestic-product-second-estimate-corporate-profits-preliminary-estimate-and-gdp
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the last GDPNow forecast for 'real GDP growth (seasonally adjusted annual rate)' published on the Atlanta Fed GDPNow page between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 (inclusive) is greater than or equal to 1.8% and less than or equal to 2.7%. It resolves No otherwise.

Primary source: the Atlanta Fed GDPNow page at https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow . The resolver should identify all GDPNow updates posted from 2025-09-01 through 2025-10-01 inclusive and use the chronologically last such update in that window. If the page shows a dated table or archive entry, that dated entry governs.

If the displayed figure is rounded to one decimal place, the displayed rounded figure will be used as published. If no GDPNow update is published during the window 2025-09-01 through 2025-10-01 inclusive, this question should resolve Unresolvable.

Fallback source: if the main GDPNow page layout changes, use the Atlanta Fed GDPNow archive or related official Atlanta Fed pages reachable from https://www.atlantafed.org/cqer/research/gdpnow that preserve the dated published nowcasts. Unofficial media summaries should not be used unless they directly reproduce an official Atlanta Fed figure and the official page is unavailable.
subquestions.rationale: GDPNow is a high-salience, quarter-specific nowcast of the same underlying concept as the ultimate question: annualized real GDP growth. Whether it is tracking near the low-to-mid 2% range by the end of September should substantially update beliefs about whether the BEA advance estimate for Q3 will land in the 2.0% to 2.5% bracket.

question: GTA 6 launch postponed?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if by May 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, officially announces that Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA VI) will not be released by May 26, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If Grand Theft Auto VI is otherwise not released in the US by May 26, 2026, 11:59 PM ET this will qualify as a postponement.

For the purposes of this market, "release" refers to the game becoming publicly available for purchase or download in the US. Early access, beta versions, other forms of pre-release availability, or leaks will not count as an official release. If the release is only for certain consoles (e.g. Xbox Series X/S) it will count.

The resolution source will be official information from Rockstar Games or its parent company, Take-Two Interactive.

subquestions.question: Will Take-Two Interactive's next official earnings release or earnings call materials published between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 explicitly continue to state that Grand Theft Auto VI is planned for release on May 26, 2026?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question is whether GTA VI will be postponed beyond May 26, 2026. A useful early indicator is whether Take-Two continues to publicly reaffirm the exact launch date in formal investor communications. Public reaffirmation in an earnings release or call deck is meaningful because Take-Two's management has strong incentives to avoid giving investors a date they no longer expect to hit.

As of late September 2025, multiple reports say Take-Two and/or Rockstar publicly reaffirmed a May 26, 2026 launch date at the September 18, 2025 shareholder meeting and on official materials. Sports Illustrated reported that Rockstar's website listed the game as "Coming May 26 2026" and that this was reiterated at Take-Two's shareholder meeting: https://www.si.com/esports/news/rockstar-confirms-grand-theft-auto-6-release-date-for-now . Hindustan Times likewise reported that the date was confirmed on Take-Two's website and at the shareholder meeting: https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/gta-6-might-be-scheduled-for-may-2026-release-here-s-what-you-need-to-know-101758396214180.html .

Take-Two's investor relations site is the authoritative place where earnings releases, slide decks, and call transcripts/links are posted: https://www.take2games.com/ir/ . The company's earnings schedule and releases can materially move expectations around major titles, especially GTA VI, which management has tied to strong Fiscal 2027 performance in prior public statements reported by the press. If the next earnings materials still explicitly mention May 26, 2026, that is evidence against an imminent postponement. If they omit the exact date or switch to vaguer language, that would be some evidence in favor of delay risk, even if not conclusive.

This subquestion is not just an earlier version of the ultimate question: it asks about a specific intermediate signal in investor communications rather than whether a postponement is officially announced.

Sources:
Take-Two Investor Relations: https://www.take2games.com/ir/
Sports Illustrated - Rockstar Confirms Grand Theft Auto 6 Release Date...For Now: https://www.si.com/esports/news/rockstar-confirms-grand-theft-auto-6-release-date-for-now
Hindustan Times - GTA 6 might be scheduled for May 2026 release: https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/gta-6-might-be-scheduled-for-may-2026-release-here-s-what-you-need-to-know-101758396214180.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), Take-Two Interactive publishes an official earnings release, shareholder letter, earnings presentation, or official earnings call transcript/webcast materials on its investor relations website that explicitly state that Grand Theft Auto VI is planned for release on May 26, 2026.

This question resolves No if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), Take-Two publishes such official earnings materials but they do not explicitly state that GTA VI is planned for release on May 26, 2026.

If no Take-Two earnings release, earnings presentation, shareholder letter, or official earnings call materials are published between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 (inclusive), this question resolves Unresolvable.

Resolution should use official Take-Two investor relations materials as the primary source: https://www.take2games.com/ir/ and any earnings-release pages linked there. If both a press release and a slide deck are published in the window, either one containing the explicit May 26, 2026 statement is sufficient for Yes. Third-party news reports do not count unless they directly reproduce or link to the official Take-Two materials. If materials are first posted within the window and later edited after 2025-10-31, the version publicly available by 2025-10-31 23:59:59 UTC governs. Archived copies from the investor relations page or the company's official newsroom may be used as fallback evidence.

Primary source: Take-Two Investor Relations https://www.take2games.com/ir/
Fallback source: Take-Two corporate site/news pages if the IR site structure changes https://www.take2games.com/
Supporting context source: Sports Illustrated article summarizing prior official confirmation https://www.si.com/esports/news/rockstar-confirms-grand-theft-auto-6-release-date-for-now
subquestions.rationale: A continued explicit reaffirmation of the exact date in formal investor communications would be a strong signal that management still expects to ship on time. Failure to reaffirm, or switching to vaguer wording, would increase the odds of a later postponement announcement.

question: Will US GDP growth in 2025 be between 2.0% and 2.5%?
description:
This market will resolve according to the seasonally adjusted real GDP growth rate for the United States in 2025, as reported in the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) "Advance Estimate" release for Q4 of 2025, scheduled for January 29, 2026.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

The GDP release will be made available here: https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product

Note: The relevant data will be the full-year real GDP growth rate as stated in the advance estimate, typically expressed as the percentage change from the annual level in 2024 to the annual level in 2025. Any revisions to this figure made after the release of the advance estimate will not be considered for this market's resolution.

subquestions.question: Will the Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index present situation component be at least 145.0 in the January 2026 release published between 2025-12-30 and 2026-01-29?
subquestions.background_information:
Consumer spending is a major driver of US GDP, so near-term measures of household conditions are useful indicators for whether full-year 2025 real GDP growth lands in the relatively solid 2.0%–2.5% range rather than below it. The Conference Board’s Consumer Confidence survey includes a Present Situation Index intended to capture consumers’ assessment of current business and labor-market conditions; stronger readings are generally associated with stronger consumption growth. The Conference Board publishes monthly Consumer Confidence releases here: https://www.conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence. 

The ultimate question will be resolved from the BEA’s advance estimate for Q4/full-year 2025 real GDP. Recent growth data suggest 2025 growth was running solidly through Q3: the user-provided news summary states Q1 was about -0.6%, Q2 about 3.8%, and Q3 about 4.3% annualized, implying the economy entered Q4 with decent momentum. The BEA GDP release page for the final underlying source is https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product. If household demand remained resilient into late 2025 and early 2026, that would modestly support the chance that full-year 2025 growth ends up in the 2.0%–2.5% bracket rather than materially lower. 

A threshold of 145.0 for the Present Situation Index is chosen because it is high enough to indicate notably strong current household sentiment without being so extreme as to be almost impossible; the January 2026 release should incorporate very recent information about labor markets and spending conditions. While consumer confidence is not identical to GDP, it is a distinct observable indicator rather than a restatement of the GDP outcome. 

Sources:
Conference Board Consumer Confidence topic page — https://www.conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence
BEA Gross Domestic Product page — https://www.bea.gov/data/gdp/gross-domestic-product
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the Conference Board’s January 2026 Consumer Confidence release, published between 2025-12-30 and 2026-01-29 (inclusive), reports the Present Situation Index at 145.0 or higher. It resolves No if that January 2026 release is published within that window and reports the Present Situation Index below 145.0.

Primary source: the official Conference Board Consumer Confidence release page at https://www.conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence and the specific January 2026 press release linked there.

If the January 2026 release is published within the window and later revised, the first value published in that release will govern. If the Conference Board does not publish a January 2026 Consumer Confidence release by 2026-01-29, this question should be considered unresolvable rather than resolving No, because the qualifying publication did not occur within the stated window.

For avoidance of doubt, only a January 2026 Consumer Confidence release counts; December 2025 or February 2026 releases do not count. The qualifying event must occur between 2025-12-30 and 2026-01-29 inclusive.
subquestions.rationale: Household consumption is the largest component of GDP. A strong January 2026 Present Situation reading would be evidence that consumer conditions remained robust around year-end, which is relevant to whether 2025 full-year GDP growth stayed in a healthy mid-2% range. This is a different observable from GDP itself, and resolution of this subquestion should update forecasts on the ultimate GDP bracket question.

question: Will Tulsi Gabbard be the first to leave the Trump Cabinet before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve based on the next individual announced to leave the Trump Cabinet, or who otherwise ceases to be a member of the administration. If no one leaves by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “None before 2027”.

An announcement of an individual's resignation/removal before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the resignation/removal takes effect.

If multiple individuals announce departures or are removed at the same time, the market will resolve to the individual who actually leaves office first. If they leave simultaneously, the market will resolve to the individual whose last name comes first alphabetically.

For the purposes of this market, the Cabinet includes Vice President, the heads of the 15 executive departments, as well as the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), the President’s Chief of Staff, the Director of National Intelligence (DNI), the Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB), the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), the United States Trade Representative (USTR), the Ambassador to the United Nations, the Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), and the Administrator of the Small Business Administration (SBA). Acting officials serving in these roles are not included. The Director of the Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) is not considered Cabinet-level under the current Trump administration and is excluded from this market.

An individual will be considered to have left the Cabinet if they resign from or are removed from any Cabinet-level position, even if they are subsequently appointed to a different Cabinet-level role.

If a candidate who is not already listed, assumes a listed cabinet position they will be added to the market. However, candidates who have merely been nominated for a cabinet position will not be considered to have left, even if their nomination is rejected or withdrawn.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the Trump administration, however a consensus of credible reopening may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Tulsi Gabbard receive a public call for her resignation or removal from at least two Republican U.S. senators between 2026-01-05 and 2026-02-01?
subquestions.background_information:
Tulsi Gabbard is serving as Director of National Intelligence, which is one of the Cabinet-level roles included in the ultimate market. She appears politically vulnerable for several reasons. Recent reporting notes that Gabbard was confirmed narrowly, with The Washington Post analysis summarized by Raw Story saying she was confirmed by only two votes, which could make replacing her politically difficult but also signals limited Senate support compared with more secure appointees. The same analysis says Gabbard drew criticism for a video claiming the world is 'on the brink of nuclear annihilation' and that several Trump officials have faced public controversy without yet being removed. https://www.rawstory.com/trump-cabinet-turnover-analysis/

There are also signs of friction around intelligence staffing. Newsmax reported on 2025-12-12 that Rep. Don Bacon said White House 'infighting' contributed to withdrawal of Joe Francescon as nominee for deputy director of the NSA, and that Francescon had initially been selected by Gabbard with Trump's approval. https://www.newsmax.com/newsfront/nsa-joe-francescon-withdrawal/2025/12/12/id/1201234/ 

On 2026-01-04, Mediaite highlighted criticism of Gabbard after contrasting her October 2025 speech against 'regime change' with the administration's later actions in Venezuela, raising questions about her alignment with administration policy. https://www.mediaite.com/politics/tulsi-gabbard-said-us-cycle-of-regime-change-was-over-just-2-months-before-maduro-arrest/

A wave of public calls from Republican senators for Gabbard to resign or be fired would be a strong elite signal that she is uniquely endangered relative to other Cabinet officials. Because senators are central to confirmation politics and often shape media narratives around Cabinet viability, such calls would be a meaningful near-term indicator for whether she is likely to be the first Cabinet member to leave.

Sources:
Raw Story - Trump's embarrassment has left him stuck with dead beat Cabinet: analysis - https://www.rawstory.com/trump-cabinet-turnover-analysis/
Newsmax - WH Pulls NSA Nominee as Cyber Leadership Gap Widens - https://www.newsmax.com/newsfront/nsa-joe-francescon-withdrawal/2025/12/12/id/1201234/
Mediaite - Tulsi Gabbard Said US 'Cycle Of Regime Change' Was Over - Just 2 Months Before Maduro Arrest - https://www.mediaite.com/politics/tulsi-gabbard-said-us-cycle-of-regime-change-was-over-just-2-months-before-maduro-arrest/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-05 and 2026-02-01 inclusive, at least two distinct sitting Republican U.S. senators each make a public statement explicitly calling for Tulsi Gabbard to resign, step down, be removed, be fired, or be replaced as Director of National Intelligence.

Qualifying statements must be public and attributable on the record, appearing in at least one of the following: the senator's official website, official social-media account, an interview transcript/video from a credible news outlet, C-SPAN coverage, or a congressional press release. The statements must clearly refer to Tulsi Gabbard personally and clearly advocate her departure from the DNI role; vague criticism or calls for 'accountability,' hearings, investigation, or 'considering personnel changes' do not count.

Primary sources for resolution will be senators' official websites and official X/social-media accounts, Senate webpages, C-SPAN, and major credible news reports aggregating the statements. Useful source pages include: U.S. Senate homepage https://www.senate.gov/ ; C-SPAN https://www.c-span.org/ ; official Senate Republican conference/member pages as applicable; and official X posts if publicly accessible. If a statement is first reported by a credible outlet, that can be used if it quotes or embeds the senator's direct remarks.

This question resolves No if fewer than two such Republican senators make qualifying statements during the window from 2026-01-05 through 2026-02-01 inclusive.

If a statement's timing cannot be established as occurring within the 2026-01-05 to 2026-02-01 window, it does not count. If source material is unavailable at resolution time, archived versions (for example via https://archive.org/ or https://archive.today/) and contemporaneous reporting from major outlets may be used as fallback evidence.
subquestions.rationale: Open Republican senatorial demands for Gabbard's ouster would be a concrete sign that her political support is collapsing. That would materially increase the chance she becomes the first Cabinet official to depart, while the absence of such calls would be modest evidence that her position remains comparatively stable.

question: Will MrBeast post another video on a weekday by September 30?
description:
On August 1, 2025, a Friday, MrBeast posted a video on his main YouTube channel, which breaks his usual pattern (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z4hVGCWH1Kc).

This market will resolve to “Yes” if MrBeast posts a YouTube video on a weekday (Monday - Friday, ET) between August 19 and September 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market is MrBeast's main YouTube channel (https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast).

Note: This market refers to MrBeast's regular posted videos. Shorts, previews, or videos on platforms other than YouTube will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will MrBeast post on X between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-07 inclusive that a new main-channel YouTube video is coming "this week," "tomorrow," or on a specific weekday before 2025-09-08?
subquestions.background_information:
MrBeast's main-channel upload timing is the core uncertainty in the ultimate question, but creator announcements on X can provide an earlier observable signal of whether a weekday upload is imminent. MrBeast has recently used X for major public updates: on August 27, 2025 he posted that filming for Beast Games Season 2 had wrapped, according to Yahoo's coverage of the post (https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/mrbeast-promises-season-2-prime-192337624.html). He also posted on August 31, 2025 offering a $100,000 reward for information leading to the arrest of scammers impersonating TeamWater, as reported by Sportskeeda (https://www.sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-i-will-reward-you-mrbeast-offers-100-000-information-scammed-entrepreneur-1-25-million-posing-teamwater). The ultimate market notes that on August 1, 2025 MrBeast posted a Friday video on his main YouTube channel, breaking his usual pattern, suggesting that schedule changes are currently salient and that public hints about upcoming uploads would be informative. The resolution source for the ultimate question is his main YouTube channel at https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast.

A direct scheduling hint on X would be a useful crux because it is different from the ultimate event itself, happens earlier, and would strongly update expectations about whether a weekday upload will occur before September 30.

Sources:
Yahoo Entertainment - MrBeast Promises Season 2 of Prime Video Show 'Beast Games' is '10× Better,' Unveils First Look - https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment/mrbeast-promises-season-2-prime-192337624.html
Sportskeeda - "I will reward you": MrBeast offers $100,000 for information on those who scammed an entrepreneur out of $1.25 million by posing as TeamWater - https://www.sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-i-will-reward-you-mrbeast-offers-100-000-information-scammed-entrepreneur-1-25-million-posing-teamwater
MrBeast YouTube channel - https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast
MrBeast X account - https://x.com/MrBeast
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 00:00:00 ET and 2025-09-07 23:59:59 ET inclusive, MrBeast posts from his verified X account (https://x.com/MrBeast) a public post that explicitly states or clearly announces that a new video on his main YouTube channel is expected within that window's remainder or by a named weekday before 2025-09-08. Examples that count include statements such as "new video tomorrow," "video on Wednesday," or "dropping this week" when the referenced video is plainly a main-channel YouTube upload. Posts that only promote an already-published video, refer only to Shorts, livestreams, Beast Games, philanthropy campaigns, or uploads on other channels/platforms do not count.

If the post is ambiguous about which channel or content type is being referenced, resolve No unless the linked media or text clearly indicates the MrBeast main YouTube channel at https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast. Quoted reposts count only if the qualifying language appears in MrBeast's own post text. Deleted posts still count if there is contemporaneous archival evidence from a reliable public archive or screenshots in reputable coverage.

Primary source for resolution: MrBeast's X account, https://x.com/MrBeast . Fallback sources if needed: web archives such as the Internet Archive Wayback Machine, https://web.archive.org/ ; and reputable news coverage quoting or embedding the post. If no qualifying post can be verified during the window from 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-07, resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: A public schedule hint from MrBeast on X would be an early indicator of an imminent upload and would materially update forecasts on the ultimate question without simply asking whether the weekday upload itself happens.

question: Will the US capture Khamenei before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if U.S. government personnel (including U.S. military, CIA, or any U.S. federal law enforcement agency) directly participate on the ground in an operation that results in the capture of Supreme Leader of Iran Ali Khamenei by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market, “capture” means Khamenei is taken into physical custody and detained (including arrest, detention, or seizure) such that he is no longer free to leave at will, even if only temporarily. Voluntary surrender may qualify if it results in immediate detention/custody.

U.S. personnel must directly participate on the ground to qualify. Intelligence, surveillance, planning, logistics, transport, support, funding, training, or advisory roles alone will not count, even if they materially contribute to the operation. If U.S. personnel are physically present in the operational area and take direct action (e.g., raiding, detaining, securing, physically transferring custody), it will qualify. U.S. government contractors will be considered to be U.S. personnel if they are confirmed to be acting under the direction of U.S. government authorities.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will a credible U.S. government official publicly state between 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-20 that the United States is considering or preparing a special operations raid or other ground operation inside Iran related to Ali Khamenei or Iran's top leadership?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term public shift by U.S. officials toward discussing a ground operation would be a meaningful indicator for the ultimate question, because the ultimate market specifically requires direct on-the-ground U.S. participation in a capture operation. Recent reporting suggests that while military action against Iran has been discussed, analysts currently see airstrikes or assassination as more plausible than a raid. CBS reported in January 2026 that U.S. options under discussion included conventional strikes, cyber operations, and even targeted action against Khamenei, while emphasizing broad uncertainty about Trump's intentions: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-iran-protesters-help-is-on-its-way-options/ . inews similarly reported on February 4, 2026 that a special operations raid was possible in principle but that a bunker-busting strike was viewed as more likely by some former U.S. officials and analysts: https://inews.co.uk/news/world/operation-khamenei-how-trump-could-hunt-down-and-kill-irans-supreme-leader-3512345 .

At the same time, tensions are elevated. Al Jazeera reported on February 1, 2026 that Khamenei warned any U.S. attack would trigger a 'regional war', while also noting open communication channels and indirect talks: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/1/khamenei-warns-us-of-regional-war-if-iran-is-attacked . Reporting also indicates substantial U.S. force presence in the region, including the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group and other assets, though that posture alone does not imply a ground capture plan: https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/us-war-machine-armada-lurks-34567890 .

Because direct public acknowledgment of considering or preparing a ground raid would mark a major escalation from general military pressure to the specific operational mode required by the ultimate question, it is a useful crux.

Sources:
CBS News - Trump told Iranian protesters 'help is on its way,' so what options does the U.S. have to respond? https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-iran-protesters-help-is-on-its-way-options/
inews - Operation Khamenei: How Trump could hunt down and kill Iran's Supreme Leader https://inews.co.uk/news/world/operation-khamenei-how-trump-could-hunt-down-and-kill-irans-supreme-leader-3512345
Al Jazeera - Khamenei warns US of 'regional war' if Iran is attacked https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/1/khamenei-warns-us-of-regional-war-if-iran-is-attacked
Mirror - US 'war-machine' armada lurks in Middle East as Iran on 'high alert' for carrier strike https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/us-war-machine-armada-lurks-34567890
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-20 inclusive, at least one credible U.S. government official publicly states that the United States is considering, planning, preparing, or readying a special operations raid, commando raid, ground operation, or similar on-the-ground mission inside Iran related to Ali Khamenei or Iran's top leadership.

Qualifying statements must satisfy all of the following:
1. The speaker is a credible U.S. government official: e.g. the President, Vice President, White House Press Secretary, Secretary of Defense, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs, a Combatant Commander, Secretary of State, National Security Advisor, or an official spokesperson for the White House, Department of Defense, or Department of State.
2. The statement is public and attributable, appearing in an official transcript/readout or in reporting by at least one major news outlet quoting the official on the record.
3. The statement specifically refers to a ground operation / raid / special operations mission / boots-on-the-ground action, not merely generic 'military options,' airstrikes, sanctions, cyber operations, intelligence support, or evacuation planning.
4. The statement links the contemplated operation to Ali Khamenei personally or to seizing/detaining/removing Iran's top leadership in a way that would be relevant to the ultimate question.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying public statement occurs between 2026-02-08 and 2026-02-20 inclusive.

Primary resolution sources: official White House statements and transcripts (https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/), U.S. Department of Defense releases/transcripts (https://www.defense.gov/News/Transcripts/ and https://www.defense.gov/News/Releases/), U.S. Department of State press briefings (https://www.state.gov/briefings/), plus corroborating coverage from Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), AP (https://apnews.com/), or CBS News (https://www.cbsnews.com/).

If an official statement is ambiguously phrased, it will count only if the plain meaning clearly indicates a contemplated on-the-ground operation inside Iran. Anonymous sourcing alone is insufficient unless later confirmed on the record by a qualifying official. If all cited primary sources become unavailable, consensus reporting from at least two of Reuters, AP, and major U.S. networks/newspapers may be used as fallback. If publication dates are unclear and it cannot be determined whether the statement occurred within the 2026-02-08 to 2026-02-20 window, the statement will not count.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question requires direct U.S. on-the-ground participation in capturing Khamenei. A public U.S. statement that a raid or ground mission is being considered would be a strong leading indicator that policymakers are moving toward the narrow class of operations capable of satisfying that condition, as opposed to more likely alternatives such as airstrikes, coercive diplomacy, or covert support.

question: Will NewJeans perform again in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if NewJeans (뉴진스, NJZ) gives at least one live performance as a group at any point between June 3 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. A qualifying performance must involve at least three members of NewJeans performing together under the group name "NewJeans" in front of a live audience or as part of a livestreamed or televised event.

Prerecorded performances aired in 2025 that were filmed earlier will not count. Solo or sub-unit performances will not count. Dance practices or behind-the-scenes content do not qualify as performances for this market.

The resolution source will be official announcements from NewJeans (including verified social media) and ADOR, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will ADOR or NewJeans publicly announce between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 that they have begun, resumed, or scheduled formal talks specifically aimed at restarting NewJeans group activities?
subquestions.background_information:
A key driver of whether NewJeans performs again in late 2025 is whether the relationship between the members and ADOR becomes operational enough to permit coordinated group activity. On 2025-10-30, multiple outlets reported that the Seoul Central District Court ruled NewJeans' exclusive contracts with ADOR remain valid until 2029, while the members said they would appeal. The ruling matters because any qualifying NewJeans group performance is now likely to require at least some practical coordination with ADOR, unless the legal situation changes again. NME reported that the court said ADOR had continued to plan albums, fan events, performances, and tours, while NewJeans is currently on an indefinite hiatus: https://www.nme.com/news/music/newjeans-must-honour-contract-with-ador-until-2029-court-rules-3860540 . Soompi likewise reported that the court found the contracts valid and that the members' legal team said trust had completely broken down and they would appeal: https://www.soompi.com/article/1755923wpp/court-rules-newjeans-contracts-with-ador-to-be-valid-members-to-appeal-decision . Earlier reporting also noted that ADOR had publicly urged the members to return to activities as NewJeans, suggesting the agency is open to a resumption if the members cooperate: https://www.indiatimes.com/trending/ador-urges-njz-to-return-to-their-rightful-place-as-newjeans-after-court-ruling-661610.html .

Because the ultimate question asks whether NewJeans will perform again before the end of 2025, a near-term indicator is not another performance question but whether either side signals a process for reactivation: negotiations, mediation, meetings, or scheduled discussions about resuming group work. subquestions.resolution_criteria:

Qualifying examples include public statements that the sides have: reopened negotiations; scheduled a meeting about resuming NewJeans promotions, performances, recordings, or fan events; entered mediation over return-to-activity terms; or agreed to discuss a roadmap for NewJeans activities. The statement must explicitly connect the talks to future group activities, promotions, performances, releases, schedules, or an operational return as NewJeans.

Non-qualifying events: a mere appeal filing; general statements of disagreement; commentary only about litigation with no mention of talks on restarting activities; fan speculation; unattributed tabloid claims; or statements only about individual members' positions without reference to group activity coordination.

Primary resolution sources: official ADOR statements on its website or verified social media; official NewJeans/NJZ verified social media; and attributed statements reported by major Korean entertainment outlets such as Soompi, NME, or Yonhap. subquestions.question: Will Phantom record at least $200,000 in daily builder revenue on 3 or more separate days between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30 (inclusive)?

The ultimate question asks whether Phantom can hit $300,000 in daily builder revenue at least once by the end of 2025, using Flowscan's "Daily Revenue by Builder" chart as the source: https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all. A useful near-term crux is whether Phantom can sustain multiple very high-revenue days in November, rather than merely spike once. Repeated days at or above $200,000 would indicate that Phantom is already operating near the level needed to plausibly reach a $300,000 day later in 2025.

This is grounded in current ecosystem conditions. Hyperliquid ecosystem application revenue was reported around $3 million per day in early October 2025, with Phantom listed among notable apps in that ecosystem, suggesting a sufficiently large addressable revenue pool for Phantom to potentially post very large daily builder-revenue readings if usage or fee capture strengthens: https://beincrypto.com/hyperliquid-vs-aster-most-investible-perp-dex/. The ultimate market itself specifies Flowscan's builder revenue chart as the canonical metric, so using the same source for a lower and more frequent threshold makes this a directly relevant indicator rather than a restatement of the main question: https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all.

Why this threshold? A $200,000 day is meaningfully below the $300,000 ultimate target, so it is not just the same question with an earlier date. Requiring 3 separate days also captures persistence rather than a one-off outlier. If Phantom cannot reach $200,000 on multiple November days, that is evidence against a December $300,000 print; if it can, forecasters should update upward on the ultimate question.

Sources:
- Flowscan Builders dashboard: https://www.flowscan.xyz/builders?builder=all
- BeInCrypto, "Why Hyperliquid Beats Aster as the Most Investible Perp DEX": https://beincrypto.com/hyperliquid-vs-aster-most-investible-perp-dex/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:

If Flowscan becomes unavailable, archived snapshots or mirrors that clearly reproduce Flowscan's Phantom daily builder revenue values may be used as fallback evidence; if no reliable reconstruction is available, the question should be considered unresolvable.

subquestions.rationale: Multiple $200k+ days in November would be a strong leading indicator that Phantom is already close to the $300k threshold and has underlying demand sufficient to produce a $300k day by year-end.
