The full rules for this market can be found here:
https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/mrbeast.png

subquestions.question: Will the MrBeast YouTube channel gain at least 8 million subscribers between 2025-09-12 and 2025-10-12?
subquestions.background_information:
One route to the ultimate market resolving No is MrBeast reaching 500 million subscribers by the end of 2025. A near-term indicator for that outcome is whether his subscriber growth remains exceptionally high over the next month. As of early September 2025, multiple outlets reported MrBeast at roughly 430-431 million subscribers, including 430 million on September 3, 2025 (Benzinga: https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/25/09/47269708/mrbeast-could-be-the-next-celebrity-to-turn-a-phone-into-a-fortune-t-mobile-us-nasdaq-tmus-amazon-com-nasdaq-amzn) and 431 million on September 5, 2025 (Yahoo Finance syndication: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/youtube-star-mrbeast-reportedly-wants-132616425.html). Earlier in 2025, Hypebeast reported that MrBeast surpassed 400 million subscribers on June 1, 2025 and cited an average growth rate of about 350,000 subscribers per day at that time, implying that monthly gains in the high single-digit millions are plausible if momentum persists (https://hypebeast.com/2025/6/mrbeast-400-million-youtube-subscribers-record-news). SocialBlade provides a widely used public tracker for YouTube subscriber counts and recent gains for major channels, including MrBeast's channel page (https://socialblade.com/youtube/c/mrbeast6000). If MrBeast adds 8+ million subscribers over this 30-day window, that would be evidence that the 500 million threshold by late 2025 is materially more reachable; if growth is much slower, the subscriber leg of the ultimate market becomes less likely to flip the outcome.

Sources:
Benzinga - MrBeast Could Be The Next Celebrity To Turn A Phone Into A Fortune: https://www.benzinga.com/markets/equities/25/09/47269708/mrbeast-could-be-the-next-celebrity-to-turn-a-phone-into-a-fortune-t-mobile-us-nasdaq-tmus-amazon-com-nasdaq-amzn
Yahoo Finance - YouTube star MrBeast reportedly wants to launch a phone company: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/youtube-star-mrbeast-reportedly-wants-132616425.html
Hypebeast - MrBeast Makes History as First-Ever YouTuber To Surpass 400 Million Subscribers: https://hypebeast.com/2025/6/mrbeast-400-million-youtube-subscribers-record-news
SocialBlade - MrBeast YouTube statistics: https://socialblade.com/youtube/c/mrbeast6000
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the publicly displayed subscriber count for the MrBeast main YouTube channel increases by at least 8,000,000 between 2025-09-12 and 2025-10-12, inclusive.

Primary source: SocialBlade's MrBeast channel page at https://socialblade.com/youtube/c/mrbeast6000 . Use the subscriber total shown for the date 2025-09-12 as the starting value and the subscriber total shown for 2025-10-12 as the ending value. If ending value minus starting value is 8,000,000 or greater, resolve Yes; otherwise resolve No.

If SocialBlade is unavailable or materially incomplete for one of those dates, use archived captures of the same page from the Internet Archive (https://web.archive.org/) for the relevant dates. If neither live nor archived SocialBlade data is available, use the subscriber totals displayed on a reputable public analytics tracker that publishes historical daily YouTube subscriber counts for MrBeast, such as vidIQ channel stats if it clearly shows dated historical totals (https://vidiq.com/youtube-stats/channel/UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA/). The fallback source must provide date-specific counts for both 2025-09-12 and 2025-10-12.

For avoidance of doubt, this is about subscriber growth over the window, not whether MrBeast reaches any absolute milestone. Partial-day fluctuations do not matter beyond the dated totals reported by the source. If no qualifying dated historical source can establish both endpoint values, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: This is a distinct observable indicator, not a restatement of the ultimate market. The ultimate market can flip to No if MrBeast reaches 500 million subscribers by year-end; unusually strong subscriber growth over the next month is an early signal that this path is live. Resolving this subquestion would materially update beliefs about the subscriber-milestone component of the ultimate question.

question: NATO downs another Russian drone by December 31?
description:
NATO fighter jets shot down multiple Russian drones that violated Polish airspace on September 10. For more information see here: https://edition.cnn.com/2025/09/09/europe/poland-scramble-jets-russian-drone-reports-intl-hnk-ml 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if a NATO military downs another Russian drone by any means (kinetic, jammer, etc.) between October 30 and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Romania's Ministry of National Defence report at least one new drone or missile incursion into Romanian airspace attributed to the war in Ukraine between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29?
subquestions.background_information:
Romania is one of the most plausible locations for another NATO downing of a Russian drone because it sits directly on Ukraine's southwestern border and has already experienced repeated cross-border drone incidents. Reuters reported on November 25, 2025 that Romanian and German NATO jets were scrambled after two Russian drones breached Romanian airspace, with one flying more than 100 km inland; Defence Minister Ionut Mosteanu said Romania had legal authority to shoot down such drones in peacetime under some conditions, though it did not do so in that case. Reuters also noted this was the 13th such breach since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine began. See: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romania-scrambles-nato-jets-after-deepest-ever-drone-incursion-calls-it-2025-11-25/ 

AP similarly reported a broader pattern of suspicious drone activity and confirmed that on September 10, 2025, Russian drones entered Polish airspace and some were shot down by NATO aircraft, demonstrating that airspace incursions can escalate to direct NATO countermeasures. See: https://apnews.com/ 

A fresh Romanian incursion during the subquestion window would be a strong leading indicator for the ultimate question because Romania has recently been the most active eastern-flank venue for such incidents, and another incursion would create another opportunity for NATO forces already on alert to engage. Romania's defence ministry publishes incident statements on its official website, which is an authoritative primary source for whether a qualifying new incursion was officially reported. See: https://english.mapn.ro/ 

Sources:
Reuters - Romania scrambles NATO jets after deepest-ever drone incursion, calls it Russian provocation - https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/romania-scrambles-nato-jets-after-deepest-ever-drone-incursion-calls-it-2025-11-25/
Romania Ministry of National Defence (English) - https://english.mapn.ro/
AP News - Mysterious drone flights in NATO airspace have caused alarm across Europe. Here's what we know - https://apnews.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Romania's Ministry of National Defence (MAPN), in an official statement published between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive, reports at least one new incursion into Romanian airspace by a drone, UAV, missile, or similar aerial object explicitly linked to or occurring in the context of Russia's war against Ukraine. The publication date of the official MAPN statement must fall within the window from 2025-11-30 to 2025-12-29 inclusive.

Primary source: official MAPN news releases at https://english.mapn.ro/ or the Romanian-language site https://www.mapn.ro/ .

A report counts if it describes a distinct incident newly announced during the window; updates during the window about an incident first officially announced before 2025-11-30 do not count.

The question resolves No if no such qualifying official MAPN statement is published between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive.

If MAPN's site is unavailable, fallback sources are official Romanian government or presidency statements and then at least two consistent reports from major international wire services such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/) or AP (https://apnews.com/) clearly attributing the incident report to Romanian defence authorities.

If available information is insufficient to determine whether a distinct new official Romanian report occurred within the stated window, resolve Unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Another official Romanian airspace incursion report would materially increase the chance of the ultimate outcome by creating a fresh, geographically plausible opportunity for NATO forces to down a Russian drone before year-end.

question: Nothing Ever Happens: Taylor Swift Edition
description:
This market will resolve to “No” if any of the following conditions are met between September 23, 2025, and December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET:

- Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce married
- Taylor Swift pregnant
- Taylor Swift mentions Travis Kelce on her new album

Otherwise, this market will resolve to “Yes”.

The full rules for this market can be found here:
https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/TS.png

subquestions.question: Will Taylor Swift or Travis Kelce publicly state or strongly imply that they are actively planning a wedding between 2025-10-25 and 2025-11-24?
subquestions.background_information:
This is a useful indicator for the ultimate market because one of the three disqualifying conditions is that Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce marry before the end of 2025. As of the start date, the couple are widely reported to be engaged: multiple October 2025 entertainment reports say Swift discussed Kelce's proposal and referred to him as her fiancé, while reporting that she was prioritizing the album rollout before wedding planning. For example, NDTV reported on 2025-10-03 that Swift said on The Graham Norton Show that Kelce "crushed" the proposal and that "I want to do the album stuff first, and the wedding is what happens after in terms of planning" (https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/taylor-swift-on-how-travis-kelce-crushed-it-with-his-marriage-proposal-9175914). Music Times likewise reported on 2025-10-07 that Swift said she was "not yet hiring a wedding planner" while expressing excitement about marrying Kelce (https://www.musictimes.com/articles/109193/20251007/taylor-swift-fires-back-fans-speculating-shell-quit-music-post-marriage-travis-kelce.htm). GEO TV reported on 2025-10-06, citing a source, that Swift was preparing to pause work to focus on wedding preparations (https://www.geo.tv/latest/619050-taylor-swift-ready-to-pause-career-for-wedding-prep-with-travis-kelce-source).

Because marriage is one of the explicit "Nothing Ever Happens" failure modes, a clear public indication that the couple are actively planning a wedding in late October or November 2025 would increase the odds of a wedding by year-end. This is meaningfully different from the ultimate question itself: it asks about wedding-planning signals, not whether a marriage actually occurs.

Sources:
NDTV - Taylor Swift On How Travis Kelce "Crushed It" With His Marriage Proposal: https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/taylor-swift-on-how-travis-kelce-crushed-it-with-his-marriage-proposal-9175914
Music Times - Taylor Swift Fires Back at Fans Speculating She'll Quit Music Post-Marriage to Travis Kelce: https://www.musictimes.com/articles/109193/20251007/taylor-swift-fires-back-fans-speculating-shell-quit-music-post-marriage-travis-kelce.htm
GEO TV - Taylor Swift ready to pause career for wedding prep with Travis Kelce: Source: https://www.geo.tv/latest/619050-taylor-swift-ready-to-pause-career-for-wedding-prep-with-travis-kelce-source
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-25 and 2025-11-24 (inclusive), either Taylor Swift or Travis Kelce makes a public statement in a primary or widely cited secondary source that clearly indicates active wedding planning is underway. Qualifying examples include statements that they have started planning the wedding, have set or are narrowing a wedding date, have chosen or are touring venues, are working with a wedding planner, are sending invitations, or are making concrete arrangements for the ceremony.

Strong implication also counts if the report quotes one of them directly describing concrete planning steps, even without the exact words "planning the wedding." Mere references to being engaged, generic excitement about getting married, or vague future-oriented remarks such as "we'll get married someday" do NOT count. Unattributed tabloid speculation or anonymous-source-only reporting does NOT count unless it is subsequently confirmed in an on-record interview or statement by Swift or Kelce during the window.

Primary resolution sources, in order of priority, are direct interviews, official social media accounts, official podcast/video appearances, or official representatives' statements. Secondary sources may be used only to relay such direct statements. Preferred sources include Taylor Swift's official accounts (https://www.instagram.com/taylorswift/), Travis Kelce's official accounts (https://www.instagram.com/killatrav/), official New Heights content (https://www.youtube.com/@newheightshow), and transcripts or recordings from major outlets such as NBC, ABC, CBS, BBC, People, Us Weekly, or similar reputable outlets.

If no qualifying public statement or strongly implied concrete planning step is documented between 2025-10-25 and 2025-11-24 (inclusive), resolve No.

If an alleged qualifying statement is reported but no sufficiently reliable public record can be found, resolve based on the best available direct quote in a reputable outlet. If all evidence is ambiguous as to whether active planning was stated, resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: A late-2025 marriage is more plausible if the couple publicly move from engagement into concrete planning. This subquestion is an early observable indicator for the marriage branch of the ultimate market without merely restating whether they marry by year-end.

question: John Bolton federally charged by October 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the United States federal government formally charges or announces a criminal indictment of former US national security advisor John Bolton between August 20, and October 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market the District of Columbia and any county, municipality, or other subdivision of a State shall be included within the definition of a State.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from US governmental sources, however a wide consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will a federal grand jury be reported by Reuters or the Associated Press as having heard evidence in the John Bolton investigation between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-14?
subquestions.background_information:
A grand-jury presentation would be a meaningful near-term indicator for whether John Bolton is federally charged soon, because federal indictments typically require either a grand-jury vote or, less commonly, an information following waiver in applicable cases. Reuters reported on 2025-09-26 that prosecutors were expected to present the Bolton case to a grand jury the following week, while noting internal DOJ disagreement over whether to move quickly. That makes actual grand-jury activity a concrete observable step distinct from the ultimate question itself and highly relevant to near-term charging odds. Reuters/KSL reported that senior DOJ leaders were urging swift charges and that prosecutors in the Maryland U.S. Attorney’s Office and DOJ National Security Division were resisting pressure, with one source saying prosecutors were expected to present the case to a grand jury next week: https://www.ksl.com/article/51373720/justice-department-pushing-for-swift-charges-against-bolton-people-familiar-say . Reporting on the August searches also indicates the investigation is criminal and active, with search warrants approved by a judge and public statements from senior officials signaling seriousness: Reuters via RTHK, https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1819852-20250823.htm .

This subquestion is not just an earlier version of the ultimate question: it asks whether a specific procedural milestone occurs, not whether Bolton is charged. If the investigation is presented to a grand jury by mid-October, that would materially increase the probability of a charge by the ultimate deadline; if not, it would tend to reduce it.

Sources:
KSL / Reuters - Justice Department pushing for 'swift charges' against Bolton, people familiar say - https://www.ksl.com/article/51373720/justice-department-pushing-for-swift-charges-against-bolton-people-familiar-say
RTHK / Reuters - FBI raids home and office of ex-Trump advisor Bolton - https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1819852-20250823.htm
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-14 (inclusive), either Reuters or the Associated Press reports that a federal grand jury heard evidence, received a presentation, or otherwise considered the John Bolton criminal investigation/case for potential charges.

This question resolves No if no such Reuters or Associated Press report is published during the window from 2025-10-01 through 2025-10-14 (inclusive).

For purposes of resolution, qualifying language includes clear statements such as that prosecutors "presented the case to a grand jury," "a grand jury heard evidence," "the case went before a grand jury," or equivalent wording indicating actual grand-jury consideration during the window. Mere statements that prosecutors expect, plan, intend, or are pushing to present the case do NOT qualify. Mere mention of sealed court activity without explicit grand-jury consideration does NOT qualify.

Primary sources for resolution: Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/) and Associated Press (https://apnews.com/). If both publish conflicting accounts within the window, resolution should follow the later clarification/correction from the same outlet; if conflict remains unresolved, the question is unresolvable. If neither Reuters nor AP publishes on the matter during the window, it resolves No even if other outlets report it.

If a report published after 2025-10-14 states that grand-jury consideration occurred during the 2025-10-01 to 2025-10-14 window, that later report may be used to resolve Yes, provided Reuters or AP explicitly dates the grand-jury activity to within that window.
subquestions.rationale: Grand-jury activity is one of the clearest observable precursors to a federal indictment. It is a procedural milestone that should substantially update forecasts about whether Bolton is charged by the ultimate deadline, while remaining distinct from the charge itself.

question: Will Kamala Harris endorse Mamdani?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kamala Harris announces that she will vote for Zohran Mamdani or endorses Mamdani for the 2025 NYC Mayor election between June 26, and November 3, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

If Kamala Harris announces that she will vote for another candidate or endorses another candidate for NYC Mayor, this market will immediately resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Kamala Harris or one of her representatives, or a consensus of credible reporting of Kamala Harris's endorsement.

subquestions.question: Will House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries endorse Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-20?
subquestions.background_information:
A key uncertainty for whether Kamala Harris will endorse Zohran Mamdani is whether prominent establishment Democrats begin publicly backing him first. Hakeem Jeffries is especially informative because he is both one of the highest-profile New York Democrats and, as of mid-July, had met with Mamdani without endorsing him. Yahoo reported on 2025-07-18 that Jeffries held an hour-long meeting with Mamdani but still had not endorsed him; the same article noted that other top Democrats, including Gov. Kathy Hochul and Sen. Chuck Schumer, also had not endorsed him yet (https://www.yahoo.com/news/hakeem-jeffries-meets-zohran-mamdani-090000000.html). This suggests Jeffries was a salient holdout rather than an automatic endorser.

At the same time, Mamdani has accumulated meaningful progressive and Democratic support. Bernie Sanders endorsed him on 2025-06-28, giving him a major boost and underscoring that he has strong support on the party's left flank (https://nystateofpolitics.com/state-of-politics/new-york/politics/2025/06/28/bernie-sanders-endorses-mamdani-in-the-mayoral-race). Rep. Adriano Espaillat endorsed Mamdani on 2025-07-18, and that report said Reps. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Jerrold Nadler, and Nydia Velázquez had also endorsed him, indicating some consolidation among elected Democrats (https://nystateofpolitics.com/state-of-politics/new-york/politics/2025/07/18/rep--adriano-espaillat-endorses-mamdani-for-mayor).

There are also countervailing signs that establishment Democrats may hesitate. Reporting has highlighted reluctance among moderates and some officials who backed Cuomo in the primary; for example, the Queens Daily Eagle reported on 2025-07-07 that several Queens elected officials were hesitant or opposed to endorsing Mamdani, with some explicitly declining to do so (https://queenseagle.com/all/mamdani-got-queens-support-on-election-day-can-he-now-get-it-from-his-queens-colleagues). If Jeffries breaks with this hesitation and endorses, that would be a strong signal that the party establishment is coalescing around Mamdani, which would plausibly increase the odds that Harris also endorses. Conversely, continued non-endorsement by Jeffries through 2025-09-20 would be evidence that high-level Democrats remain cautious.

Sources:
Yahoo: Hakeem Jeffries meets with Zohran Mamdani, but no endorsement yet for NYC mayor — https://www.yahoo.com/news/hakeem-jeffries-meets-zohran-mamdani-090000000.html
State of Politics: Bernie Sanders endorses Mamdani in the mayoral race — https://nystateofpolitics.com/state-of-politics/new-york/politics/2025/06/28/bernie-sanders-endorses-mamdani-in-the-mayoral-race
State of Politics: Rep. Adriano Espaillat endorses Mamdani for mayor — https://nystateofpolitics.com/state-of-politics/new-york/politics/2025/07/18/rep--adriano-espaillat-endorses-mamdani-for-mayor
Queens Daily Eagle: Mamdani got Queens’ support on election day – can he now get it from his Queens colleagues? — https://queenseagle.com/all/mamdani-got-queens-support-on-election-day-can-he-now-get-it-from-his-queens-colleagues
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if Hakeem Jeffries publicly endorses Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-20, inclusive. For this market, an endorsement means a public statement by Jeffries or his office/campaign/official spokesperson explicitly urging support for Mamdani, stating that Jeffries endorses Mamdani, or clearly indicating that Jeffries will vote for Mamdani in the 2025 NYC mayoral general election during that window.

This question resolves No if no such endorsement occurs between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-20, inclusive.

A statement that is merely positive, conciliatory, or reports a meeting without explicit endorsement does not count. Neutral comments such as praising a conversation, saying Mamdani is the Democratic nominee, or criticizing other candidates without explicitly backing Mamdani do not qualify. If Jeffries explicitly endorses another candidate for NYC mayor during the resolution window, that is still a No for this question unless he also explicitly endorses Mamdani within the same window.

Primary resolution sources will be official statements from Jeffries, including his official House website, official social media accounts, press releases, or statements from his spokesperson. Secondary sources will be consensus reporting from major outlets such as AP, NYT, Gothamist, Politico, CNN, or Spectrum News NY1/State of Politics if they directly report an endorsement. If official and credible secondary sources conflict, official Jeffries statements take precedence. If the endorsement is first reported during the window but later shown to have occurred outside the window, resolution should be based on when the endorsement statement was actually made public.

If no authoritative source is available by 2025-09-27 confirming whether a qualifying endorsement occurred during 2025-09-01 to 2025-09-20, the question should be treated as unresolvable.

Proposed sources for resolution:
Hakeem Jeffries official website: https://jeffries.house.gov/
Hakeem Jeffries on X: https://x.com/RepJeffries
Associated Press: https://apnews.com/
New York Times: https://www.nytimes.com/
Spectrum News NY1 / State of Politics: https://nystateofpolitics.com/
subquestions.rationale: Jeffries is a high-profile New York Democratic leader whose endorsement would signal establishment acceptance of Mamdani. Harris is less likely to endorse if top party figures in New York continue to hold back, and more likely if they begin to unify behind the nominee. This makes Jeffries's decision a useful near-term indicator rather than a restatement of the ultimate question.

question: Will SpaceX Starship Flight Test 12 launch by November 30?
description:
If the 12th SpaceX Starship successfully launches from its launch pad by November 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Yes”. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The outcome of any launch will be corroborated by examining official video provided by SpaceX (https://www.youtube.com/c/SpaceX), as well as secondary video feeds and/or written reports if necessary.

Any subsequent anomaly (e.g., an explosion) after the launch will have no bearing on the outcome. Any name change of the Starship with another vehicle will have no bearing on the outcome of the market.

subquestions.question: Will the FAA issue or update a public airspace closure notice for a Starship/Super Heavy launch from Starbase with a validity window beginning on or before 2025-11-17?
subquestions.background_information:
A publicly posted FAA airspace closure for a Starship launch is a strong near-term operational indicator that SpaceX and regulators expect another launch attempt soon. After Starship Flight 11 launched successfully on 2025-10-13/14, reporting indicated it was SpaceX's fifth Starship flight of 2025 and followed an accelerated cadence discussed by Elon Musk of roughly one launch every 3-4 weeks, which would make another launch by late November plausible. Yahoo's Aug. 27 coverage notes Musk's stated cadence of "every 3 to 4 weeks" and that the FAA had approved up to 25 Starship test flights per year in May 2025: https://www.yahoo.com/news/spacex-launches-starship-most-successful-120000000.html . Reporting on Flight 11 also says the mission was the final launch from the original Pad 1 in its current configuration and that Pad 1 was being retrofitted afterward, while a new launch tower has been under construction, making regulatory and range scheduling milestones especially informative about whether Flight 12 can happen by Nov. 30. See Austin American-Statesman, 2025-10-13: https://www.statesman.com/story/news/state/2025/10/13/spacex-starship-flight-11-test-launch-starbase-texas-what-to-know/ .

For Starbase launches, temporary flight restrictions / notices affecting airspace are typically published through FAA systems and mirrored by third-party aviation aggregators. The appearance of such a notice with dates in the relevant window would be concrete evidence that SpaceX has progressed on regulatory coordination and launch scheduling, both important prerequisites for Flight 12. FAA TFR information is publicly searchable here: https://tfr.faa.gov/tfr2/list.html . Notice aggregators that often mirror Starbase-related FAA notices include the US Notices site: https://www.notams.faa.gov/ and FLY.faa.gov advisories: https://fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis.jsp .

Sources:
Yahoo News / launch cadence article: https://www.yahoo.com/news/spacex-launches-starship-most-successful-120000000.html
Austin American-Statesman / Flight 11 context: https://www.statesman.com/story/news/state/2025/10/13/spacex-starship-flight-11-test-launch-starbase-texas-what-to-know/
FAA TFR List: https://tfr.faa.gov/tfr2/list.html
FAA NOTAM Search: https://www.notams.faa.gov/
FAA Other Advisories: https://fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis.jsp
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 (inclusive), the FAA publishes or updates a publicly accessible airspace restriction/closure notice (including a TFR, NOTAM, or equivalent FAA advisory) that explicitly identifies Starbase/Boca Chica, Texas and clearly pertains to a Starship/Super Heavy launch operation, and the notice includes at least one validity period beginning on or before 2025-11-17.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying FAA notice is publicly posted between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 (inclusive).

Primary sources for resolution:
- FAA TFR list/search: https://tfr.faa.gov/tfr2/list.html
- FAA NOTAM search: https://www.notams.faa.gov/
- FAA advisories: https://fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis.jsp

A qualifying notice must be publicly viewable on at least one of the above FAA pages, or on an official FAA-hosted page linked from them, and must be specific enough that a reasonable resolver can identify it as for a Starship/Super Heavy launch from Starbase/Boca Chica rather than a generic local closure.

If the FAA systems are unavailable at resolution time, secondary evidence from reputable launch-tracking outlets may be used only to locate the underlying FAA notice, not to substitute for it. Examples include NASASpaceflight or Space Launch Schedule, but only if they reproduce the FAA notice number and text and the FAA source cannot be accessed directly. If no underlying FAA notice can be verified, the question resolves No.

If a notice is issued in the window but later canceled, the question still resolves Yes, because the issuance/update itself is the event being forecast.

If the notice appears before 2025-10-18, it does not count unless it is materially updated or republished between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 inclusive.

If the notice is posted within the window but all of its validity windows begin after 2025-11-17, it does not count.

Sources for resolution criteria:
FAA TFR List: https://tfr.faa.gov/tfr2/list.html
FAA NOTAM Search: https://www.notams.faa.gov/
FAA Advisories: https://fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis.jsp
subquestions.rationale: A public FAA airspace closure or equivalent notice is a concrete, externally observable precursor to launch. It captures regulatory readiness and an expected attempt window without merely asking whether Flight 12 launches earlier. Resolving this subquestion should significantly update expectations about whether Flight 12 can occur by Nov. 30.

question: Will Khamenei visit Russia by June 30?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Ali Khamenei visits Russia by June 30, 2026, 11:59PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A "visit" is defined as Ali Khamenei physically entering the terrestrial territory of Russia in a voluntary capacity. Whether or not Ali Khamenei enters Russian airspace or maritime territory during the timeframe of this market will have no bearing on a positive resolution.

Entering Russia requires physically entering sovereign Russian territory, including all Russian federal subjects and territories. Areas under Russian control but not under Russian sovereignty (e.g., Crimea) do not count. Russian airspace, Russian embassies/consulates abroad, and international zones do not constitute Russian sovereign territory.

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will a senior Russian or Iranian government official publicly state between 2026-01-10 and 2026-02-09 that Ali Khamenei has been invited to visit Russia, or that preparations are underway for such a visit?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term public acknowledgment of planning for a Khamenei trip to Russia would be a strong leading indicator for whether he later physically visits Russia. Russia and Iran already have active high-level channels: in October 2025, Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Ali Larijani met Vladimir Putin in Moscow and said he conveyed a message from Khamenei, indicating direct leader-level communication and an established pathway for arranging top-level contacts. See Tehran Times coverage: https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/509091/Larijani-and-Putin-discuss-economic-regional-and-international and RT coverage: https://www.rt.com/news/605987-russia-middle-east-syria-iran/. Russia and Iran also signed a strategic partnership treaty in January 2025, further institutionalizing bilateral ties; Reuters reported on the signing here: https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-iranian-president-sign-broad-cooperation-pact-kremlin-says-2025-01-17/ .

At the same time, as of 2026-01-10 there is no widely documented official announcement of a planned Khamenei trip to Russia. Recent reporting has instead focused on unrest in Iran and speculative claims that Khamenei could flee to Russia, but those reports are not themselves official confirmation of a diplomatic visit. For example, India Today summarized speculation on 2026-01-09: https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/ayatollah-ali-khamenei-flee-iran-russia-protests-israel-war-trump-remarks-2660404-2026-01-09 . Because the ultimate question requires a physical visit to sovereign Russian territory, an official statement about an invitation or preparations would materially shift expectations while remaining distinct from the final outcome.

This subquestion is not a restatement of the ultimate question: it asks about an observable precursor event in public diplomacy, not the visit itself.

Sources:
Tehran Times - Larijani and Putin discuss economic, regional and international cooperation in Moscow - https://www.tehrantimes.com/news/509091/Larijani-and-Putin-discuss-economic-regional-and-international
RT - Moscow’s Middle East makeover: From Syria to Tehran, the game has changed - https://www.rt.com/news/605987-russia-middle-east-syria-iran/
Reuters - Putin, Iranian president sign broad cooperation pact, Kremlin says - https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-iranian-president-sign-broad-cooperation-pact-kremlin-says-2025-01-17/
India Today - Khamenei has plan in place to flee Iran. Will protesters drive him out? - https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/ayatollah-ali-khamenei-flee-iran-russia-protests-israel-war-trump-remarks-2660404-2026-01-09
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-10 and 2026-02-09 inclusive, at least one senior Russian or Iranian government official publicly states that Ali Khamenei has been invited to visit Russia, is expected to visit Russia, or that preparations / arrangements / planning are underway for such a visit.

For this question, a "senior Russian or Iranian government official" includes: the Russian president, prime minister, foreign minister, presidential press secretary, Kremlin spokesperson, Iranian president, foreign minister, foreign ministry spokesperson, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, or an official statement published by the Kremlin, the Russian Foreign Ministry, the Iranian presidency, or the Iranian Foreign Ministry.

Qualifying statements must be public and attributable through one or more of the following sources: official government websites or readouts, or credible reporting quoting the official statement. Primary resolution sources are:
- Kremlin official site: http://en.kremlin.ru/ and http://kremlin.ru/
- Russian Foreign Ministry: https://mid.ru/en/ and https://mid.ru/
- Iranian Foreign Ministry: https://en.mfa.gov.ir/
- Iranian presidency: https://president.ir/en
- Reuters: https://www.reuters.com/
- AP: https://apnews.com/
- AFP: https://www.afp.com/

This question resolves No if no such qualifying public statement is made during the window from 2026-01-10 through 2026-02-09 inclusive.

Statements that merely discuss rumors that Khamenei might flee to Russia, generic comments about strong bilateral relations, or references to letters/messages from Khamenei without mentioning a visit to Russia do not count. Statements about visits to Crimea or other occupied territories that are not sovereign Russian territory do not count. If only anonymous-official reporting exists with no attributable public statement, the question resolves No.

If all primary official sources are unavailable, resolution may rely on a consensus of Reuters, AP, and AFP reporting. If reporting remains contradictory or insufficient to determine whether a qualifying public statement occurred within 2026-01-10 to 2026-02-09 inclusive, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A public acknowledgment of invitation or trip planning is a concrete precursor that would substantially increase the chance of an eventual Khamenei visit to Russia by the ultimate deadline. Forecasters who disagree on the ultimate question are likely to update meaningfully if official planning becomes public.

question: Will Han Duck-soo be sentenced to prison before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Han Duck-soo is sentenced to any time in jail/prison for charges related to the 2024 South Korean political crisis, including but not limited to allegations of failure to promulgate legislation, obstruction of constitutional processes, or other criminal acts stemming from his actions as Acting President and Prime Minister by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This market will remain open through 2026 regardless of whether Han Duck-soo's initial sentencing includes prison.  Any sentencing will qualify, regardless of subsequent appeals or changes to the sentence.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the South Korean government and law enforcement; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the Seoul Central District Court hold at least one additional scheduled hearing in Han Duck-soo's criminal case related to the 2024 martial law crisis between 2025-11-25 and 2025-12-25 (inclusive)?
subquestions.background_information:
Han Duck-soo was indicted in August 2025 on charges tied to South Korea's 2024 martial law crisis, including abetting insurrection, preparing false public documents, and perjury. Multiple reports state that prosecutors had earlier sought his arrest, but the court dismissed the detention request and he was indicted without detention, meaning the case is proceeding through ordinary criminal trial processes rather than pretrial detention proceedings. See The Korea Herald's Aug. 29, 2025 report: https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10563578 and Reuters-style coverage summarized by Anadolu Ajansı: https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/south-korean-prosecutors-indict-former-premier-first-lady-on-separate-charges/3670386

Han's trial reportedly began on Sept. 30, 2025, in Seoul. Coverage of the opening hearing says Han admitted some factual elements related to false statements but denied the core allegations, indicating the case is contested and likely to require multiple hearings rather than resolving immediately. See The Straits Times summary: https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-ex-pm-hans-martial-law-trial-begins and The Star's report: https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2025/09/30/ex-pm-han039s-trial-over-martial-law-crisis-kicks-off

In South Korea, a criminal case that continues to receive scheduled hearings after indictment is a practical indicator that prosecutors and the court are devoting sustained resources to adjudicating the charges. Continued hearing activity by late 2025 would be evidence that the case remains active and is moving toward merits resolution, which is relevant to whether Han could ultimately be sentenced before the ultimate market deadline. Conversely, if no additional hearing is scheduled or held in the near term, that could indicate delay, procedural disruption, or de-prioritization.

Sources:
The Korea Herald - Ex-PM Han indicted on abetment of insurrection, perjury charges - https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10563578
Anadolu Ajansı - South Korean prosecutors indict former premier, first lady on separate charges - https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/south-korean-prosecutors-indict-former-premier-first-lady-on-separate-charges/3670386
The Straits Times - South Korea ex-PM Han's martial law trial begins - https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/south-korea-ex-pm-hans-martial-law-trial-begins
The Star - Ex-PM Han's trial over martial law crisis kicks off - https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2025/09/30/ex-pm-han039s-trial-over-martial-law-crisis-kicks-off
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-25 and 2025-12-25 (inclusive), there is at least one additional scheduled hearing date in Han Duck-soo's criminal case related to the 2024 martial law crisis that is publicly confirmed by an official South Korean court source or by a consensus of at least two credible news reports stating that a hearing was held or scheduled within that window.

Primary resolution sources: official South Korean judiciary/court information, including the Supreme Court of Korea or Seoul Central District Court case/hearing notices if publicly available: https://www.scourt.go.kr and any Seoul Central District Court pages under that domain. If those sources are unavailable or do not clearly identify hearing dates, fallback sources will be major Korean or international news organizations such as Yonhap News Agency https://en.yna.co.kr/, The Korea Herald https://www.koreaherald.com/, and Reuters https://www.reuters.com/.

The question resolves No if no such additional hearing is publicly confirmed as held or scheduled during the window from 2025-11-25 through 2025-12-25.

Clarifications:
- 'Additional' means a hearing after the Sept. 30, 2025 opening hearing already reported in the press.
- A hearing counts if it is specifically identified as part of Han Duck-soo's criminal proceedings arising from the martial law crisis charges.
- If a hearing is scheduled during the window and later postponed beyond 2025-12-25 before it occurs, it still counts as Yes only if reliable reporting or official court information confirms that the hearing had in fact been scheduled for a date within the window.
- If all identified sources conflict irreconcilably or the event cannot be verified, the question should be considered unresolvable rather than guessed.
subquestions.rationale: A prison sentence before the ultimate deadline becomes more plausible if Han's case is actively progressing through hearings in late 2025. This is not a restatement of the ultimate question: it tracks procedural momentum in the trial, which is an early indicator of whether sentencing on the charged conduct is likely on a fast enough timeline.

question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $70 by end of June?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, on any trading day, the official CME settlement price for the Active Month (front month) of Crude Oil (CL) futures is equal to or above the listed price by the final trading day of June 2026. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No".

For CME Crude Oil (CL) futures contracts, the active month is the nearest of the contract months listed. The active month becomes a non-active month effective two business days prior to the spot month expiration. For example; if the spot month expires on a Friday the next listed contract will be considered the Active Month on the Wednesday prior to the spot month expiration.

Only the Active Month's official settlement price published by CME Group will be considered. Intraday trades, highs, lows, bids, offers, midpoint values, or indicative prices do not count.

Note that the settlement price may differ from the last traded price. CME's methodology to determine the settlement price can vary by commodity and contract.

Only days on which CME publishes an official settlement price for the Active Month will be included. Days without settlement prices (weekends, holidays, or market closures) are ignored.

This market will resolve based on the settlement price as it appears on the CME settlement page at the time it is first published for that trading day, regardless of any later corrections or updates.

The resolution source for this market is the CME Group website — specifically, the daily "Settlement" price for the Active Month of Crude Oil (CL) futures.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Energy Information Administration report total U.S. commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) below 415 million barrels in any Weekly Petroleum Status Report released between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-26?
subquestions.background_information:
A key driver of near-term WTI crude prices is the balance between supply and demand reflected in U.S. crude inventories. Lower commercial crude stocks generally indicate a tighter physical market, which tends to support higher front-month NYMEX WTI prices. This makes inventory draws a meaningful leading indicator for whether front-month CL could later rally to $70.

As of late December 2025, front-month WTI prices were still well below $70. AP reported that the February 2026 NYMEX Light Sweet Crude contract settled at $58.01 on 2025-12-22, showing the market would need a substantial rally to reach the ultimate target. https://apnews.com/ (article slug not provided in prompt; see cited AP market report "BC-OILS", 2025-12-22)

The EIA's Weekly Petroleum Status Report (WPSR) is the standard public source for U.S. commercial crude inventories excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve, and these data are closely watched by oil traders. The current WPSR series is published by the U.S. Energy Information Administration here: https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/ and the crude stocks series is available in EIA data tools, including series WCESTUS1 (U.S. Ending Stocks of Crude Oil, excluding SPR). https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=WCESTUS1&f=W

A threshold of 415 million barrels is chosen because it is low enough to indicate meaningful tightening, but still plausible within a one-month window if inventories continue to draw. If inventories fall below that level in early January 2026, forecasters should update upward on the chance of a price spike later in the first half of 2026.

Sources:
EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report - https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/
EIA crude oil stocks excluding SPR series WCESTUS1 - https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=WCESTUS1&f=W
AP market report reference (BC-OILS, 2025-12-22) - https://apnews.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, in any Weekly Petroleum Status Report first released between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-26 (inclusive), the U.S. Energy Information Administration reports U.S. commercial crude oil inventories excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve below 415.0 million barrels.

Primary resolution source: the EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report at https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/ and/or the corresponding EIA historical weekly series for U.S. Ending Stocks of Crude Oil excluding SPR (series WCESTUS1) at https://www.eia.gov/dnav/pet/hist/LeafHandler.ashx?n=PET&s=WCESTUS1&f=W

For resolution purposes:
- Only WPSR releases first published between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-26 (inclusive) count.
- The relevant value is the nationwide U.S. commercial crude oil inventory level excluding SPR, reported in million barrels.
- If any qualifying release shows a value strictly below 415.0 million barrels, the market resolves Yes.
- Otherwise it resolves No.
- Revisions published after 2026-01-26 do not count unless the original qualifying release within the window already displayed a sub-415.0 value.
- If the primary WPSR web page is unavailable, the EIA historical series page above will be used as fallback. If both are unavailable but the same data are available through another official EIA publication or API endpoint, that official EIA source will govern.
- If no qualifying WPSR release is published between 2025-12-27 and 2026-01-26, this question resolves No, not unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A drop in U.S. commercial crude inventories would be evidence of a tightening oil market and would increase the likelihood of a later upward move in front-month WTI toward $70. This is a different observable from the ultimate price target and should provide useful directional information.

question: David Baszucki out as Roblox CEO in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if David Baszucki ceases to be CEO of Roblox for any length of time between August 14, and December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

An announcement of David Baszucki's resignation/firing before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced resignation/firing goes into effect.

This market's primary resolution source will be official information from Roblox and/or David Baszucki, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Roblox publicly announce a new, company-wide child-safety or trust-and-safety leadership role reporting directly to the CEO or Board by 2025-10-31?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term signal for whether David Baszucki is at risk of leaving as CEO is whether Roblox responds to the current child-safety backlash with a visible governance escalation short of removing him. In August 2025, public pressure intensified after a Change.org petition demanding Baszucki’s resignation reportedly surpassed 250,000 signatures, tied to allegations that Roblox failed to adequately protect children on the platform. Multiple outlets also connected this backlash to a lawsuit by Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill alleging inadequate safety controls on Roblox. See Times of India coverage of the petition surpassing 250,000 signatures: https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/esports/news/roblox-communitys-push-for-ceo-david-baszuckis-exit-hits-over-250000-signatures-amidst-rising-controversies/articleshow/123546516.cms and MediaPost’s summary of the same controversy: https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/406142/thousands-of-roblox-users-urge-ceo-to-quit.html

Roblox has previously emphasized safety in public communications. For example, after backlash over the Schlep ban, reporting noted that Roblox posted a video featuring Baszucki, chief safety officer Matt Kaufman, and senior director of product policy Eliza Jacobs discussing the platform’s commitment to safety, civility, and freedom. That suggests Roblox may respond to pressure via organizational or leadership changes in safety rather than immediate CEO turnover. See Indy100: https://www.indy100.com/gaming/roblox-drama-explained-schlep-ban

Roblox is a large public company, so material senior leadership changes are often disclosed through investor-relations pages, SEC filings, newsroom posts, or executive LinkedIn/company bios. Roblox investor relations and SEC filings pages are here: https://ir.roblox.com/ and https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=1315098&owner=exclude

This subquestion is informative because a public move to create or elevate a senior safety post reporting to the CEO or Board would suggest the company is trying to contain governance pressure while retaining Baszucki, which may be evidence against imminent CEO removal. Conversely, failure to make such a move during intense scrutiny could leave CEO-level change more plausible.

Sources:
Times of India - Roblox community's push for CEO David Baszucki's exit hits over 250,000 signatures amidst rising controversies - https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/esports/news/roblox-communitys-push-for-ceo-david-baszuckis-exit-hits-over-250000-signatures-amidst-rising-controversies/articleshow/123546516.cms
MediaPost - Thousands Of Roblox Users Urge CEO To Quit - https://www.mediapost.com/publications/article/406142/thousands-of-roblox-users-urge-ceo-to-quit.html
Indy100 - Roblox drama explained as CEO under huge pressure after Schlep 'predator hunter' ban - https://www.indy100.com/gaming/roblox-drama-explained-schlep-ban
Roblox Investor Relations - https://ir.roblox.com/
SEC EDGAR - Roblox Corp filings - https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=1315098&owner=exclude
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive, Roblox publicly announces the appointment, creation, or formal elevation of a company-wide child-safety, trust-and-safety, or online-safety leadership role that (a) is described as an executive, head, chief, vice president, or equivalent senior role, and (b) is explicitly stated in the announcement or an authoritative company source to report directly to the CEO, to the Board of Directors, or to a Board committee.

This question resolves No if no such public announcement occurs between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-31 inclusive.

Qualifying announcements may appear in Roblox press releases/newsroom posts, investor-relations releases, SEC filings, or official Roblox corporate social-media posts that clearly identify the role and reporting line. Primary sources: Roblox Investor Relations (https://ir.roblox.com/), Roblox Newsroom or corporate site (https://corp.roblox.com/newsroom/ or successor pages on roblox.com/corp), and SEC filings for Roblox Corp (https://www.sec.gov/edgar/browse/?CIK=1315098&owner=exclude).

For resolution, the role must be company-wide; appointments limited to a product team, region, contractor, advisory council, or temporary task force do not count unless Roblox explicitly describes the role as having company-wide responsibility for platform safety/trust and safety. A mere mention that an existing executive 'focuses on safety' does not count unless the company publicly announces a new role, newly elevated remit, or appointment during the window.

If the reporting line is not explicit in the initial announcement, secondary confirmation from Roblox’s official executive leadership page, an SEC filing, or an official company spokesperson statement published by a credible outlet may be used. If no authoritative source clearly establishes both the role and qualifying reporting line by the end of the window, resolve No.

If Roblox announces the role during the window but states the appointment is contingent and later canceled before 2025-10-31, resolve No. If the announcement is made during the window and the effective date is later, resolve Yes, because the question is about public announcement, not assumption of duties.
subquestions.rationale: A visible safety-governance escalation is a plausible substitute for CEO removal amid current pressure on Baszucki. If Roblox creates or elevates a senior safety role reporting to the CEO or Board, that likely indicates the company is attempting to stabilize the situation without replacing the CEO, which is evidence against the ultimate question resolving Yes. If no such move occurs despite sustained backlash, pressure for a CEO change may remain more acute.

question: Will the U.S. national debt hit $38 trillion in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the U.S. national debt reaches the listed value this year at any point by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be the U.S. Treasury Department (https://www.treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current). If treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current becomes unavailable, another credible source will be used.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Treasury's Total Public Debt Outstanding increase by at least $120 billion between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-19?
subquestions.background_information:
The ultimate question asks whether U.S. national debt will hit $38 trillion in 2025. A key near-term indicator is the pace of debt accumulation over the next few weeks. The U.S. Treasury reported that total public debt outstanding surpassed $37 trillion in August 2025, after rising from $34 trillion in January 2024, $35 trillion in July 2024, and $36 trillion in November 2024, implying an increase of roughly $1 trillion about every five months recently. AP reported this milestone on 2025-08-12, citing Treasury data: https://apnews.com/article/us-national-debt-37-trillion-treasury-2025 and Treasury's own daily debt data are published here: https://www.treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current . Fortune similarly noted that another $1 trillion would be added in about 173 days at the then-current daily pace, which is roughly $5.8 billion per day; over 19 days, that pace would imply about $110 billion of additional debt, making a $120 billion threshold plausible but not trivial: https://fortune.com/2025/08/29/us-national-debt-37-trillion-record-years-sooner-than-pre-pandemic-projections/ .

This subquestion is not a restatement of the ultimate question because it asks about short-run growth rate, not whether debt reaches a specific headline level. If debt grows by at least $120 billion in the first 19 days of October, that would be evidence that the debt trajectory is steep enough to make hitting $38 trillion later in 2025 more likely; if growth is materially slower, it would suggest a lower near-term pace.

Sources:
- U.S. Treasury, Debt to the Penny and Current Debt: https://www.treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current
- AP News, U.S. national debt reaches a record $37 trillion: https://apnews.com/article/us-national-debt-37-trillion-treasury-2025
- Fortune, National debt hits a record $37 trillion: https://fortune.com/2025/08/29/us-national-debt-37-trillion-record-years-sooner-than-pre-pandemic-projections/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if the value of 'Total Public Debt Outstanding' reported by the U.S. Treasury increases by at least $120,000,000,000 between 2025-10-01 and 2025-10-19, inclusive.

Primary source: the U.S. Treasury's Current Debt page / Debt to the Penny data at https://www.treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current .

Operationally, let S be the first published Treasury value for Total Public Debt Outstanding on 2025-10-01, and let E be the last published Treasury value for Total Public Debt Outstanding on 2025-10-19. The question resolves Yes if E - S >= $120,000,000,000; otherwise it resolves No.

If Treasury does not publish a value on 2025-10-01 or 2025-10-19, use the first published value after 00:00 ET on 2025-10-01 for S, and the last published value before 23:59 ET on 2025-10-19 for E, using the same Treasury series. If the Current Debt page is unavailable, resolvers should use the Treasury's Debt to the Penny dataset or a substantially identical Treasury-published series accessible via TreasuryDirect. If no Treasury-published data for these dates can be retrieved, the question should resolve as unresolvable rather than relying on non-Treasury secondary estimates.

Only changes occurring within the window from 2025-10-01 through 2025-10-19 inclusive count toward resolution.

Sources for resolution:
- U.S. Treasury Current Debt: https://www.treasurydirect.gov/NP_WS/debt/current
- TreasuryDirect Debt to the Penny (landing page): https://www.treasurydirect.gov/govt/reports/pd/pd_debttothepenny.htm
subquestions.rationale: A short-term acceleration in debt growth is one of the most direct leading indicators for whether total debt is likely to reach $38 trillion later in 2025. Forecasters who disagree about the ultimate question may disagree mainly about the near-term accumulation rate; resolving this subquestion would meaningfully update those views.

question: Will CME self certify a sports contract in 2025?
description:
This market resolves to “Yes” if CME Group files a self-certification under CFTC Regulation 40.2 for at least one sport-based event contract by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, it resolves to “No.”

For this market, “self-certify” means CME, acting as a DCM or self-listing exchange, submits a written certification per 17 C.F.R. § 40.2 that the contract complies with the Commodity Exchange Act and CFTC regulations. The contract must explicitly reference a sporting event (e.g. game result, player performance, etc.). Announcements alone do not qualify; the filing must be made and publicly verifiable.

The resolution source will be the CFTC’s public filings, CME’s disclosures, and a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will CME Group or a CME-affiliated entity publicly announce between 2025-10-09 and 2025-11-08 that it intends to list, self-certify, or otherwise launch a sport-based event contract in the U.S.?
subquestions.background_information:
A public statement of intent by CME would be a meaningful leading indicator for whether CME ultimately files a CFTC Regulation 40.2 self-certification for a sports contract in 2025, because exchanges typically socialize controversial new product categories before filing or launch. CME is already active in event-contract infrastructure: reporting in July 2025 said the CFTC granted CME relief related to certain margined event contracts, conditional on CME publishing contract terms and clearing them through its DCO, indicating CME has been laying groundwork for event-contract listings more broadly (JD Supra, 2025-07-26: https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/global-moves-digital-shifts-july-2025-6209777/). Separately, FanDuel’s partnership with CME was described in September 2025 as an entry into prediction markets, initially for non-sporting events, while leaving open a possible path toward broader event-contract offerings later in the year (Yahoo Sports, 2025-09-02: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/theres-many-ways-sportsbooks-prediction-110000000.html ; Covers, 2025-08-26: https://www.covers.com/industry/ohio-warns-sportsbooks-contemplating-prediction-market-services-august-26-2025). 

At the same time, the regulatory environment around sports event contracts is highly active. A September 30, 2025 CFTC advisory specifically addressed exchange-listed sports event contracts and noted that several DCMs had already listed such contracts via self-certification rather than formal approval, while warning market participants about litigation and state enforcement risk (JD Supra, 2025-10-07: https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/boundaries-of-banking-and-markets-5313072/). Other exchanges and platforms have continued to move aggressively: Kalshi reportedly self-certified new football player-stat contracts in September 2025 (Yahoo Sports, 2025-09-16: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/kalshi-self-certifies-wide-array-230000000.html), and QCEX/Polymarket filings reportedly covered athletic-event and athletic-spread contracts scheduled for listing no earlier than October 2, 2025 (Covers, 2025-10-01: https://www.covers.com/industry/polymarket-preparing-sports-betting-included-return-to-us-october-1-2025). 

CME leadership has also publicly engaged on prediction-market regulation. At a late-September SEC-CFTC roundtable, CME CEO Terry Duffy argued against a regulatory double standard while highlighting the company’s FanDuel partnership, though reporting said the initial focus was economic indicators rather than sports (Yahoo Sports, 2025-09-29: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/sports-event-contracts-largely-ignored-210000000.html). Because CME has not yet publicly committed to sports contracts, a new explicit statement of intent during this window would materially update expectations about the ultimate question.

Sources:
JD Supra - Global Moves, Digital Shifts, July 2025 - CFTC Relief for Event Contracts — https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/global-moves-digital-shifts-july-2025-6209777/
Yahoo Sports - There Are Many Ways Sportsbooks Can Get Into Event Contracts -- But FanDuel's Path Looks Promising — https://sports.yahoo.com/article/theres-many-ways-sportsbooks-prediction-110000000.html
Covers - Ohio Warns Sportsbooks Contemplating Prediction Market Services — https://www.covers.com/industry/ohio-warns-sportsbooks-contemplating-prediction-market-services-august-26-2025
JD Supra - Boundaries of Banking and Markets, October 2025 - CFTC's Advisory on Exchange-Listed Sports Event Contracts — https://www.jdsupra.com/legalnews/boundaries-of-banking-and-markets-5313072/
Yahoo Sports - Kalshi Self-Certifies For Wide Array Of New Player Props, Election Parlays — https://sports.yahoo.com/article/kalshi-self-certifies-wide-array-230000000.html
Covers - Polymarket Preparing Sports Betting-Included Return to U.S. — https://www.covers.com/industry/polymarket-preparing-sports-betting-included-return-to-us-october-1-2025
Yahoo Sports - Sports Event Contracts Largely Ignored As Kalshi and Polymarket CEOs Speak At SEC-CFTC Roundtable — https://sports.yahoo.com/article/sports-event-contracts-largely-ignored-210000000.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-09 and 2025-11-08 (inclusive), CME Group Inc. or a majority-owned CME affiliate publicly states in a press release, official website post, investor presentation/transcript, CME rule filing/disclosure, or an on-the-record statement reported by at least one credible business or legal-news outlet that it intends to list, self-certify, launch, or offer a sport-based event contract in the United States. Statements that the company is 'exploring' or 'monitoring' sports contracts without indicating intent to proceed do not count.

For this question, a 'sport-based event contract' means a contract whose payoff is explicitly tied to a sporting event, game result, player performance/statistics, spread, total score, or comparable athletic-event outcome. General comments about prediction markets or event contracts that only mention economics, politics, weather, or other non-sports subjects do not count.

Primary sources for resolution should be CME's official newsroom and investor-relations materials (https://www.cmegroup.com/media-room.html and https://investor.cmegroup.com/), plus any relevant CME rule/disclosure pages on https://www.cmegroup.com/. If no qualifying official CME statement is available but a qualifying statement is quoted on the record in at least one credible outlet, that may be used as evidence, with outlets such as Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), Bloomberg (https://www.bloomberg.com/), Yahoo Sports (https://sports.yahoo.com/), Covers (https://www.covers.com/industry), or JD Supra (https://www.jdsupra.com/) as secondary sources.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying public statement appears between 2025-10-09 and 2025-11-08 (inclusive). If an apparent announcement is later shown to be misdated, unauthenticated, or not actually public within the window, it does not count. If the only relevant statement is materially ambiguous as to whether CME intends to proceed with a sports contract, resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: An explicit public commitment by CME to pursue sports event contracts is a strong near-term precursor to an actual self-certification filing, while still being meaningfully different from the ultimate question. It captures business intent and willingness to absorb regulatory/reputational risk before a formal filing occurs.

question: Will SpaceX Starship Flight Test 11 Superheavy explode?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the booster for the eleventh Starship-SuperHeavy test explodes at any point during the test from the start of fueling operations to 60 minutes after it makes contact with Earth upon landing. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An explosion is defined as a violent and catastrophic event resulting in the destruction of all or part of the vehicle, regardless of intent or context (e.g., a planned termination event would also count).

If the eleventh launch has not occurred by February 28, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

Note: The sixth Starship-SuperHeavy test flight which exploded after executing controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico would qualify for a "Yes" resolution.

The resolution source for this market will be official video provided by SpaceX (https://www.youtube.com/c/SpaceX), as well as secondary video feeds and/or written reports if necessary.

subquestions.question: Will SpaceX complete a full-duration static fire of the Super Heavy booster intended for Starship Flight Test 11 between 2025-09-10 and 2025-10-10?
subquestions.background_information:
A successful full-duration static fire of the specific Super Heavy booster assigned to Flight Test 11 would be a strong near-term indicator that the booster is healthy enough to proceed toward launch with lower immediate technical risk. SpaceX commonly uses static fires as a major integrated preflight check for propulsion, ground systems, and vehicle plumbing. Recent Starship testing has shown that booster reliability remains a live issue: Flight 9's Super Heavy was lost after a landing-burn experiment, and SpaceX said it would not repeat that angle-of-attack experiment on future flights. See The Register's summary of SpaceX's explanation: https://www.theregister.com/2025/08/18/spacex_starship_flight_10/ .

Flight 10, launched on 2025-08-26/27, was a relative success for the booster: one engine failed during ascent, but the mission continued and the booster performed a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico before a planned post-splashdown explosion. This suggests progress, but also that engine-out conditions and terminal-phase robustness are still relevant concerns for the next booster flight. See The Register: https://www.theregister.com/2025/08/27/spacex_starship_flight_10/ and BNO News: https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/spacex-starship-completes-10th-test-flight-ends-in-splashdown-explosion/ .

The June 2025 Massey test-site anomaly, which destroyed a prototype intended for Flight 10, was attributed by SpaceX to a fault involving a composite overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV), after which SpaceX said it would add inspections and proof tests and operate future COPVs at lower pressure. That history makes any demonstrated, vehicle-specific ground test on the actual Flight 11 booster especially informative. Gizmodo summarizes SpaceX's stated corrective actions here: https://gizmodo.com/watch-live-as-spacex-tries-to-prove-starship-isnt-a-total-flop-with-flight-10-2000641204 .

Because the ultimate question asks whether the Flight 11 Super Heavy booster will explode during its test window, evidence that the actual booster has passed a major integrated firing test should update forecasts downward on explosion risk; failure to achieve such a test by early October could indicate schedule pressure, unresolved technical issues, or lower readiness.

Sources:
The Register - SpaceX gets ready for a tenth Starship flight test - https://www.theregister.com/2025/08/18/spacex_starship_flight_10/
The Register - SpaceX's Starship keeps it together for Flight Test 10 - https://www.theregister.com/2025/08/27/spacex_starship_flight_10/
BNO News - SpaceX Starship completes 10th test flight; ends in splashdown explosion - https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/spacex-starship-completes-10th-test-flight-ends-in-splashdown-explosion/
Gizmodo - Watch Live as SpaceX Tries to Prove Starship Isn't a Total Flop With Flight 10 - https://gizmodo.com/watch-live-as-spacex-tries-to-prove-starship-isnt-a-total-flop-with-flight-10-2000641204
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-10 and 2025-10-10 (inclusive), SpaceX publicly shows or clearly announces completion of a full-duration static fire of the specific Super Heavy booster intended to fly on Starship Flight Test 11.

For this question:
- "Full-duration static fire" means a static fire that SpaceX, or contemporaneous reporting based on SpaceX statements, describes as the planned or full-duration firing for that booster rather than a brief spin-prime, partial test, or engine chill test.
- "Intended to fly on Starship Flight Test 11" means the booster is identified by SpaceX or reliable spaceflight reporting as the booster assigned to Flight Test 11 at the time of the static fire.

Primary sources for resolution:
- SpaceX official updates/posts: https://x.com/SpaceX
- SpaceX official video channel: https://www.youtube.com/c/SpaceX
- SpaceX website/news: https://www.spacex.com/

Secondary sources if SpaceX evidence is incomplete but the event is widely documented with attribution to SpaceX:
- NASASpaceflight: https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/
- The Register: https://www.theregister.com/
- Ars Technica: https://arstechnica.com/

Resolution notes:
- A static fire of a different booster does not count.
- A cryogenic proof test or wet dress rehearsal without engine ignition does not count.
- A very short ignition that is explicitly characterized as aborted, partial, or not the planned full-duration static fire does not count.
- If sources conflict on whether the firing was full-duration, priority goes to explicit SpaceX characterization; otherwise, the question resolves based on the preponderance of authoritative reporting.
- If no qualifying full-duration static fire occurs between 2025-09-10 and 2025-10-10 (inclusive), resolve No.
subquestions.rationale: This is a concrete prelaunch readiness indicator for the exact hardware relevant to the ultimate question. Passing a major integrated ground firing should reduce estimated odds of an in-test booster explosion, while failure to reach that milestone in time may indicate unresolved technical issues or rushed operations that raise explosion risk.

question: Will Atlas have a Windows app live by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Atlas, the web browser by OpenAI, has a native Windows desktop application publicly available for download in the U.S. by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The application must be officially released by OpenAI or through official Atlas communication channels.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from OpenAI; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will OpenAI publicly state between 2025-10-23 and 2025-11-22 that Atlas for Windows is available via a beta, preview, waitlist, or early-access program?
subquestions.background_information:
Atlas launched on macOS on October 21, 2025, and multiple contemporaneous reports say Windows support is expected soon, but as of 2025-10-23 there is no confirmed public Windows download. TechStory reported that Atlas is available on macOS and that Windows, iOS, and Android would launch "in the coming weeks" (https://techstory.in/openai-unveils-chatgpt-atlas-revolutionizing-web-browsing/). VentureBeat likewise reported that Atlas is globally available on macOS, with Windows support expected soon (https://venturebeat.com/ai/openai-releases-chatgpt-atlas-an-ai-enabled-web-browser-to-challenge-google-chrome/). OpenAI often uses staged rollouts, betas, previews, and waitlists for major products before broad release; if OpenAI opens any public Windows beta/preview/waitlist for Atlas by late November, that would be a strong near-term indicator that a full Windows app by December 31 is on track. This is meaningfully different from the ultimate question because it asks about a precursor distribution milestone rather than whether a native Windows app is fully live for public download in the U.S. by year-end.

Sources:
TechStory - OpenAI Unveils ChatGPT Atlas, Revolutionizing Web Browsing - https://techstory.in/openai-unveils-chatgpt-atlas-revolutionizing-web-browsing/
VentureBeat - OpenAI releases ChatGPT Atlas, an AI-enabled web browser to challenge Google Chrome - https://venturebeat.com/ai/openai-releases-chatgpt-atlas-an-ai-enabled-web-browser-to-challenge-google-chrome/
