If by 2025-12-07 no authoritative public information is available to determine the count, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Repeated official scrambles by front-line NATO states are an observable sign that Russian strike patterns are creating acute spillover risk near alliance territory. A high scramble count indicates sustained Russian operations close enough to NATO borders to trigger military response, which should materially raise the probability of an actual Russian aerial impact on NATO territory before year-end.

question: Will Russia capture Drobysheve by February 28?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the intersection between Derzhavna Vulytsya and Slobozhanska Vulytsya located in Drobysheve, Donetsk Oblast,(49°02'31.4"N 37°43'54.7"E) by February 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.

The intersection will be considered captured if any part of the intersection is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by the specified date, the market will resolve to “No”.

For any change on the ISW map to qualify for this market’s resolution, the relevant shading indicating Russian control must persist through the next full ISW daily update cycle. If ISW skips a day, shading must persist until the next finalized ISW update is published, regardless of the date. Any continuous shading which reflects either “Assessed Russian Control”, “Assessed Russian Advance In Ukraine”, or “Assessed Russian Gains in the Past 24 Hours” will qualify. “Assessed Russian Infiltration Areas in Ukraine” will not qualify.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded red in the ISW map. An announcement of a negotiated settlement which gives Russia de jure control will not qualify. Actual control must be established.

Once Russia captures the intersection, any subsequent loss of control will not be considered towards the resolution of this market.

Intersection Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/D1.png

Intersection Location in Drobysheve: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/D2.png

Drobysheve Location: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/D3.png

Location on Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/v4o2xVfT89B3LHKM7

The primary resolution source for this market will be the ISW Ukraine map. If the ISW map is rendered unavailable, information from DeepStateMap (https://deepstatemap.live/) may be used. If information from both the ISW and DeepStateMap are rendered permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used.

Note: Any temporary glitches or errors in the map will not be considered.

subquestions.question: Will the ISW map show any part of the settlement of Karpivka, Donetsk Oblast (approximately 49.048°N, 37.706°E), as under Russian control or Russian advance by 2026-02-26?
subquestions.background_information:
Drobysheve lies just east-northeast of Karpivka, and Russian progress into or through Karpivka would be a meaningful operational indicator for whether Russian forces are closing the western/northwestern approach needed to secure Drobysheve’s remaining contested area. A move into Karpivka would suggest that Russian forces are not merely conducting temporary infiltration in the Drobysheve area but are broadening and consolidating local control.

The ultimate market is based on ISW map shading at a specific intersection inside Drobysheve. ISW’s mapping distinguishes between assessed Russian control/advance/gains and mere infiltration; this matters because recent reporting has highlighted that Russian claims of capture can be exaggerated and that infiltration does not always translate into durable control. ISW has recently pushed back on inflated Russian territorial claims, including claims by Gerasimov, emphasizing that some reported advances lacked supporting evidence: https://charter97.org/en/news/2026/1/28/627711/ . ISW’s own mapping products and legend are hosted here: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 .

Recent reporting specifically claimed that Russian forces were 'completing the capture of Drobysheve' and advancing in the nearby Lyman/Sloviansk axis, but these claims came from Russian or pro-Russian sources and should be treated cautiously as signals rather than facts: https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/01/27/ . Another report claimed an enemy group in Drobysheve had been trapped and destroyed, again reflecting Russian official statements rather than neutral confirmation: https://tass.com/politics/ . Because of this uncertainty, an adjacent-settlement indicator like Karpivka is useful: if ISW itself starts shading Karpivka red, that would be a stronger sign that Russian pressure around Drobysheve is translating into map-confirmed control.

This subquestion is not a restatement of the ultimate question because it concerns a different location. It is an early indicator: Russian-confirmed expansion into Karpivka before late February would raise the odds that the specific Drobysheve intersection is captured by February 28, while failure to do so would be evidence against rapid nearby consolidation.

Sources:
ISW Ukraine map: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375
Charter97 summary of ISW criticism of Russian claims (2026-01-28): https://charter97.org/en/news/2026/1/28/627711/
PravdaReport article on Russian claims near Drobysheve/Lyman (2026-01-27): https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2026/01/27/
TASS politics coverage (for cited Russian official claims context): https://tass.com/politics/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-30 and 2026-02-26 inclusive, the Institute for the Study of War (ISW) Ukraine map shows any part of the settlement of Karpivka, Donetsk Oblast, shaded as any of the following: 'Assessed Russian Control,' 'Assessed Russian Advance in Ukraine,' or 'Assessed Russian Gains in the Past 24 Hours.' 'Assessed Russian Infiltration Areas in Ukraine' does not count.

As with the ultimate market, for any qualifying ISW shading to count, it must persist through the next full ISW daily update cycle. If ISW skips a day, the shading must remain until the next finalized ISW update is published. Temporary glitches or obvious map errors do not count.

The primary source for resolution is the ISW Ukraine map and daily updates: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375 . If the ISW map becomes permanently unavailable, the fallback source is DeepStateMap: https://deepstatemap.live/ . Under the fallback, the question resolves Yes if DeepStateMap shows Karpivka within the red Russian-controlled area between 2026-01-30 and 2026-02-26 inclusive. If both ISW and DeepStateMap become permanently unavailable, a consensus of credible reporting may be used, but only if multiple independent reputable outlets clearly report that Russian forces established control over at least part of Karpivka during the window.

If no qualifying map depiction or qualifying fallback evidence occurs between 2026-01-30 and 2026-02-26 inclusive, the question resolves No. If source failure or ambiguity makes the question impossible to determine, it should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: Karpivka is adjacent to the Drobysheve fight and likely lies on a relevant approach/contiguous zone of control. Russian-confirmed expansion there would be a strong early indicator that Russian forces are successfully consolidating the local area rather than only probing or infiltrating, which materially increases the chance of capturing the target intersection in Drobysheve by February 28.

question: Will BTS release any tracks in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if BTS (방탄소년단) releases any new music track credited to the group between June 3 and December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The track must be publicly released through major music platforms (e.g., Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube) and must be announced via official BTS or BigHit Music channels. The release must include new musical content; re-releases, remasters, or compilations of previously released songs do not count unless they contain newly recorded material.

Tracks released by individual members, sub-units, or under any designation other than "BTS" as a group will not count toward resolution.

The resolution source will be any official BTS streaming or download site, e.g. Apple Music or Spotify.

subquestions.question: Will BigHit Music or BTS officially announce a BTS group album or single release scheduled for on or before 2026-03-31 between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29?
subquestions.background_information:
A formal announcement of a group comeback is a useful leading indicator for whether BTS will release any new group track in late 2025, because it would show that BigHit and the group have moved from general comeback talk to a concrete release plan. Multiple late-2025 reports say BTS completed 2025 album recording sessions around November 1, 2025 and that a spring 2026 release is expected, suggesting material exists even if the main comeback is planned for 2026 rather than 2025. ScreenRant reported on 2025-11-12 that BigHit Music had the 2026 world tour still 'undecided' while album recording sessions had concluded and a spring 2026 release was expected: https://screenrant.com/ . Mashable Middle East similarly reported on 2025-10-29 that RM had confirmed album photos and music videos were in production, with release expected in late March 2026: https://me.mashable.com/entertainment/ . Pinkvilla reported on 2025-07-10 that BTS members were working on a new album and conducting a song camp in the U.S.: https://www.pinkvilla.com/entertainment/bts-surpasses-impressive-44-billion-spotify-streams-across-group-and-members-solo-credits-1394377 .

Because the ultimate market asks whether BTS will release any new group track in 2025, an official late-2025 announcement of a specific group album or single would be informative in two ways. First, it would confirm that group-level release machinery is active: scheduling, marketing, and official communications. Second, if the announcement happens before year-end, it raises the chance of pre-release promotional content, soundtrack tie-ins, or advance singles. Conversely, the absence of any official announcement by late December 2025 would support the view that BigHit is holding all new BTS group music for the planned 2026 comeback window.

Official announcement channels are active and publicly accessible. BigHit Music publishes notices on Weverse and HYBE labels channels, while BTS maintains official social media and YouTube presences where comeback announcements are typically surfaced. Relevant official channels include BigHit Music on Weverse: https://weverse.io/bts/notice and HYBE LABELS on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@HYBELABELS .

Sources:
ScreenRant - BTS's World Tour Delay: What It Means for K-Pop's Future - https://screenrant.com/
Mashable Middle East - BTS, BLACKPINK, and more K-pop groups set to drop new albums soon - https://me.mashable.com/entertainment/
Pinkvilla - BTS surpasses impressive 44 billion Spotify streams across group and members' solo credits - https://www.pinkvilla.com/entertainment/bts-surpasses-impressive-44-billion-spotify-streams-across-group-and-members-solo-credits-1394377
Weverse BTS notices - https://weverse.io/bts/notice
HYBE LABELS YouTube - https://www.youtube.com/@HYBELABELS
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive, an official BTS or BigHit Music channel publicly posts an announcement that explicitly states BTS, as the full group, will release an album, single, or other group music release with a scheduled release date on or before 2026-03-31.

Qualifying official channels include, but are not limited to:
- BTS Weverse notices: https://weverse.io/bts/notice
- BTS official X account: https://x.com/BTS_twt
- BIGHIT MUSIC / HYBE official notices or news pages: https://ibighit.com/ and https://hybecorp.com/
- HYBE LABELS YouTube community/posts/videos: https://www.youtube.com/@HYBELABELS

The announcement must unambiguously refer to BTS as a group, not a solo member or sub-unit. Teasers, press rumors, or third-party media reports do not count unless they directly reproduce or link to an official announcement from one of the above channels. General statements such as 'BTS is preparing a comeback' do not count unless they include a scheduled release date or release window specific enough to establish that the release is on or before 2026-03-31.

This question resolves No if no such official announcement appears between 2025-11-30 and 2025-12-29 inclusive.

If all identified official sources become unavailable, resolution should use archived captures of those official pages/posts (for example via the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org/) or widely cited screenshots that clearly show the official account name, date, and announcement text. If no reliable evidence remains available, the question should be treated as unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: A concrete official comeback announcement is a meaningful operational indicator of whether BTS group-release activity is imminent. It is not the same as asking whether a 2025 track releases; rather, it asks whether the label/group publicly commits to a group music schedule, which should substantially update forecasts on near-term releases.

question: Will the Canberra Raiders win the 2025 National Rugby League?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Canberra Raiders win the 2025 National Rugby League. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

If at any point it becomes impossible for this team to win the National Rugby League based on the rules of the NRL (e.g. they are eliminated in the playoff bracket), this market will resolve immediately to "No".

subquestions.question: Will the Canberra Raiders finish the 2025 NRL regular season in 1st or 2nd place on the official ladder?
subquestions.background_information:
A top-two finish is a strong early indicator for winning the NRL premiership because it confers the double chance in Week 1 of the finals and, for Canberra specifically, likely home-ground advantage deep into the finals. The NRL finals format gives teams finishing 1st–4th a qualifying final in Week 1, with 1st and 2nd receiving a second chance if they lose; the NRL's official finals structure sets out this pathway clearly: https://www.nrl.com/operations/the-game/finals/

This is especially relevant for Canberra in 2025. Reporting before 2025-09-01 noted that the Raiders were leading the ladder and that GIO Stadium had been approved to host a preliminary final if Canberra secured home-ground advantage. Sporting News reported on 2025-07-21 that Canberra were pursuing a top-two finish and could host two finals matches at GIO Stadium if they got there: https://www.sportingnews.com/au/rugby-league/news/green-machine-gets-green-light-nrl-confirms-canberra-preliminary-final/ . News.com.au also reported on 2025-08-22 that Canberra were ladder leaders and close to locking up the minor premiership after defeating Penrith: https://www.news.com.au/sport/nrl/remarkable-raiders-golden-point-madness-leaves-cleary-panthers-shattered/news-story/ . Fox Sports and Sporting News coverage through July and August similarly described Canberra as top-of-the-table contenders and highlighted their strong home form, including winning eight of their last nine home games by late July: https://www.foxsports.com.au/nrl/nrl-premiership/nrl-2025-newcastle-knights-v-canberra-raiders-live-blog-stats-scores-teams-where-to-watch-start-time-jamal-fogarty-kalyn-ponga-rugby-league-news/news-story/ and https://www.sportingnews.com/au/rugby-league/news/canberra-second-half-raiders-do-it-again-finals-challenge-laid-bare-nrl-rivals/ .

Because the Raiders were already near the top entering September, whether they actually lock in a top-two regular-season finish by the end of the regular season is a concrete and highly informative signal about their premiership chances without merely restating the ultimate question.

Sources:
NRL Finals format - https://www.nrl.com/operations/the-game/finals/
Sporting News: Green Machine gets green light -- NRL confirms Canberra preliminary final - https://www.sportingnews.com/au/rugby-league/news/green-machine-gets-green-light-nrl-confirms-canberra-preliminary-final/
News.com.au: Raiders' golden point madness leaves Cleary, Panthers shattered - https://www.news.com.au/sport/nrl/remarkable-raiders-golden-point-madness-leaves-cleary-panthers-shattered/news-story/
Fox Sports: Newcastle Knights v Canberra Raiders preview - https://www.foxsports.com.au/nrl/nrl-premiership/nrl-2025-newcastle-knights-v-canberra-raiders-live-blog-stats-scores-teams-where-to-watch-start-time-jamal-fogarty-kalyn-ponga-rugby-league-news/news-story/
Sporting News: Canberra 'second-half' Raiders do it again - https://www.sportingnews.com/au/rugby-league/news/canberra-second-half-raiders-do-it-again-finals-challenge-laid-bare-nrl-rivals/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
Start date: 2025-09-01. End date: 2025-09-07.

This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-07 (inclusive), the official final 2025 NRL regular-season ladder published by the NRL shows the Canberra Raiders in 1st or 2nd place after all regular-season matches are complete.

This question resolves No if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-07 (inclusive), the official final 2025 NRL regular-season ladder published by the NRL shows the Canberra Raiders in 3rd place or lower after all regular-season matches are complete.

Primary source: the official NRL ladder on NRL.com, or the official NRL match centre/competition pages documenting the completed regular season: https://www.nrl.com/ladder/ and https://www.nrl.com/draw/

If the NRL ladder page layout changes, resolution should use any official NRL.com page showing the final regular-season standings. If NRL.com is temporarily unavailable, a secondary source may be the Australian Rugby League Commission / NRL official app or an official finals-fixture page on NRL.com reflecting the Week 1 finals matchups consistent with ladder positions 1–4. If the regular season has not been completed by 2025-09-07 due to postponement or extraordinary disruption, this question should be considered unresolvable rather than guessing from an incomplete ladder.

Tiebreakers are whatever the official NRL ladder applies at the end of the regular season; no independent recalculation should be used.
subquestions.rationale: A top-two finish materially improves Canberra's title odds via the double chance and likely home finals, making it one of the clearest near-term indicators of whether they are on a premiership-winning path.

question: GPT transaction fees by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if OpenAI integrates agentic taker fees or another form of a transaction-based commission model into ChatGPT, GPT-4, GPT-4.1, GPT-5, or any successor general-purpose GPT model made publicly available by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Qualifying commission models include agentic taker fees, marketplace transaction fees, referral and affiliate fees, etc.

Limited releases restricted to a specific region, model, or user group will qualify. The release must be publicly announced as accessible to the relevant users. Closed betas or fully private testing do not count.

Once implemented, the market will resolve to “Yes” immediately, regardless of whether the integration is later removed.

An announcement will not suffice to resolve this market to "Yes"; only the release of a qualifying commission model integration will trigger a "Yes" resolution for this market.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from OpenAI; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will OpenAI publicly announce between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 that ChatGPT agent, Codex, or another GPT-powered OpenAI product has completed a purchase, booking, checkout, or paid subscription sign-up on behalf of a user using an integrated third-party merchant or service flow?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term indicator for whether OpenAI will add transaction-based commissions to ChatGPT is whether OpenAI expands its agent products from research/coding assistance into commerce-like task execution. OpenAI has already launched a more agentic ChatGPT experience that can research, run code, interact with websites, and fill forms, indicating the product is moving closer to workflows where payments and referrals could naturally be monetized. OpenAI’s Help Center and product materials for ChatGPT agent describe browser actions, website interaction, and user controls such as pause/takeover, which are prerequisites for any eventual checkout or referral-fee model. See OpenAI’s ChatGPT agent introduction and help documentation: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/ and https://help.openai.com/ .

OpenAI also rolled out major Codex updates in late August 2025, including IDE integration, GitHub workflows, and persistent agent behavior across local and cloud environments, suggesting OpenAI is aggressively productizing agentic usage rather than offering only static chat responses. Reporting says these new features are available to paid ChatGPT subscribers and are powered by GPT-5, reinforcing that OpenAI is trying to embed GPT systems into real user workflows where monetization options may expand beyond subscriptions. See Winbuzzer coverage: https://winbuzzer.com/2025/08/28/openai-supercharges-codex-ai-coding-agent-with-ide-integration-gpt-5-power-and-github-reviews-xcxwbn/ .

OpenAI’s scale also matters. ChatGPT reportedly has hundreds of millions of weekly users, with one recent article citing more than 700 million weekly users, which creates strong incentive to diversify revenue models if agentic use cases become commercially actionable. See Medium: https://medium.com/ . Competition is also intensifying in AI assistants and coding, with reports that OpenAI faces pressure from Anthropic, Google, and others, making new monetization experiments more plausible. See The New Stack: https://thenewstack.io/the-ai-wars-data-developers-and-the-battle-for-market-share/ .

If OpenAI publicly demonstrates or announces that its agents can complete paid transactions or bookings for users through merchant flows, that would be a meaningful crux for the ultimate question: it would show both technical capability and commercial intent adjacent to transaction-fee monetization, without merely restating the ultimate question.

Sources:
OpenAI — Introducing ChatGPT agent — https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/
OpenAI Help Center — https://help.openai.com/
Winbuzzer — OpenAI Supercharges Codex AI Coding Agent With IDE Integration, GPT-5 Power, and GitHub Reviews — https://winbuzzer.com/2025/08/28/openai-supercharges-codex-ai-coding-agent-with-ide-integration-gpt-5-power-and-github-reviews-xcxwbn/
The New Stack — The AI Wars: Data, Developers and the Battle for Market Share — https://thenewstack.io/the-ai-wars-data-developers-and-the-battle-for-market-share/
Medium — What's Changed in 1,000 Days of AI and What's Next for Schools — https://medium.com/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 inclusive, OpenAI publicly announces through an official OpenAI source that ChatGPT agent, Codex, ChatGPT, GPT-5, or another GPT-powered OpenAI product has successfully completed at least one of the following on behalf of a user through an integrated third-party flow: (a) a purchase of goods or services, (b) a booking or reservation that requires payment or payment authorization, or (c) a paid subscription sign-up.

Qualifying official sources include OpenAI’s website/blog/newsroom (https://openai.com/news/ or relevant post pages on https://openai.com/), OpenAI Help Center documentation (https://help.openai.com/), official OpenAI social media accounts, or official product release notes. The announcement must describe the capability as available to some publicly identified set of users (including limited regional or tier-specific rollouts). Closed beta testing, private demos, or third-party rumors do not count.

The event counts only if the official announcement indicates completion of a real merchant/service transaction flow or paid sign-up, not merely form-filling, cart-building, price comparison, or a future roadmap statement. A demo video or announcement qualifies only if OpenAI states the capability is released or accessible to the specified users during the window.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying OpenAI announcement appears between 2025-09-01 and 2025-10-01 inclusive.

If OpenAI announces the capability during the window but explicitly says it is not yet released or only in internal/private testing, this resolves No. If relevant official pages are unavailable at resolution time, credible archived versions of official OpenAI pages (for example via https://archive.org/web/) may be used as fallback evidence. Credible reporting may be used only as secondary confirmation, not as the primary basis, unless it directly quotes or reproduces an official OpenAI release.

Primary sources proposed for resolution:
OpenAI News/Blog — https://openai.com/news/
OpenAI main site — https://openai.com/
OpenAI Help Center — https://help.openai.com/
OpenAI X account — https://x.com/OpenAI
subquestions.rationale: A public move from agentic assistance to completed commerce actions would be a strong leading indicator that OpenAI is building the product and partnership infrastructure needed for referral fees, taker fees, or marketplace commissions. It is distinct from the ultimate question because it asks about transaction execution capability, not whether OpenAI has already implemented a fee model.

question: Trump Crypto Pardon Parlay
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if both Changpeng Zhao and Roger Ver receive a presidential pardon, commutation, or reprieve from Donald Trump by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution source for whether the individual is pardoned or not will be official information from the US government, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will a federal court docket show that Roger Ver's deferred prosecution agreement or other plea/settlement resolving his U.S. criminal tax case was filed or approved by 2025-11-17?
subquestions.background_information:
A near-term indicator for the ultimate pardon parlay is whether Roger Ver's criminal case is moving toward ordinary legal resolution rather than requiring presidential clemency. Multiple October 2025 reports say Ver is near or has reached a DOJ deal to resolve the case for roughly $48–$50 million, with a court hearing reportedly scheduled for December 15, 2025. If a formal deferred prosecution agreement, plea agreement, dismissal motion tied to settlement, or comparable court-filed resolution appears by mid-November, that may reduce the need for a Trump pardon before year-end; if no such filing appears, pressure for a pardon campaign may remain higher. Fortune reported on October 14, 2025 that Ver had reached a deferred prosecution agreement with DOJ and would pay $49.9 million, and that the agreement was confirmed via a court filing: https://fortune.com/crypto/2025/10/14/bitcoin-jesus-roger-ver-doj-tax-evasion-charges-dismissed-50-million/. CoinDesk reported on October 9, 2025 that Ver was close to a settlement but that the deal had not yet been filed or approved by the federal judge, and noted a December 15, 2025 hearing: https://www.coindesk.com/policy/2025/10/09/roger-ver-reportedly-near-us-tax-settlement/. CoinCentral similarly reported a tentative settlement around $48 million, not yet filed with or approved by the judge, and noted Ver's lobbying/pardon efforts: https://coincentral.com/bitcoin-jesus-roger-ver-reaches-48-million-settlement-agreement-with-doj-over-tax-charges/. Reuters' April 2024 report provides the underlying case context: the U.S. charged Ver with mail fraud, tax evasion, and filing false tax returns related to allegedly underreporting bitcoin holdings and exit-tax obligations after renouncing U.S. citizenship: https://www.reuters.com/world/us/bitcoin-evangelist-roger-ver-charged-us-with-mail-fraud-tax-evasion-2024-04-30/.

Sources:
Fortune Crypto - Roger Ver reaches deal with DOJ: https://fortune.com/crypto/2025/10/14/bitcoin-jesus-roger-ver-doj-tax-evasion-charges-dismissed-50-million/
CoinDesk - Roger Ver reportedly near U.S. tax settlement: https://www.coindesk.com/policy/2025/10/09/roger-ver-reportedly-near-us-tax-settlement/
CoinCentral - Roger Ver settlement agreement report: https://coincentral.com/bitcoin-jesus-roger-ver-reaches-48-million-settlement-agreement-with-doj-over-tax-charges/
Reuters - Roger Ver charged in U.S. tax case: https://www.reuters.com/world/us/bitcoin-evangelist-roger-ver-charged-us-with-mail-fraud-tax-evasion-2024-04-30/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 inclusive, the public federal court docket for Roger Ver's U.S. criminal case shows a filing or order that clearly indicates a material settlement of the criminal charges, such as: (a) a deferred prosecution agreement, (b) a plea agreement, (c) a joint motion to dismiss or defer prosecution pursuant to a settlement, or (d) a court order approving such an agreement. This question resolves No if no such docket entry appears between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 inclusive.

Primary source: the federal court docket on PACER / CourtListener for the relevant Roger Ver criminal case. Resolvers should use the official PACER docket if available; if CourtListener mirrors the docket, it may be used as a convenience copy. PACER: https://pacer.uscourts.gov/ ; CourtListener RECAP search: https://www.courtlistener.com/recap/ .

Secondary confirming sources, if needed for interpretation of a docket entry: DOJ press releases at https://www.justice.gov/news ; major wire/service reporting such as Reuters https://www.reuters.com/ or AP https://apnews.com/ .

Clarifications: (1) Mere media reports of a proposed settlement do not count unless supported by an actual docket entry within the window. (2) A hearing being scheduled, continued, or discussed does not count by itself. (3) A filing must pertain to resolution of the criminal case, not merely related civil tax matters or extradition proceedings abroad. (4) If the docket is temporarily inaccessible on 2025-11-17, resolution may be delayed until access is restored, but only filings timestamped within 2025-10-18 through 2025-11-17 inclusive count. (5) If reporting conflicts about whether a filing occurred, the official docket controls.
subquestions.rationale: Roger Ver is one of the two required legs of the ultimate market. Whether his criminal case moves toward conventional judicial resolution in the next month is a meaningful crux: a formal settlement or DPA could reduce the probability that he needs or receives a presidential pardon by year-end, while the absence of such progress leaves the pardon route more salient.

question: Will Pieter Mulier be named the next creative director of Versace?
description:
This market will resolve according to the name of the person announced as the next creative director of Versace.

The listed person must be officially announced by Versace or Prada Group as the new Creative Director or an equivalent title such as Chief Creative Officer, Artistic Director of Versace, etc.

If no new creative director is announced by March 31, 2026, 11:59PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

Any announcement of a decision before this market's end date will immediately resolve this market to "Yes", regardless of when the announced appointment goes into effect.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Versace or Prada group, or a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will Maison Alaïa or Richemont publicly announce Pieter Mulier's departure from Alaïa, or the appointment of an interim/successor creative lead at Alaïa, between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-03?
subquestions.background_information:
Pieter Mulier is widely reported as the leading candidate to become Versace's next creative leader after Prada Group's acquisition of Versace. Multiple fashion-industry reports in December 2025 said Prada/Versace had identified Mulier as the preferred choice, but that negotiations with Richemont, Alaïa's parent company, were still ongoing. WWD reported on 2025-12-17 that Mulier "has not yet signed" and that his move was pending final negotiations with Richemont, which was reluctant to let him go because of his success at Alaïa (https://wwd.com/fashion-news/designer-luxury/pieter-mulier-versace-1237894567/). HYPEBEAST likewise reported on 2025-12-19 that negotiations with Richemont were ongoing and that a formal announcement was expected in early 2026 (https://hypebeast.com/2025/12/pieter-mulier-expected-to-lead-versace-under-prada-group-report). Business of Fashion also listed confirmation of Mulier as Versace's next creative director as a possible near-term development in late December 2025 (https://www.businessoffashion.com/articles/news-analysis/this-week-one-last-push-for-holiday-sales-december-2025/).

Because Mulier is currently creative director of Alaïa, a public departure announcement from Alaïa or Richemont, or a public naming of an interim or successor creative lead there, would be a strong operational signal that a move to Versace is imminent. This is a different observable event from Versace itself naming him, and it bears directly on one of the main reported bottlenecks: Richemont's willingness to release him.

Sources:
WWD - Sources: Pieter Mulier Headed to Versace: https://wwd.com/fashion-news/designer-luxury/pieter-mulier-versace-1237894567/
HYPEBEAST - Pieter Mulier Expected to Lead Versace Under Prada Group: https://hypebeast.com/2025/12/pieter-mulier-expected-to-lead-versace-under-prada-group-report
The Business of Fashion - This Week: One Last Push for Holiday Sales: https://www.businessoffashion.com/articles/news-analysis/this-week-one-last-push-for-holiday-sales-december-2025/
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-03 inclusive, Maison Alaïa or Compagnie Financière Richemont publicly announces any of the following: (a) that Pieter Mulier is leaving or has left his role at Alaïa; or (b) that Alaïa has appointed an interim creative lead, new creative director, chief creative officer, artistic director, design director, or other clearly equivalent top creative replacement for Mulier.

This question resolves No if no such public announcement is made between 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-03 inclusive.

For resolution, primary sources are official public communications from Alaïa or Richemont, including press releases or official website/newsroom/social-media posts: https://www.maison-alaia.com/ , https://www.richemont.com/ , https://www.instagram.com/maisonalaia/ .

If no official announcement is available, the question may resolve Yes based on a consensus of at least two independent credible reports from major fashion-business outlets explicitly stating that Alaïa or Richemont has announced Mulier's departure or a replacement during the resolution window. Suitable secondary sources include WWD (https://wwd.com/), Business of Fashion (https://www.businessoffashion.com/), Vogue Business (https://www.voguebusiness.com/), Reuters (https://www.reuters.com/), and FashionNetwork (https://us.fashionnetwork.com/).

Rumors, anonymous-source reports that do not describe a public announcement, or reports merely saying negotiations are ongoing do not count. If an announcement is issued outside the 2026-01-06 to 2026-02-03 window, it does not count. If reporting is too contradictory to determine whether a qualifying public announcement occurred during the window, the question should be considered unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: The ultimate question hinges not just on Versace's preferences but on whether Mulier can actually leave Alaïa. Recent reporting identifies Richemont negotiations as a key gating factor. Therefore, a public Alaïa/Richemont departure or replacement announcement would materially increase the probability that Versace soon names Mulier, while the absence of such a signal by early February would modestly weaken that case.

question: Will Apple release a new version of the Apple TV by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Apple releases a new Apple TV product by December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

A qualifying product must be named "Apple TV" and be recognized as a successor to the original Apple TV, similar to the relationship between iPhone 14 and iPhone 15. A new Apple TV product released without a number, under a designation other than Apple TV 2 will qualify if it retains the original functions of the Apple TV and expands on them in such a way that it is clear that this product is a successor.

In order to be considered released, the product must be officially announced by Apple, or otherwise available for purchase by the general public within the specified timeframe. An announcement or unveiling alone, for example during a WWDC event, will be sufficient to resolve this market to "Yes".

The primary resolution source for this market will be official statements from Apple. However, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

subquestions.question: Will Apple list the current Apple TV 4K as unavailable for immediate purchase on Apple.com in the United States at any point between 2025-10-17 and 2025-11-16, inclusive?
subquestions.background_information:
A short-term supply squeeze or removal of the existing Apple TV 4K from Apple's U.S. online store would be a meaningful indicator of an imminent hardware refresh, because Apple often allows inventory of outgoing models to run down shortly before replacing them. The current Apple TV 4K line was last updated in 2022; Apple still sells Apple TV 4K models on its website as part of its TV & Home lineup: https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/ and https://www.apple.com/tv-home/. Recent reporting specifically says Apple TV and HomePod mini inventory has been dwindling at select Apple Stores, which is consistent with an approaching product refresh (MacRumors, 2025-10-16): https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/16/apple-next-rumored-products-homepod-mini-apple-tv/. Separate roadmap reporting also says Apple is expected to refresh the Apple TV with a faster chip and new wireless components before year-end 2025 (MacRumors, 2025-10-01): https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/01/apple-2025-product-roadmap-whats-still-coming/. Bloomberg-sourced reporting summarized by Markets Insider on 2025-10-14 likewise said a refreshed Apple TV is in development even if not part of that week's launch set: https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/apple-aapl-may-introduce-several-new-products-this-week-1034634901. Because the ultimate question asks whether Apple will release a new Apple TV by December 31, 2025, a visible online-store stock disruption in the current model during the next month would be an observable near-term signal that Apple is preparing a successor rather than continuing normal steady-state sales.

Sources:
Apple TV 4K - https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/
Apple TV & Home - https://www.apple.com/tv-home/
MacRumors: Apple's 2025 Product Roadmap: What's Still Coming - https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/01/apple-2025-product-roadmap-whats-still-coming/
MacRumors: Apple's Next Rumored Products: New HomePod Mini, Apple TV, and More - https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/16/apple-next-rumored-products-homepod-mini-apple-tv/
Markets Insider: Apple (AAPL) May Introduce Several New Products This Week - https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/apple-aapl-may-introduce-several-new-products-this-week-1034634901
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, at any time between 2025-10-17 and 2025-11-16 inclusive, Apple's U.S. online store shows the currently sold Apple TV 4K hardware as not immediately purchasable due to supply status. Qualifying examples include Apple.com marking the product as "Currently unavailable," "Out of stock," "Unavailable," or giving a shipping estimate later than 14 calendar days from the observation date for all listed Apple TV 4K configurations on the main U.S. Apple TV 4K purchase page. The primary source is Apple's U.S. product page: https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/ and, if needed, Apple's checkout/store pages reachable from there. 

This question resolves No if no such qualifying unavailability appears on the U.S. Apple online store at any point between 2025-10-17 and 2025-11-16 inclusive.

For resolution, only the U.S. Apple online store counts; third-party retailers and physical store inventory do not count. Temporary website outages, pages under maintenance, or inability to load the site do not count as product unavailability unless the product page itself explicitly indicates unavailability or delayed shipping as defined above. If only some configurations are unavailable but at least one Apple TV 4K configuration remains available for immediate purchase with shipping within 14 calendar days, that does not qualify. If Apple replaces the page with a successor product before any qualifying unavailability is observed, this subquestion still resolves based only on whether the old product page met the stated unavailability condition during the 2025-10-17 to 2025-11-16 window.

Suggested evidentiary sources for archival confirmation, if Apple changes the page later, are the Internet Archive Wayback Machine https://web.archive.org/ and archived snapshots/screenshots from reputable coverage such as MacRumors https://www.macrumors.com/ or 9to5Mac https://9to5mac.com/. If no reliable archived evidence is available to determine whether the condition occurred during the window, the question should be treated as unresolvable.
subquestions.rationale: This is not just the ultimate question with an earlier deadline. Instead, it tracks a distinct operational signal: whether Apple appears to be winding down sales of the current model. If the current Apple TV 4K goes unavailable on Apple's own store in the next month, that would materially increase the odds that Apple is preparing a near-term successor by year-end.

question: John Brennan federally charged by December 31?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the United States federal government formally charges or announces a criminal indictment of former American intelligence officer John O. Brennan between October 27 and December 31, 2025 ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

For the purposes of this market the District of Columbia and any county, municipality, or other subdivision of a State shall be included within the definition of a State.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from US governmental sources; however, a wide consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

subquestions.question: Will the U.S. Department of Justice or the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of Florida publicly confirm by 2025-12-27 that John O. Brennan has been subpoenaed or otherwise compelled to provide testimony or documents in a federal criminal investigation?
subquestions.background_information:
A meaningful near-term indicator for whether John Brennan could be federally charged by year-end is whether federal prosecutors publicly confirm compulsory investigative steps against him. Public confirmation of a subpoena, target-related document demand, or compelled testimony would be a materially different event from an indictment, but one that would usually signal that a criminal investigation is active and sufficiently advanced to justify coercive process.

As of 2025-11-27, multiple outlets have reported that Brennan is under federal scrutiny tied to alleged false statements about the Steele dossier and the 2017 Intelligence Community Assessment. Fox News reported on 2025-11-07 that DOJ had issued federal subpoenas to Brennan and others as part of a criminal investigation supervised by U.S. Attorney Jason Reding Quiñones in the Southern District of Florida: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/grand-jury-subpoenas-brennan-strzok-page-trump-russia-probe . The Washington Examiner similarly reported on 2025-11-08 that Brennan had been subpoenaed by a grand jury in the Southern District of Florida: https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/policy/courts/3216841/john-brennan-other-officials-subpoenaed-over-trump-russia-inquiry/ . The Independent reported on 2025-11-11 that subpoenas had been issued in the broader probe and included Brennan among the targets: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-russia-probe-subpoenas-b2650197.html .

However, these reports appear to rely heavily on anonymous sourcing and secondary reporting; the ultimate market specifies that official U.S. governmental sources are primary for resolution. Therefore, an official public confirmation from DOJ or the relevant U.S. Attorney's Office would be a clearer, lower-level crux than an indictment itself. If such confirmation occurs, forecasters should update upward on the chance of a charge by 2025-12-31; if no such confirmation occurs by 2025-12-27, that would be some evidence against very near-term charges.

Sources:
Fox News - Grand jury subpoenas Brennan, Strzok, Page in Trump-Russia probe: https://www.foxnews.com/politics/grand-jury-subpoenas-brennan-strzok-page-trump-russia-probe
Washington Examiner - John Brennan and other officials subpoenaed over Trump-Russia inquiry: https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/policy/courts/3216841/john-brennan-other-officials-subpoenaed-over-trump-russia-inquiry/
The Independent - Top prosecutor fires off subpoenas for 'conspiracy' case against Trump's enemies: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/trump-russia-probe-subpoenas-b2650197.html
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-11-27 and 2025-12-27 inclusive, an official public statement by the U.S. Department of Justice or the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of Florida states that John O. Brennan has been subpoenaed, ordered to produce records, or otherwise compelled to testify or provide documents in a federal criminal investigation.

Qualifying official public statements include, for example:
- a DOJ press release on https://www.justice.gov/ ;
- a press release or news item on the Southern District of Florida website at https://www.justice.gov/usao-sdfl ;
- a filed federal court document publicly available via PACER or mirrored by a court/DOJ webpage that explicitly states Brennan was subpoenaed or compelled in a criminal matter; or
- an official DOJ spokesperson statement published on a .gov webpage.

This question does NOT resolve Yes based solely on anonymous-source media reports, commentary by members of Congress, or statements by Brennan or his representatives, unless those statements attach or directly quote an official DOJ/court document confirming the compulsory process.

If multiple official sources conflict, the most specific and authoritative criminal-case document or DOJ press statement governs. If no qualifying official public confirmation appears during the window from 2025-11-27 through 2025-12-27 inclusive, the question resolves No.

If a claimed subpoena was issued before 2025-11-27 but is only officially confirmed during the resolution window, that still counts for Yes, because the qualifying event is the official public confirmation during the stated window. If a confirmation is first published after 2025-12-27, it does not count.

Primary sources for resolution:
- U.S. Department of Justice press releases: https://www.justice.gov/news
- U.S. Attorney's Office, Southern District of Florida: https://www.justice.gov/usao-sdfl
- PACER case search: https://pcl.uscourts.gov/pcl/index.jsf
subquestions.rationale: An officially confirmed subpoena or similar compulsory step is a strong process indicator that prosecutors are actively developing a criminal case against Brennan. It is not the same as an indictment, but it would materially increase the plausibility of charges by December 31.

question: Will Travis Hunter only play defense?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Travis Hunter plays at least 20 total defensive snaps AND plays 19 or less total offensive snaps across the first 4 NFL games he participates in. Otherwise this market will resolve to "No".

Participating is defined as entering the game for at least one snap.  

If Travis Hunter doesn't participate in 4 games of the 2025-26 NFL Regular Season Game by December 31, 2025, this market will resolve to "No". 

The resolution source will be official information from the National Football League, however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used. 

Note: Offensive snaps on plays in which there is a punt will not count towards the total.

subquestions.question: Will Travis Hunter be listed as a starter at wide receiver or cornerback on at least two official Jacksonville Jaguars regular-season depth charts released between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-27?
subquestions.background_information:
This is a useful indicator for whether Hunter will "only play defense" in his first four NFL games, because teams' official depth charts signal intended role and usage before game snaps are fully observed. If Hunter is repeatedly listed as a starter at WR or CB, that suggests the Jaguars intend meaningful deployment on that side of the ball. Since the ultimate market resolves Yes only if he plays at least 20 defensive snaps and 19 or fewer offensive snaps across his first four games, repeated starting designation at wide receiver would be especially bearish for a Yes outcome, while repeated starting designation only at cornerback and not at WR would be more consistent with a defense-heavy role.

Hunter and the Jaguars have publicly discussed a two-way role. Hunter said before the draft that he wanted to keep playing both offense and defense, and that if a team would not let him do that, it would be "game over" for football for him. See ESPN, 2025-04-15: https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/44687455/travis-hunter-says-never-play-football-again-if-nfl-team-tells-one-position and CBS Sports, 2025-04-08: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-draft-2025-travis-hunter-says-he-would-like-to-play-every-snap-in-game-if-team-allows-him/

Preseason reporting also suggested Jacksonville was preparing him for real work on both sides rather than a defense-only role. A Jaguars-related report cited ESPN's Jeremy Fowler saying Hunter might play roughly 40 snaps on offense and 30 on defense, though not a full ironman load: https://www.ledger-enquirer.com/sports/nfl/article307967306.html . Another August report said coach Liam Coen envisioned a large offensive workload and potentially matching defensive involvement: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/jaguars-reveal-shocking-plan-travis-223000123.html . Reporting on late-August practices said his 11-on-11 practice snaps had been close to even between offense and defense (173 offense, 168 defense), despite an upper-body injury and cautious preseason handling: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/nfl-insider-injury-update-jaguars-120000000.html

Because official team depth charts are publicly posted each regular-season week and specify starters by position, they provide a cleaner, earlier indicator than waiting for four games of snap totals.

Sources:
ESPN - Travis Hunter says he'd quit football if told to play one position: https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/44687455/travis-hunter-says-never-play-football-again-if-nfl-team-tells-one-position
CBS Sports - Travis Hunter says he would like to play every snap if team allows him: https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/nfl-draft-2025-travis-hunter-says-he-would-like-to-play-every-snap-in-game-if-team-allows-him/
Ledger-Enquirer - Jaguars send welcoming message / expected offensive and defensive snap mix: https://www.ledger-enquirer.com/sports/nfl/article307967306.html
Yahoo Sports - Jaguars reveal plan for large offensive workload: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/jaguars-reveal-shocking-plan-travis-223000123.html
Yahoo Sports - Injury/practice update with near-even 11-on-11 snaps: https://sports.yahoo.com/article/nfl-insider-injury-update-jaguars-120000000.html
Jacksonville Jaguars official depth chart page: https://www.jaguars.com/team/depth-chart
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-27 (inclusive), the Jacksonville Jaguars publish at least two official regular-season depth charts on https://www.jaguars.com/team/depth-chart (or another official Jaguars/NFL team site location if the page structure changes) on which Travis Hunter is listed as a starter at either wide receiver or cornerback.

For this question, "starter" means he is listed in the top/first-string slot for a position on the official depth chart for WR or CB. If the Jaguars use left/right or X/Z/slot distinctions, being first-listed at any WR spot counts; being first-listed at any CB spot counts. The same depth chart can count only once even if he is shown as a starter at both WR and CB on that chart.

Primary source: Jacksonville Jaguars official depth chart page, https://www.jaguars.com/team/depth-chart . If the Jaguars move or archive the page, an official NFL/Jaguars team website mirror or archived copy of the official page may be used. As a secondary confirmation source only, NFL.com team pages or the official weekly Game Release / depth chart PDF issued by the Jaguars may be used if publicly available.

This question resolves No if fewer than two such official depth charts meeting the above criteria are released between 2025-09-01 and 2025-09-27 (inclusive).

If no official Jaguars regular-season depth chart is published at all during the window, resolve No. If a purported depth chart appears only in media reporting and not on an official Jaguars or NFL source, it does not count.

Sources for resolution:
Jacksonville Jaguars official depth chart: https://www.jaguars.com/team/depth-chart
NFL.com Jacksonville Jaguars team page: https://www.nfl.com/teams/jacksonville-jaguars/
subquestions.rationale: Official starting designations are an early, observable signal of intended usage. If Hunter is repeatedly listed as a starting WR, that strongly suggests offensive snaps are coming and makes the ultimate Yes outcome less likely. If he is repeatedly listed only as a starting CB and not as a starting WR, that is more compatible with a defense-dominant first month.

question: Trump appoints special prosecutor for Epstein case in 2025?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Donald Trump officially appoints, or announces the appointment of a special prosecutor, special counsel, or other independent prosecutor to investigate matters related to Jeffrey Epstein by December 31, 2025, 11:59 PM ET.  Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”
 
To qualify, the appointee must be explicitly tasked with investigating the Epstein case. A public statement from Trump, the White House, or the Department of Justice confirming the appointment will be sufficient for a “Yes” resolution regardless of when the appointment goes into effect. 

General statements of intent without a named appointee will not qualify. 

The primary resolution source will be official announcements from the Trump administration or a consensus of credible reporting.

subquestions.question: Will the Trump administration or DOJ publicly release any new tranche of non-court-filed Jeffrey Epstein investigative materials between 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30?
subquestions.background_information:
A meaningful near-term indicator for whether Trump will later appoint a special prosecutor on Epstein is whether the administration chooses a transparency/escalation path on the underlying matter during November. Public release of new Epstein-related investigative materials would suggest the White House or DOJ sees political value in visibly advancing the issue, which could increase the odds of a later independent-prosecutor appointment. Conversely, continued refusal to release materials would weakly suggest less appetite for escalating the matter through a special prosecutor.

This is grounded in current reporting that Attorney General Pam Bondi has faced criticism over the department’s handling of Epstein files and has refused to release them despite pressure from conservatives; that issue was expected to come up in her October 7 Senate Judiciary Committee testimony. See Daily Bulletin, Oct. 7, 2025: https://www.dailybulletin.com/2025/10/07/watch-live-attorney-general-bondi-faces-senate-questions-over-political-pressure-on-justice-department/

The broader late-2025 context also suggests DOJ under Trump is willing to take highly public, politically salient prosecutorial steps when Trump pressures it to do so, including pursuing adversaries and using unconventional appointment arrangements. See Yahoo, Oct. 10, 2025: https://www.yahoo.com/news/when-trump-demands-prosecutions-his-doj-now-obeys-000000000.html ; MSNBC, Oct. 19, 2025: https://www.msnbc.com/opinion/msnbc-opinion/trump-acting-prosecutors-doj-loyalists-rcna000000

Recent legal turmoil around Trump-appointed acting prosecutors in multiple districts also makes a document-release path potentially more attractive than immediately creating another controversial prosecutorial role. Newsweek reported on Oct. 30, 2025 that a federal judge found acting U.S. attorney Bill Essayli was serving unlawfully, following similar disputes elsewhere: https://www.newsweek.com/trump-picked-attorney-reacts-after-judge-disqualifies-him-0000000

For this subquestion, 'new tranche of non-court-filed Jeffrey Epstein investigative materials' means materials that were not already publicly available before 2025-10-31 and that are released by the administration/DOJ/FBI in connection with Epstein, such as FBI files, DOJ memoranda, interview summaries, evidence logs, visitor logs, correspondence, or similar records. It excludes purely judicial filings already placed on court dockets by private litigants, as those are less informative about the administration’s own willingness to act.

Sources:

subquestions.question: Will OpenAI publicly announce a waitlist, beta, or developer preview for a standalone web browser between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17?
subquestions.background_information:
One leg of the ultimate parlay requires that OpenAI publicly release a standalone web browser by the end of 2025. A near-term precursor would be OpenAI publicly acknowledging the product through a waitlist, beta signup, or developer preview page. Such a step would be materially different from the final release itself, but would strongly indicate that a 2025 release remains on track. Reporting before 2025-10-18 says OpenAI’s browser is expected but still lacks an official release date, suggesting meaningful uncertainty remains rather than the event being already locked in. Mashable reported on 2025-10-01 that OpenAI’s AI-powered browser was anticipated, with native ChatGPT integration and competition with Chrome, Safari, and Edge, but that no official release date had been given: https://mashable.com/article/ai-product-releases-on-the-horizon-2025 . A related 2025-10-01 Mashable ME article likewise described the browser as upcoming but without an official launch date: https://me.mashable.com/tech/62015/6-productivity-boosting-ai-product-releases-on-the-horizon .

This is a useful crux because late-2025 consumer software launches are often preceded by public waitlists, preview programs, or developer documentation. If no such public signal appears by mid-November 2025, forecasters should update downward on the chance that OpenAI will complete a full public browser release by 2025-12-31. Conversely, a public preview or waitlist would be a strong positive indicator while remaining distinct from the ultimate condition.

Sources:
Mashable - 6 productivity-boosting AI product releases on the horizon in 2025 - https://mashable.com/article/ai-product-releases-on-the-horizon-2025
Mashable ME - 6 productivity-boosting AI product releases on the horizon - https://me.mashable.com/tech/62015/6-productivity-boosting-ai-product-releases-on-the-horizon
subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 (inclusive), OpenAI publicly announces or makes publicly accessible any official waitlist, beta signup, developer preview, preview program, or similar pre-release access mechanism for a standalone web browser product.

For Yes, all of the following must be true within the window 2025-10-18 through 2025-11-17 inclusive:
1. The announcement or page is issued by OpenAI or published on an official OpenAI-controlled property, such as openai.com, chatgpt.com, help.openai.com, platform.openai.com, official OpenAI social accounts, or an official OpenAI livestream/event page.
2. The product is explicitly presented as a standalone web browser (not merely a feature inside ChatGPT, an operator/agent feature, a plugin, a search mode, or an API capability).
3. The waitlist / beta / preview is available to the public in the sense that any member of the public can view the announcement page or attempt to sign up, even if access is limited, region-gated, invite-only after signup, or capped.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying public announcement or public-facing page appears between 2025-10-18 and 2025-11-17 inclusive.

Resolution sources, in order of priority:
1. Official OpenAI website and newsroom pages, including https://openai.com/ and linked subpages.
2. Official OpenAI X account and other official social accounts: https://x.com/OpenAI .
3. OpenAI Help Center: https://help.openai.com/ .
4. If an official announcement clearly occurred in-window but later pages are removed, archived captures from the Internet Archive may be used as corroborating evidence: https://web.archive.org/ .

Edge cases:
- If OpenAI announces a browser internally or via leaks only, that does not count.
- If OpenAI announces only a browser feature within ChatGPT or within another company’s browser, that does not count.
- If a page appears before 2025-10-18, it does not count even if still live during the window.
- If the announcement is first made after 2025-11-17, it does not count.
- If evidence remains too ambiguous to determine whether the product is a standalone browser, resolve No.
- If official sources become unavailable, contemporaneous archived copies plus at least one major reputable news report quoting the official announcement may be used as fallback, but the official announcement itself must still have existed during the 2025-10-18 to 2025-11-17 window.
subquestions.rationale: Among the five legs, OpenAI’s browser appears comparatively uncertain and time-sensitive. A public waitlist or preview by mid-November would be a strong leading indicator that OpenAI can still ship a standalone browser by year-end, while failure to show even a public pre-release signal would meaningfully weaken the case for the ultimate parlay resolving Yes.

subquestions.question: Will any official Up Only public channel publish a post between 2025-10-23 and 2025-11-22 that explicitly announces a release date or release window for a new Up Only podcast episode in 2025?
subquestions.background_information:
A concrete public announcement is a strong leading indicator for whether a dormant or irregular podcast will actually release before year-end. For podcast/video productions, release-date announcements typically occur shortly before publication and often reflect that recording, editing, and scheduling are already substantially complete. The ultimate market resolves on whether a full new Up Only episode is publicly released by December 31, 2025, so an official announcement of a 2025 release window by late November would materially increase the chance of a December release.

The relevant observable here is not the episode itself, but whether the creators publicly commit to a release timeline on an official channel. Official channels are important because third-party speculation or fan posts are weak evidence, while creator-controlled posts on YouTube, X, podcast feeds, or official websites are much stronger indicators of intent and production status.

General industry context: podcast episodes are commonly promoted on creator-controlled distribution channels such as YouTube and platform-linked podcast feeds before release. Apple Podcasts provides show pages and episode feeds that can be checked for show activity: https://podcasts.apple.com/ and Spotify likewise hosts official show pages and episode listings: https://podcasters.spotify.com/ and https://open.spotify.com/. YouTube is also a standard release and promotion channel for video podcasts: https://www.youtube.com/.

Because the ultimate question concerns a release by the end of 2025 and today is already 2025-10-23, a public announcement by 2025-11-22 would be a timely, nontrivial indicator without merely restating the ultimate question.

1. Official Up Only public posts/pages on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, official website, or official social accounts.

subquestions.question: Will Mark Teixeira report at least $3.0 million in total receipts for his 2025–2026 Republican primary campaign for TX-21 in his next FEC filing made public by 2026-03-01?
subquestions.background_information:

A January 2026 report on his campaign said he had raised and loaned $2.5 million to his campaign, far outpacing rivals, and had endorsements from Gov. Greg Abbott and multiple sitting members of Congress (Houston Chronicle, 2026-01-20: https://www.houstonchronicle.com/politics/texas/article/mark-teixeira-tx21-republican-primary-20000000.php). Another January 2026 report stated that Teixeira announced over $300,000 raised in Q4 and more than $2.5 million cash on hand, while highlighting his endorsements from Abbott, Steve Scalise, Jim Jordan, and numerous Texas conservatives (NJ.com, 2026-01-06: https://www.nj.com/yankees/2026/01/ex-yankees-slugger-celebrates-milestone-as-political-outsider-voters-want-a-proven-winner.html).

Because Teixeira has already reportedly crossed roughly $2.5 million in raised-and-loaned support, whether his next official FEC filing shows at least $3.0 million in total receipts by early March is a useful near-term test of whether his financial advantage is real and durable enough to help secure the nomination. This is not the same as asking who wins the primary; it focuses on an observable campaign-strength indicator before voting concludes.

The relevant official data source is the Federal Election Commission candidate filings database, which publishes campaign finance reports including total receipts, contributions, loans, and cash-on-hand for federal candidates: https://www.fec.gov/data/ and campaign finance filing resources at https://www.fec.gov/help-candidates-and-committees/filing-reports/.

subquestions.resolution_criteria:

Primary source: the Federal Election Commission candidate/committee filings and financial summary pages at https://www.fec.gov/data/.

Resolution procedure:
1. Identify Mark Teixeira's authorized principal campaign committee for his 2026 U.S. House campaign in Texas' 21st district on the FEC website.
2. Check any filing first made publicly available by the FEC between 2026-02-02 and 2026-03-01 inclusive.
3. Use the FEC-reported "total receipts" figure for the 2025-2026 cycle from that filing or its FEC summary page.
4. Resolve Yes if that figure is greater than or equal to $3,000,000. Otherwise resolve No.

Clarifications:
- "Made public" means visible on the FEC website during the resolution window, not merely submitted by the campaign earlier.
- If multiple qualifying filings are made public during the window, use the latest such filing made public by 2026-03-01.
- Amendments count if they are made public during the window.
- Candidate loans count only insofar as they are included in the FEC's "total receipts" figure; no separate manual adjustment should be made.
- If no new Teixeira filing is made public by the FEC between 2026-02-02 and 2026-03-01 inclusive, resolve No.
- If the FEC site is unavailable or the filing cannot be accessed, use archived FEC pages or the campaign's filed report as reproduced by a major nonpartisan campaign-finance database that mirrors FEC data, such as OpenSecrets: https://www.opensecrets.org/.

Sources for resolution:
Federal Election Commission data portal https://www.fec.gov/data/
Federal Election Commission filing reports guidance https://www.fec.gov/help-candidates-and-committees/filing-reports/
OpenSecrets https://www.opensecrets.org/
subquestions.rationale: Teixeira's path to the nomination likely depends in part on whether his apparent money advantage is large enough to dominate a crowded field. An official FEC showing of at least $3.0 million in receipts by March 1 would reinforce the case that he has unusual campaign capacity and viability; failure to reach that mark would be evidence against the narrative that he is the clear frontrunner.

question: Will the Sanctioning Russia Act of 2025 (S.1241) be signed into law by December 31 2025?

subquestions.question: Will Congress.gov show at least one committee report or written report filed on S.1241 between 2025-10-22 and 2025-11-21?
subquestions.background_information:

The ultimate question asks whether S.1241, the Sanctioning Russia Act of 2025, will be signed into law by the end of 2025. A near-term indicator is whether the bill shows concrete procedural movement in Congress, especially committee reporting, which is a standard step for many bills before floor consideration. Congress.gov is the official federal legislative tracking source and records actions such as committee reports and related filings on each bill page: https://www.congress.gov/. The provided background indicates that S.1241 has attracted extensive bipartisan support and substantial public discussion, with reports in mid-2025 claiming roughly 84-85 Senate cosponsors and possible efforts to attach the measure to must-pass legislation, but also that the bill had not yet become law and still faced procedural and presidential obstacles. See Forbes on 2025-07-15: https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbesbusinesscouncil/2025/07/15/us-senate-weighs-sanctions-bill-as-russia-stalls-peace-talks/ ; and WSIU/AP-style reporting on 2025-07-18: https://www.wsiu.org/2025-07-18/congress-hopes-to-raise-heat-on-russia-amid-souring-relations-between-trump-and-putin . Because broad cosponsorship alone does not ensure enactment, an observable sign of increased seriousness is whether official committee reporting occurs in the next month. If such a report appears, it would suggest the bill is receiving active institutional processing rather than remaining dormant.

Qualifying examples include entries on the S.1241 bill page or its Actions/All Actions tabs such as "Committee report filed," "Reported by," "Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders," when explicitly tied to a committee report, or a linked committee report document associated with S.1241. If the bill is superseded, amended, or folded into another vehicle, that does not count unless Congress.gov still shows a committee report filed on S.1241 itself during the resolution window. It is not a restatement of the ultimate question, but a tractable indicator of whether S.1241 is moving through Congress quickly enough to have a realistic chance of becoming law by year-end.

subquestions.question: Will OpenAI release an Atlas browser version for either Windows or a mobile operating system (iOS or Android) between 2025-10-24 and 2025-11-23, inclusive?
subquestions.background_information:
Atlas appears to have launched publicly in late October 2025 as an AI-powered browser from OpenAI. Multiple contemporaneous reports say the initial release was on macOS, with Windows, iOS, and Android versions expected soon. For example, The Telegraph reported on 2025-10-22 that Atlas was 'initially available on macOS, with Windows, iOS, and Android versions expected soon' (https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2025/10/22/openai-unveils-atlas-browser-to-take-on-google/). Hindustan Times likewise reported that Atlas launched first on macOS and would expand to Windows, iOS, and Android (https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/google-loses-100-billion-in-market-value-after-chatgpt-announces-new-browser-101761129000000.html). Daily News similarly described the launch as initially for Apple desktops/laptops worldwide, with other platforms coming soon (https://www.nydailynews.com/2025/10/21/openai-launches-ai-powered-web-browser-chatgpt-atlas/).

This matters for the ultimate question because StatCounter's browser market-share series for the parent market includes Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, and Console worldwide. A browser limited to macOS desktop/laptop for most of the remaining year would face a much narrower addressable base than one that quickly expands to Windows and/or mobile. Current browser usage is heavily cross-platform, and mobile accounts for a majority of global web traffic. StatCounter coverage for browser share in the ultimate question explicitly aggregates desktop, mobile, tablet, and console usage worldwide (https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share). Separately, reporting citing StatCounter noted that mobile devices account for over 60% of global web traffic, underscoring why mobile availability could be especially important for any attempt to reach 5% global share by year-end (https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkiye-surpasses-global-average-in-mobile-internet-use-211157).

The incumbent market is highly concentrated. Recent reporting based on StatCounter described Chrome at roughly 71.8%-71.9% global share in September/October 2025, with Safari and Edge far behind (https://www.pcworld.com/article/2816751/chrome-breaks-market-share-record-leaving-competitors-in-the-dust.html; https://www.neowin.net/news/google-chrome-continues-crushing-other-browsers-reaches-new-all-time-high/). That concentration suggests Atlas likely needs very rapid distribution expansion, not just a macOS-only launch, to have a realistic path to 5%+ by 2025-12-31.

Sources:
The Telegraph - OpenAI unveils Atlas browser to take on Google and redefine the Internet experience - https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2025/10/22/openai-unveils-atlas-browser-to-take-on-google/
Hindustan Times - Google loses $100 billion in market value after ChatGPT announces new browser - https://www.hindustantimes.com/technology/google-loses-100-billion-in-market-value-after-chatgpt-announces-new-browser-101761129000000.html

StatCounter Global Stats - Browser Market Share Worldwide - https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share
Hurriyet Daily News - Türkiye surpasses global average in mobile internet use - https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/turkiye-surpasses-global-average-in-mobile-internet-use-211157

subquestions.resolution_criteria:
This question resolves Yes if, between 2025-10-24 and 2025-11-23 inclusive, OpenAI publicly releases Atlas for at least one of the following operating systems: Windows, iOS, or Android.

A qualifying release means at least one of the following occurs within the window:
1. An official OpenAI announcement states that Atlas is available to the general public on Windows, iOS, or Android; or
2. Atlas becomes publicly listed and downloadable/installable in an official distribution channel for one of those platforms during the window, namely Microsoft Store for Windows, Apple App Store for iOS, or Google Play for Android.

The primary sources for resolution will be official OpenAI channels and official app-store listings:
- OpenAI News: https://openai.com/news/
- OpenAI X account: https://x.com/OpenAI
- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store
- Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/

If an official OpenAI post links directly to a public beta, preview, or general availability build for one of the qualifying platforms, that counts as a release, provided the software is actually obtainable by the public during the window. A mere announcement of future plans, waitlist, closed beta, developer test, or region-limited/private test does not count unless the app is publicly downloadable by general users in at least one country during the window.

This question resolves No if no such qualifying public release occurs between 2025-10-24 and 2025-11-23 inclusive.

If evidence is conflicting, priority will be: (1) official OpenAI announcement explicitly stating availability, then (2) live official app-store listing showing Atlas available for download, then (3) major press coverage quoting OpenAI and linking to the release. If Atlas is announced within the window but the actual public availability begins only after 2025-11-23, resolve No. If OpenAI or the relevant stores are permanently unavailable at resolution time, fallback sources include reputable reporting from The Verge, TechCrunch, Reuters, or The Telegraph, so long as they clearly document a public release during the stated window.
subquestions.rationale: Near-term cross-platform rollout is a strong indicator of whether Atlas can plausibly reach 5% global share by 2025-12-31. Because the ultimate market uses worldwide browser share across desktop and mobile/tablet, expansion beyond an initial macOS launch is a key bottleneck. If Atlas is still single-platform by late November, 5% by year-end becomes much less likely; if OpenAI ships Windows or mobile quickly, the path becomes more credible.
